title: JointHOI: Jointly Generating Contact Maps Enhances Hand Object Interaction Generation
summary: Text driven hand object interaction (HOI) generation is gaining attention for immersive applications and robotics, yet producing physically plausible interactions remains challenging. Even when individual motions appear natural, small contact errors can cause conspicuous artifacts such as floating and interpenetration. Prior methods mitigate these issues using explicit contact cues or implicit grasp priors, but typically rely on multi stage pipelines and fail to model temporally evolving contact. We present JointHOI, a single stage diffusion framework that jointly generates 3D hand object motion and dynamic, distance based contact maps from text. By treating contact as an auxiliary inner modality, joint generation enables the model to learn contact motion coupling during training. At inference, contact guided sampling enforces consistency between generated contact maps and motion implied geometry, improving temporal stability and reducing penetration and floating. Experiments on GRAB and ARCTIC demonstrate consistent improvements in text adherence and physical plausibility over prior methods.

AI.title_translation: JointHOI：联合生成接触图以增强手部-物体交互生成
AI.tldr: JointHOI 通过联合生成运动与接触图，在单阶段框架下解决了手部-物体交互生成中的物理穿透和悬空问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本驱动手部-物体交互生成方法难以保证物理合理性，常出现悬空或物体穿透现象，且现有方法多采用多阶段流水线，难以有效建模随时间演变的接触信息。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 JointHOI 的单阶段扩散框架，该框架将手部-物体运动与动态、基于距离的接触图进行联合生成；在训练时学习接触与运动的耦合，在推理时利用接触引导采样来约束生成过程。
AI.result: 在 GRAB 和 ARCTIC 数据集上的实验表明，JointHOI 在文本一致性和物理合理性方面均优于现有方法，有效减少了穿透和悬空现象，并增强了时间稳定性。
AI.conclusion: JointHOI 通过联合生成动态接触图与手部-物体交互运动，显著提升了生成结果的物理合理性和时间稳定性，优于现有的多阶段方法。
AI.translation: 文本驱动的手部-物体交互（HOI）生成在沉浸式应用和机器人领域正受到关注，但产生物理上合理的交互仍然具有挑战性。即使单个动作看起来很自然，微小的接触误差也可能导致明显的伪影，如悬空和穿透。先前的方法使用显式的接触线索或隐式的抓取先验来缓解这些问题，但通常依赖于多阶段流水线，且无法建模随时间演变的接触。我们提出了 JointHOI，这是一个单阶段扩散框架，可以从文本中联合生成 3D 手部-物体运动和动态的、基于距离的接触图。通过将接触视为辅助内部模态，联合生成使模型能够在训练过程中学习接触与运动的耦合。在推理时，接触引导采样强制执行生成的接触图与运动隐含几何形状之间的一致性，从而提高了时间稳定性并减少了穿透和悬空。在 GRAB 和 ARCTIC 数据集上的实验证明，与先前的方法相比，该方法在文本依从性和物理合理性方面均有持续的改进。
AI.summary: JointHOI 是一种用于文本驱动手部-物体交互（HOI）生成的单阶段扩散框架。它通过将动态接触图与 3D 运动联合生成，并采用接触引导采样，解决了传统方法中存在的物理合理性差、多阶段流程复杂及难以处理时间演变接触的问题。
AI.keywords: 手部-物体交互, 扩散模型, 接触图, 物理合理性, 运动生成
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将接触图（contact maps）作为辅助模态与手部-物体交互（HOI）运动联合生成，并采用单阶段扩散框架，有效解决了现有方法中多阶段流水线复杂及难以建模时间演变接触的问题。它在提升运动物理合理性（如减少穿透和悬空）方面表现出色，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Faster Parameterized Broadcasting
summary:
Given a connected graph $G$ and a source $s \in V(G)$, what is the smallest number of rounds necessary for all vertices of $G$ to receive a message initially only held by $s$, where at each round every informed vertex passes the message to one of its neighbors? This problem is called Telephone Broadcast and is suprisingly hard: it remains NP-hard on cycles intersecting at a single shared vertex, in particular, graphs of pathwidth 2 with a linear feedback vertex set of size 1, as well as on graphs with treedepth at most 6 [Egami et al.; MFCS '25]. Vertex cover number, vertex integrity, and distance to clique are among the few parameters for which Telephone Broadcast is fixed-parameter tractable. There is a $2^{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{vc}^3)} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$-time algorithm parameterized by vertex cover number $\mathrm{vc}$ [Fomin, Fraigniaud, Golovach; TCS '24], a double-exponential algorithm parameterized by vertex integrity $\mathrm{vi}$, and a $2^{\mathcal{O}(k^2)} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$-time algorithm parameterized by distance to clique $k$ [Egami et al.; MFCS '25].
  In this paper, we give improved parameterized algorithms for Telephone Broadcast with running times $2^{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{vc} \log \mathrm{vc})} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$, $2^{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{vi}^2 \log \mathrm{vi})} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$, and $2^{\mathcal{O}(k \log k)} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$. The main ingredient that makes our algorithms faster is a Turing reduction to edge-weighted $b$-Matching.

AI.title_translation: 更快的参数化广播算法
AI.tldr: 通过将Telephone Broadcast问题归约为带权b-匹配问题，作者为多个图参数提供了显著更快的参数化算法。
AI.motivation: Telephone Broadcast问题在多种图结构中均表现出NP-hard特性，且现有的参数化算法在顶点覆盖数、顶点完整性及到团距离等参数下的运行时间仍有优化空间。
AI.method: 通过Turing归约将Telephone Broadcast问题转化为带权边的b-匹配（edge-weighted b-Matching）问题，从而优化了参数化算法的复杂度。
AI.result: 将针对顶点覆盖数、顶点完整性及到团距离的算法运行时间分别提升至 $2^{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{vc} \log \mathrm{vc})} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$、$2^{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{vi}^2 \log \mathrm{vi})} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$ 和 $2^{\mathcal{O}(k \log k)} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将Telephone Broadcast问题转化为带权边的b-匹配问题，成功改进了针对顶点覆盖数、顶点完整性和到团距离三个参数的算法运行时间。
AI.translation: 给定一个连通图 $G$ 和源点 $s \in V(G)$，所有顶点接收到初始仅由 $s$ 持有的消息所需的最少轮数是多少？在每一轮中，每个已接收消息的顶点将其传递给一个邻居。这个问题被称为“电话广播”（Telephone Broadcast），它非常困难：即使在仅通过单个共享顶点相交的环（即路宽为2、线性反馈顶点集大小为1的图）以及树深度最多为6的图中，它仍然是NP-hard的 [Egami et al.; MFCS '25]。顶点覆盖数、顶点完整性和到团距离是少数几个使电话广播成为固定参数可解（FPT）的参数。目前已有针对顶点覆盖数 $\mathrm{vc}$ 的 $2^{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{vc}^3)} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$ 时间算法 [Fomin, Fraigniaud, Golovach; TCS '24]，针对顶点完整性 $\mathrm{vi}$ 的双指数算法，以及针对到团距离 $k$ 的 $2^{\mathcal{O}(k^2)} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$ 时间算法 [Egami et al.; MFCS '25]。在本文中，我们给出了电话广播问题的改进参数化算法，运行时间分别为 $2^{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{vc} \log \mathrm{vc})} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$、$2^{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{vi}^2 \log \mathrm{vi})} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$ 和 $2^{\mathcal{O}(k \log k)} n^{\mathcal{O}(1)}$。使我们的算法更快的关键在于向带权边 $b$-匹配的Turing归约。
AI.summary: 本文研究了Telephone Broadcast问题的参数化复杂度，针对顶点覆盖数、顶点完整性和到团距离等参数，提出了改进的算法，显著降低了其时间复杂度。核心思路是将该问题归约为带权边的b-匹配问题。
AI.keywords: Telephone Broadcast, 参数化算法, 顶点覆盖数, b-匹配, 计算复杂度
AI.comments: 该论文通过创新的归约方法，显著优化了Telephone Broadcast问题的参数化算法复杂度，将指数部分从之前的多项式级降低到了拟线性级，是该领域的重要进展。

title: On the structure of constacyclic codes over finite chain rings
summary: In the present paper, we provide an explicit construction for generators of a $λ$-constacyclic code $\mathcal{C}$ of arbitrary length $\ell$ over a finite chain ring(FCR) $\mathcal{R}$ in terms of certain minimum degree polynomials of the ring $\mathcal{R}[x]/ \langle x^{\ell}-λ\rangle$. Moreover, the proposed construction achieves the minimum possible number of generators. We prove certain properties of this set of generators, using which we obtain a minimal spanning set of $\mathcal{C}$. We also obtain that the rank of $\mathcal{C}$ is $\ell-n_0$, where $n_0$ is the degree of the minimal degree polynomial in $\mathcal{C}$. Finally, we derive necessary and sufficient conditions under which an arbitrary length $λ$-constacyclic code $\mathcal{C}$ over $\mathcal{R}$ is Maximum Hamming Distance with respect to Rank(MHDR) as well as Maximum Distance Separable(MDS) in terms of a torsion code of $\mathcal{C}$ over the residue field $\mathbb{F}_q$ of $\mathcal{R}$. We further determine the exact values for $n_0$ for which $\mathcal{C}$ over $\mathcal{R}$ is MHDR.

AI.title_translation: 关于有限链环上常循环码的结构研究
AI.tldr: 本文提出了有限链环上任意长度常循环码的一种极小生成元构造方法，并给出了判定其距离特性（MHDR和MDS）的充要条件。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决有限链环上任意长度λ-常循环码的结构描述问题，特别是寻求生成元数量的极小化及相关距离特性的判定准则。
AI.method: 通过在商环 R[x]/⟨x^ℓ-λ⟩ 中利用最小度多项式来构建λ-常循环码的生成元，并利用这些生成元性质推导出最小生成集和码的秩。
AI.result: 给出了λ-常循环码的显式生成元构造，证明了生成元数量达到极小；确定了码的秩为ℓ-n0；给出了码成为MHDR和MDS的充要条件，并明确了MHDR码的n0具体取值。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功构建了有限链环上任意长度λ-常循环码的极小生成元集，并确定了该类码成为MHDR和MDS码的充要条件，完善了该领域的相关理论框架。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们针对有限链环（FCR）$\mathcal{R}$ 上任意长度 $\ell$ 的 $\lambda$-常循环码 $\mathcal{C}$，利用环 $\mathcal{R}[x]/ \langle x^{\ell}-\lambda\rangle$ 中的特定最小度多项式，提供了一种显式的生成元构造方法。此外，所提出的构造实现了最少的生成元数量。我们证明了该生成元集合的某些性质，并由此获得了 $\mathcal{C}$ 的最小生成集。我们还得出 $\mathcal{C}$ 的秩为 $\ell-n_0$，其中 $n_0$ 是 $\mathcal{C}$ 中最小度多项式的次数。最后，我们根据 $\mathcal{C}$ 在 $\mathcal{R}$ 的剩余域 $\mathbb{F}_q$ 上的挠码（torsion code），推导了任意长度 $\lambda$-常循环码 $\mathcal{C}$ 成为最大汉明距离秩码（MHDR）以及最大距离可分码（MDS）的充要条件。我们进一步确定了使 $\mathcal{C}$ 在 $\mathcal{R}$ 上成为 MHDR 的 $n_0$ 的确切值。
AI.summary: 本文研究了有限链环上任意长度λ-常循环码的结构，提出了一种利用商环中最小度多项式构造极小生成元集的方法，并分析了该类码的秩及其成为MHDR和MDS码的条件。
AI.keywords: 常循环码, 有限链环, 极小生成元, MHDR码, MDS码
AI.comments: 该论文在有限链环上对常循环码的生成元结构进行了深入的代数刻画，特别是通过最小度多项式实现了生成元数量的极小化。其理论结果对于理解有限链环上的纠错码结构具有重要意义，并为判断码的MHDR和MDS性质提供了明确的充要条件。

title: LLM-Empowered Multimodal Fusion Framework for Autonomous Driving: Semantic Enhancement and Channel-Adaptive Design
comments: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted by 2026 IEEE 37th International Symposium on Personal, Indoor and Mobile Radio Communications (PIMRC)
summary: Vision-radar fusion is central to robust autonomous driving, combining dense visual semantics with precise range and velocity measurements from radar. However, real-world fusion quality is fundamentally challenged by dynamically varying input quality, stemming from occlusion, adverse weather, and channel noise. To address this, we re-frame the problem from static data fusion to channel-aware semantic reasoning and propose a Large Language Model-centric Semantic-layer Channel-aware Integrated Perception (LM-SCIP) framework. It places a Large Language Model (LLM) as a central reasoning core to fuse a local visual stream with a quality-varying external radar stream used to cover perception-blind spots. Concretely, LM-SCIP couples a hierarchical radar-vision encoder with a Channel-Adaptive Semantic Module (CASM) that maps link indicators into a "Channel Prompt" to dynamically gate external radar features. A parameter-efficient, LoRA-tuned LLM, in conjunction with a heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts (H-MoE), then arbitrates between local visual cues and the channel-conditioned radar context. Finally, a decoupled multi-task decoder outputs localization, trajectory forecasting, and image reconstruction. Experiments on nuScenes and VIRAT validate our approach. On nuScenes, under a controlled toggle of radar input, LM-SCIP reduces localization RMSE by 40.0% versus a vision-only baseline. On VIRAT, the model attains a 0.214m localization RMSE and 0.179m minFDE (k=1). These results reveal that the proposed LM-SCIP enables a robust vision-dominant fallback at low SNR and synergistic fusion at high SNR.
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted by 2026 IEEE 37th International Symposium on Personal, Indoor and Mobile Radio Communications (PIMRC)

AI.title_translation: 面向自动驾驶的LLM赋能多模态融合框架：语义增强与通道自适应设计
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于大语言模型的自动驾驶感知框架LM-SCIP，通过动态通道自适应技术，有效解决了视觉与雷达在恶劣环境下的融合难题，显著提升了定位与预测精度。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的自动驾驶场景中，遮挡、恶劣天气和噪声会导致视觉与雷达传感器的输入质量动态变化，传统的静态融合方法难以应对这些不确定性。
AI.method: 提出了LM-SCIP框架，包含：1. 分层雷达-视觉编码器；2. 通道自适应语义模块（CASM），将链路指标映射为“通道提示”；3. 基于LoRA微调的LLM与异构专家混合模型（H-MoE）进行特征仲裁；4. 解耦多任务解码器用于定位与预测。
AI.result: 在nuScenes数据集上，相比纯视觉基线，定位RMSE降低了40.0%；在VIRAT数据集上，实现了0.214m的定位RMSE和0.179m的minFDE。
AI.conclusion: LM-SCIP 框架成功实现了基于LLM的感知增强，通过动态通道适应设计，显著提升了自动驾驶在复杂环境下的定位与轨迹预测精度，验证了LLM在处理多传感器异构数据融合中的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 视觉-雷达融合对于稳健的自动驾驶至关重要，它结合了密集的视觉语义与雷达精准的距离和速度测量。然而，现实世界的融合质量受到遮挡、恶劣天气和通道噪声等动态变化输入质量的严峻挑战。为解决这一问题，我们将该问题从静态数据融合重新定义为通道感知的语义推理，并提出了大语言模型中心化的语义层通道感知集成感知（LM-SCIP）框架。该框架以大语言模型（LLM）为核心推理单元，融合本地视觉流与用于覆盖感知盲区的质量变化的外部雷达流。具体而言，LM-SCIP结合了分层雷达-视觉编码器与通道自适应语义模块（CASM），将链路指标映射为“通道提示”以动态门控外部雷达特征。随后，一个经过LoRA调优的参数高效LLM与异构专家混合模型（H-MoE）协同工作，在本地视觉线索与通道条件下的雷达上下文之间进行仲裁。最后，解耦的多任务解码器输出定位、轨迹预测和图像重建结果。在nuScenes和VIRAT数据集上的实验验证了我们的方法。在nuScenes上，通过受控的雷达输入切换，LM-SCIP将定位RMSE比纯视觉基线降低了40.0%。在VIRAT上，该模型达到了0.214米的定位RMSE和0.179米的minFDE（k=1）。这些结果表明，所提出的LM-SCIP在低信噪比下实现了稳健的视觉主导回退，并在高信噪比下实现了协同融合。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为LM-SCIP的框架，利用大语言模型作为核心，通过通道自适应机制动态融合视觉与雷达数据。该方法能根据输入信号质量动态调节模态权重，在各种复杂环境下均能提供稳健的感知与预测性能。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 多模态融合, 大语言模型, 语义增强, 通道自适应
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于引入大语言模型（LLM）作为感知决策的核心，将传统的静态多模态融合问题转化为动态的语义推理问题。通过引入通道提示（Channel Prompt）和异构专家混合模型（H-MoE），该框架能根据环境质量动态调整雷达与视觉数据的权重，在恶劣天气或噪声干扰下表现出极强的鲁棒性。其局限性可能在于引入LLM带来的计算开销，以及在实时性要求极高的自动驾驶场景下的推理延迟。

title: Verifiable Knowledge Expansion through Retrieval-Grounded Formal Concept Analysis
comments: 8 pages, 2 figures, Accepted to the 8th epiDAMIK ACM SIGKDD International Workshop on Epidemiology meets Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery (epiDAMIK 2026)
summary: Ontology construction requires deciding which objects, attributes, and structural relations should be accepted as valid knowledge. Language models can propose such structures from text, but their outputs can still be unsupported or inconsistent. This paper proposes a retrieval-augmented small language model (SLM) framework that uses formal concept analysis (FCA) as a symbolic verification loop for knowledge expansion. Starting from seed attributes, FCA proposes implications over a growing formal context. A retrieval-grounded SLM oracle then validates each implication or returns a counterexample. The oracle also supports incidence judgments, consistency checks, and attribute proposals, making accepted implications, counterexamples, contradictions, and corrections inspectable. In a rare ataxia setting constructed from Orphadata resources, retrieval-grounded 10-seed runs obtain relation F1 of 0.29-0.52 and closure-based implication F1 of 0.22-0.30. Larger seed sets increase the number of evaluated implications and often improve implication F1. The lower implication scores reflect a stricter evaluation of derived implications, where one missed or extra relation can affect several implication judgments. Ablations show that incidence judgments in a fixed object-attribute setting can improve closure-based implication scores. However, identifying positive object-attribute pairs remains difficult even when the candidate objects and attributes are fixed.
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, Accepted to the 8th epiDAMIK ACM SIGKDD International Workshop on Epidemiology meets Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery (epiDAMIK 2026)

AI.title_translation: 通过检索基础形式概念分析实现可验证的知识扩展
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合FCA与检索增强语言模型的方法，通过符号逻辑循环验证模型生成的知识，从而提高本体构建的准确性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 本体构建过程中，语言模型生成的知识结构往往缺乏支持或存在不一致性，需要一种可验证、可审计的方法来确保知识的严谨性。
AI.method: 提出了一种检索增强小语言模型（SLM）框架，利用形式概念分析（FCA）构建符号验证循环。该方法从种子属性出发生成蕴含关系，并由SLM预言机进行验证或提供反例，同时支持一致性检查和属性建议。
AI.result: 在罕见共济失调数据集上的实验显示，该方法在关系F1上达到0.29-0.52，在基于闭包的蕴含F1上达到0.22-0.30。实验表明增加种子集规模有助于提升评估蕴含的数量和效果，但识别正向对象-属性对依然困难。
AI.conclusion: 通过将形式概念分析与检索增强小语言模型相结合，该框架实现了知识扩展过程的可验证性和可解释性，尽管在复杂关系推理和属性识别上仍有改进空间。
AI.translation: 本体构建需要确定哪些对象、属性和结构关系应被接受为有效知识。语言模型可以从文本中提出此类结构，但其输出仍可能缺乏支持或存在不一致。本文提出了一种检索增强小语言模型（SLM）框架，使用形式概念分析（FCA）作为知识扩展的符号验证循环。从种子属性开始，FCA在不断增长的形式背景上提出蕴含关系。检索基础的SLM预言机随后验证每个蕴含或返回反例。该预言机还支持关联判断、一致性检查和属性建议，使得被接受的蕴含、反例、矛盾和修正均可审查。在利用Orphadata资源构建的罕见共济失调设置中，检索基础的10种子运行获得了0.29-0.52的关系F1和0.22-0.30的基于闭包的蕴含F1。较大的种子集增加了评估蕴含的数量，并通常提高了蕴含F1。较低的蕴含分数反映了对推导出的蕴含的严格评估，其中一个遗漏或额外的关系可能会影响多个蕴含判断。消融研究表明，在固定对象-属性设置中的关联判断可以提高基于闭包的蕴含分数。然而，即使在候选对象和属性固定的情况下，识别正向的对象-属性对仍然很困难。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合检索增强小语言模型与形式概念分析的框架，旨在通过符号逻辑验证循环解决本体构建中模型输出的不可靠问题。该框架通过FCA生成逻辑蕴含，并利用SLM预言机进行验证，实现了知识扩展的可解释与可验证。实验证明了该方法在特定领域知识提取中的有效性，同时也指出了在属性识别任务上的局限性。
AI.keywords: 本体构建, 形式概念分析, 检索增强语言模型, 可验证知识扩展, 知识图谱
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地结合了符号AI（形式概念分析）与神经符号方法（检索增强小语言模型），为本体构建提供了一种可验证的自动化路径。其核心创新在于将FCA作为逻辑验证循环，有效缓解了大型模型在知识构建中常见的不可靠和不一致问题。局限性在于在识别正向对象-属性对方面仍面临挑战，且评价指标对错误较为敏感。

title: Subliminal Clocks: Latent Time Modelling in Diffusion Language Models
comments: Equal contribution: Thomas Fontanari and Simone Petruzzi
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive models. Unlike standard diffusion-based approaches, DLMs are not explicitly conditioned on a timestep, raising a natural question: do these models internally represent denoising progress, and how is such information used downstream? In this work, we show that DLMs do in fact encode a latent representation related to the diffusion timestep within their residual streams. We find that this signal can be reliably extracted using probes across layers, indicating that denoising progress is decodable from internal activations. We further demonstrate that steering the model along a low-dimensional subspace associated with the inferred timestep allows us to systematically modulate its notion of denoising progress, leading to predictable changes in model confidence and entropy. Finally, we analyse the geometry of the identified representation, showing that it exhibits structured and interpretable properties in activation space, and shedding light on how such a signal is processed by these models.
comment: Equal contribution: Thomas Fontanari and Simone Petruzzi

AI.title_translation: 潜意识时钟：扩散语言模型中的潜时间建模
AI.tldr: 扩散语言模型内部隐式编码了去噪进度，通过操纵这一“潜时间”信号，可以系统地控制模型的生成置信度。
AI.motivation: 由于扩散语言模型（DLMs）在训练中并不显式依赖时间步，研究者试图探究模型内部是否隐式地表示了去噪进度，以及这种信息如何影响下游任务。
AI.method: 利用探针技术（probes）从DLM的残差流中提取与去噪进度相关的潜表征；通过在低维子空间中对该信号进行操纵（steering），观察模型输出置信度和熵的变化；分析该表征的几何结构。
AI.result: 研究发现DLM在残差流中编码了与去噪进度相关的潜表征；成功实现了通过操纵该表征来系统性调节模型输出的置信度和熵；揭示了该潜表征在激活空间中具有结构化和可解释的几何特性。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实扩散语言模型在内部隐式编码了去噪进度（潜时间），且该信号可被提取和操纵，从而为理解和控制DLM的生成行为提供了新途径。
AI.translation: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）最近已成为自回归模型的一种有前途的替代方案。与标准的基于扩散的方法不同，DLMs并不显式地以时间步为条件，这引发了一个自然的问题：这些模型是否在内部表示了去噪进度，以及这种信息如何在下游被使用？在这项工作中，我们证明了DLMs确实在其残差流中编码了与扩散时间步相关的潜表征。我们发现，该信号可以通过跨层的探针可靠地提取，这表明去噪进度可以从内部激活中解码出来。我们进一步证明，沿着与推断出的时间步相关的低维子空间引导模型，使我们能够系统地调节其对去噪进度的感知，从而导致模型置信度和熵的预测性变化。最后，我们分析了所识别表征的几何结构，表明它在激活空间中表现出结构化和可解释的属性，并阐明了这些模型如何处理此类信号。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了扩散语言模型（DLM）内部对去噪进度的隐式编码。研究发现，尽管DLM缺乏显式的时间步条件，但其残差流中仍包含可提取的“潜时间”信号。通过操纵该信号，研究者能够系统地调节模型的生成行为，并揭示了该表征在激活空间中的结构化特性。
AI.keywords: 扩散语言模型, 潜时间建模, 可解释性, 模型操纵, 去噪进度
AI.comments: 该研究通过可解释性技术揭示了扩散语言模型（DLM）内部隐藏的时间维度，为理解此类模型的黑盒机制提供了重要视角。其创新点在于证明了模型在无显式时间步条件的情况下，仍能自发形成“潜时间”概念，并能通过操纵该维度来控制模型输出的置信度。

title: Set Diffusion: Interpolating Token Orderings Between Autoregression and Diffusion for Fast and Flexible Decoding
comments: ICML 2026. We provide the code at https://github.com/kuleshov-group/setdlms
summary: Discrete diffusion models have steadily improved in quality relative to autoregressive (AR) models. However, these models are normally constrained to fixed-length generation and do not support key-value (KV) caching. Block diffusion partially bridges diffusion and AR by generating token blocks left-to-right, but its fixed-size sequential blocks limit decoding flexibility and parallelism. Here, we present a new class of language models, set diffusion, comprised of (i) a likelihood parameterization that factorizes over flexible-position, flexible-length token sets and (ii) a set-causal diffusion architecture that supports KV cache updates after every inference step. By factorizing over token sets instead of fixed-size blocks, tokens can be decoded in arbitrarily-ordered sets, including sliding-window sets, enabling faster inference and support for any-order decoding. Set diffusion achieves better speed-quality tradeoffs on mathematical reasoning, summarization, and unconditional generation compared to prior diffusion language models while offering stronger infilling performance than block diffusion. We provide the code, along with the model weights and blog post on the project page: https://m-arriola.com/setdlms/
comment: ICML 2026. We provide the code at https://github.com/kuleshov-group/setdlms

title: AI Virtue: What is "Good" Knowledge in the Age of Artificial Intelligence?
summary: In the age of AI, what will be good knowledge? This article, which is accepted and forthcoming in a special issue of Modern Fiction Studies on "Cultural AI" in 2027, applies digital humanities methods to map epistemic virtues (like "true," "accurate," "creative") used in a corpus of 553 journal articles on AI published in 2024. "Creativity" comes in for special attention as an example. Exploring this discourse of value, the article considers how a framework might be developed for evaluating the knowledge-worth of AI -- one less locked into values formed around pre-AI "knowledge work" agents or structures, and more open to the future values of "generativity." The essay is supported by an online digital kit for exploring data models of the corpus of articles on AI it studies.

AI.title_translation: AI美德：人工智能时代的“良知”是什么？
AI.tldr: 本文利用数字人文方法分析了AI时代的知识价值，主张抛弃旧有的知识评价标准，转向以“生成性”为核心的未来评估框架。
AI.motivation: 在人工智能时代，传统的知识定义与价值评估标准受到挑战，作者旨在探索什么是AI时代的“良知”，并建立一套不局限于前AI时代知识工作结构的评估框架。
AI.method: 应用数字人文方法，对2024年发表的553篇关于AI的期刊文章语料库进行分析，重点映射其中的“认知美德”（如“真实”、“准确”、“创造力”），并配套开发了在线数字工具包。
AI.result: 研究发现“创造力”在当前AI话语中受到特别关注；作者建议构建一种更开放、更关注未来“生成性”价值的知识评估体系。
AI.conclusion: AI时代的知识评估需要超越传统的知识工作框架，转向一种更具前瞻性的、以“生成性”为核心的价值体系。
AI.translation: 在人工智能时代，什么是好的知识？本文将于2027年收录于《现代小说研究》关于“文化AI”的特刊中。文章运用数字人文方法，对2024年发表的553篇关于AI的期刊文章语料库中使用的认知美德（如“真实”、“准确”、“创造力”）进行了映射。其中，“创造力”被作为案例重点关注。通过探讨这种价值话语，本文思考了如何建立一套评估AI知识价值的框架——这一框架应减少对前AI时代“知识工作”代理或结构的依赖，并更加开放地接纳未来“生成性”的价值。该论文配套有一个在线数字工具包，用于探索研究中所使用的文章语料库数据模型。
AI.summary: 本文通过数字人文手段分析了2024年AI相关文献中的认知美德，探讨了AI时代知识价值的重构。文章指出应摆脱传统知识工作模式的束缚，建立一套以“生成性”为核心的评估框架，以适应人工智能带来的变革。
AI.keywords: 人工智能, 认知美德, 数字人文, 知识价值, 生成性
AI.comments: 该论文通过数字人文方法对AI时代的知识价值进行了批判性分析，创新性地将“认知美德”作为评估AI知识贡献的框架。其重要意义在于挑战了传统的“知识工作”定义，提出了一种面向未来的“生成性”价值评估视角。局限性在于研究样本仅局限于2024年发表的553篇期刊文章，可能无法完全涵盖AI领域快速演变的多元话语。

title: SpaceEra++: A Unified Framework Towards 3D Spatial Reasoning in Video
summary: Visual-spatial understanding, defined as the ability to infer object relationships and scene layouts from visual inputs, is fundamental to downstream tasks such as robotic navigation and embodied interaction. However, pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) remain constrained by spatial uncertainty stemming from inherently 2D observations and by the scarcity of data for 3D spatial understanding. To address these limitations, we proposed a novel framework, SpaceEra, in the NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight paper. Although it achieved significant performance gains, we further observed that its effectiveness is hindered by insufficient input from scanning videos and weak reasoning constraints. To tackle these newly emerged challenges, we extend the original framework into a comprehensive system, termed SpaceEra++, which spans data construction, model design, training optimization, and prompting inference. Specifically, to alleviate input insufficiency, we introduce ScenePick, a frame sampling strategy that balances spatial coverage with object semantics to produce compact yet comprehensive scene representations. In addition, to enhance spatial reasoning, we develop SpaceAlign, which enforces pairwise object constraints by jointly exploiting absolute coordinates and relative spatial relations, thereby aligning optimization with spatial accuracy. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines, while ablation studies validate both the individual and joint contributions of each component, and further analyses provide guidance for future research.

AI.title_translation: SpaceEra++：一种迈向视频中3D空间推理的统一框架
AI.tldr: 针对现有视觉语言模型在3D空间推理中的不足，SpaceEra++通过创新的采样策略和空间对齐约束，实现了更精准的视频场景理解。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型受限于2D观测带来的空间不确定性及3D数据匮乏，且前作SpaceEra在处理扫描视频输入和推理约束方面仍存在不足。
AI.method: 提出SpaceEra++框架，包含：1. ScenePick采样策略，平衡空间覆盖与语义信息；2. SpaceAlign对齐机制，通过联合利用绝对坐标和相对关系实施配对对象约束。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中表现优于强基线模型，消融实验证明了各组件的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SpaceEra++通过改进视频采样和引入空间对齐约束，显著提升了模型在视频中的3D空间推理能力，在多个基准测试中表现优异。
AI.translation: 视觉-空间理解（即从视觉输入中推断物体关系和场景布局的能力）是机器人导航和具身交互等下游任务的基础。然而，预训练的视觉语言模型（VLMs）仍受到源于固有2D观测的空间不确定性以及3D空间理解数据匮乏的限制。为了解决这些局限性，我们在NeurIPS 2025的Spotlight论文中提出了一个名为SpaceEra的新框架。尽管它取得了显著的性能提升，但我们进一步观察到其有效性受到扫描视频输入不足和推理约束薄弱的阻碍。为了应对这些新出现的挑战，我们将原始框架扩展为一个名为SpaceEra++的综合系统，涵盖数据构建、模型设计、训练优化和提示推理。具体而言，为了缓解输入不足，我们引入了ScenePick，这是一种平衡空间覆盖率与对象语义的帧采样策略，以生成紧凑而全面的场景表示。此外，为了增强空间推理，我们开发了SpaceAlign，它通过联合利用绝对坐标和相对空间关系来强制执行成对对象约束，从而使优化与空间准确性保持一致。在多个基准测试上的广泛实验证明了相对于强基线模型的一致性改进，同时消融研究验证了每个组件的单独和联合贡献，进一步的分析为未来的研究提供了指导。
AI.summary: SpaceEra++是一个针对视频中3D空间推理的统一框架，旨在解决现有模型输入信息受限及推理约束不足的问题。该系统通过引入ScenePick采样策略优化场景表示，并利用SpaceAlign机制强化对象间的空间约束，从而提升模型在复杂场景下的空间理解能力。
AI.keywords: 3D空间推理, 视觉语言模型, 视频理解, 具身智能, 场景表示
AI.comments: 该研究通过提出SpaceEra++，有效解决了预训练视觉语言模型在处理3D空间推理时面临的输入不足和推理约束弱的问题。其核心创新在于提出了ScenePick采样策略和SpaceAlign对齐机制，这种从数据构建到模型推理的全流程优化方案，为具身智能领域提供了重要的技术参考。

title: EHHN: An Event-driven Heterogeneous Hypergraph Network for Object-Centric Next Activity Prediction
summary: Next activity prediction helps service-oriented processes anticipate upcoming steps before delays, exceptions, or service-level risks occur. Most existing methods assume classical single-case event logs, whereas real service processes often involve events shared by multiple typed business objects. Object-centric event logs (OCELs) capture such interactions, but current predictors remain limited. Flattening-based approaches lose cross-object context, and native OCEL graph-based approaches encode multi-object events through pairwise relations. Existing models also do not jointly capture event-driven object state changes, inter-event timing, and global execution patterns. We propose EHHN, an Event-driven Heterogeneous Hypergraph Network for object-centric next activity prediction. EHHN represents each prediction prefix as a heterogeneous hypergraph, where event--object hyperedges bind retained co-participating objects and a lifecycle hyperedge groups the primary object's observed lifecycle events. Based on this representation, EHHN uses a dual-stream architecture in which a micro-spatial stream models event-driven object-state evolution and a macro-evolution stream captures temporal dynamics using retrieved global prototypes. The two streams are fused to predict the next activity. Experiments on four public OCEL benchmarks against nine baselines show that EHHN achieves the best accuracy and macro F1-score on all datasets, with improvements of up to 8.1 and 12.4 percentage points over the strongest baselines. Compared with the strongest OCEL-native graph baseline, EHHN also reduces peak GPU memory by up to 24 times. Code is available at https://github.com/chenkaitao1112/EHHN.

AI.title_translation: EHHN：一种用于以对象为中心的下一活动预测的事件驱动异构超图网络
AI.tldr: EHHN 引入异构超图和双流架构，有效解决了对象中心事件日志中的复杂交互建模问题，在提升预测精度的同时大幅降低了显存需求。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在处理对象中心事件日志时，要么丢失跨对象上下文，要么仅局限于成对关系建模，且未能同时捕获事件驱动的状态变化、事件间时序和全局执行模式。
AI.method: 提出了 EHHN 模型，采用异构超图表示法（将事件-对象关联和对象生命周期建模为超边），并结合双流架构：微观空间流用于建模事件驱动的对象状态演变，宏观演变流用于通过全局原型捕捉时间动态。
AI.result: 在四个公开 OCEL 基准测试中，EHHN 在准确率和宏观 F1 值上均达到最优，相较于最强基准分别提升了 8.1 和 12.4 个百分点，并将峰值 GPU 显存占用降低了 24 倍。
AI.conclusion: EHHN 是一种高效的对象中心下一活动预测模型，通过异构超图表示和双流架构，在准确性和计算效率上均优于现有的基准模型。
AI.translation: 下一活动预测有助于面向服务的流程在延迟、异常或服务水平风险发生之前预测即将到来的步骤。大多数现有方法假设是经典的单案例事件日志，而实际的服务流程通常涉及由多种类型的业务对象共享的事件。对象中心事件日志 (OCEL) 捕获了这些交互，但当前的预测器仍然受到限制。基于平铺的方法丢失了跨对象上下文，而原生的基于 OCEL 图的方法通过成对关系对多对象事件进行编码。现有模型也无法联合捕获事件驱动的对象状态变化、事件间计时和全局执行模式。我们提出了 EHHN，一种用于对象中心下一活动预测的事件驱动异构超图网络。EHHN 将每个预测前缀表示为异构超图，其中事件-对象超边绑定了保留的共同参与对象，生命周期超边对主要对象观察到的生命周期事件进行分组。基于这种表示，EHHN 使用双流架构，其中微观空间流模拟事件驱动的对象状态演变，宏观演变流使用检索到的全局原型捕获时间动态。这两个流被融合以预测下一个活动。在四个公共 OCEL 基准测试上针对九个基准进行的实验表明，EHHN 在所有数据集上都达到了最佳的准确性和宏观 F1 分数，比最强的基准提高了 8.1 和 12.4 个百分点。与最强的 OCEL 原生图基准相比，EHHN 还将峰值 GPU 内存减少了 24 倍。代码可在 https://github.com/chenkaitao1112/EHHN 获取。
AI.summary: EHHN 是一种用于对象中心下一活动预测的异构超图网络。它通过构建异构超图来捕捉复杂的对象交互，并利用双流架构融合微观对象状态演变和宏观时间动态，在保证高性能预测的同时显著提升了计算效率。
AI.keywords: 下一活动预测, 对象中心事件日志, 异构超图网络, 事件驱动, 过程挖掘
AI.comments: 该研究通过超图建模成功解决了对象中心事件日志（OCEL）中多对象交互信息的复杂性问题。其创新之处在于利用双流架构同时捕捉微观的对象状态演变和宏观的时间动态，在提升预测准确率的同时显著降低了显存消耗，具有很高的实用价值。

title: KRCA: An Efficient Root Cause Analysis System in Hyper-Scale Microservice Systems via Agentic AI
summary: Hyper-scale microservice systems have become the standard infrastructure for large-scale Internet companies. These systems consist of numerous loosely coupled microservices that evolve independently through continuous development and deployment. Such complexity makes failures unavoidable, necessitating efficient Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to help Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) quickly localize root cause services and classify failure types. However, existing RCA methods often struggle to adapt to the extreme dynamism and massive scale of these systems. In this paper, we present KRCA, an end-to-end RCA system designed for hyper-scale microservice systems. To manage the vast search space, KRCA employs a multi-stage pipeline that begins with an API-level drilldown to isolate suspicious services. It then instantiates a skeleton-based causal graph from anomalous metrics to serve as a high-recall structural prior, before utilizing a memory-augmented multi-agent framework to verify causality and generate the final failure report. By combining structured causal constraints with multi-agent reasoning, KRCA employs balances diagnostic accuracy with the efficiency requirements of real-time production use. Experimental results show that KRCA achieves AC@1 scores of 0.88 and 0.79 for root cause service localization and failure type classification, outperforming the strongest baseline by at lease 31% in absolute gains. KRCA has been deployed in Kuaishou's production environment for over six months, reducing the average diagnosis time by 77.3%.

title: EPnG: Adaptive Expert Prune-and-Grow for Parameter-Efficient MoE Fine-tuning
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale efficiently but remain costly to adapt due to redundant experts and uniform parameter allocation. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods such as LoRA ignore MoE routing dynamics, leading to suboptimal resource use. We propose EPnG, an adaptive prune-and-grow framework that reallocates LoRA capacity based on expert importance derived from router gate probabilities. EPnG prunes under-utilized experts and expands high-importance experts via rank growth with orthogonal initialization, while maintaining a fixed parameter budget. Across OLMoE and Qwen1.5-MoE, EPnG consistently outperforms LoRA under the same budget and achieves performance comparable to full fine-tuning while updating only 0.55%-0.72% of parameters (up to 140x-180x fewer). These results demonstrate that aligning PEFT with MoE routing yields a more effective and scalable fine-tuning strategy.

AI.title_translation: EPnG：面向参数高效MoE微调的自适应专家剪枝与增长策略
AI.tldr: EPnG通过动态调整MoE模型中各专家的LoRA容量，以极小的参数更新比例实现了优于传统LoRA的微调效果。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法（如LoRA）忽视了MoE模型的路由动态，导致资源分配不均和冗余专家问题，限制了模型微调的效率。
AI.method: 提出EPnG框架，基于路由门控概率评估专家重要性；通过剪枝低利用率专家并利用正交初始化对高重要性专家进行秩增长，从而在保持固定参数预算的前提下重新分配LoRA容量。
AI.result: 在OLMoE和Qwen1.5-MoE模型上，EPnG在相同预算下表现优于LoRA，且仅更新0.55%-0.72%的参数即可达到接近全参数微调的效果。
AI.conclusion: 将PEFT策略与MoE的路由动态对齐，能够显著提升模型微调的效率与效果，在固定参数预算下实现了优于传统LoRA的性能。
AI.translation: 混合专家（MoE）模型虽然扩展效率高，但由于专家冗余和参数分配不均，导致其微调成本依然昂贵。现有的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法（如LoRA）忽视了MoE的路由动态，导致资源利用次优。我们提出了EPnG，一种自适应的剪枝与增长框架，它根据由路由门控概率导出的专家重要性来重新分配LoRA容量。EPnG在保持固定参数预算的同时，剪枝利用率低的专家，并通过正交初始化的秩增长来扩展高重要性专家。在OLMoE和Qwen1.5-MoE上的实验表明，EPnG在相同预算下表现优于LoRA，并以仅更新0.55%-0.72%参数（减少了140倍至180倍）的代价，达到了与全参数微调相当的性能。这些结果证明，将PEFT与MoE路由对齐可产生更有效且可扩展的微调策略。
AI.summary: EPnG是一种针对混合专家（MoE）模型的自适应剪枝与增长微调框架，通过根据路由概率动态调整LoRA容量，实现了参数的高效利用与性能优化。
AI.keywords: 混合专家模型, 参数高效微调, 剪枝与增长, 路由动态, LoRA
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将MoE架构的路由动态与参数高效微调（PEFT）相结合，通过动态调整专家容量实现了资源的高效分配，在大幅减少训练参数的同时保持了极高的性能，为大规模MoE模型的微调提供了一种极具潜力的优化思路。

title: PARTREP: Learning What to Repeat for Decoder-only LLMs
summary: While decoder-only LLMs excel at a vast array of natural language tasks, it suffers from an asymmetric information flow induced by causal attention: later tokens are richer in contextual grounding than earlier ones. A simple and effective remedy is prompt repetition -- just appending a second copy of prompt before generation can redistribute grounding across positions and improve reasoning performance. However, full repetition of the original prompt doubles the KV cache footprint and quadruples attention cost during prefill, making it impractical for long-context settings. We propose PartRep, a selective augmentation method that appends only the most informative tokens -- rather than the entire prompt. We use token-wise negative log-likelihood (NLL) as a selection signal, motivated by the hypothesis that less predictable tokens are less recoverable from surrounding context and therefore benefit more from late-position repetition. To avoid the heavy cost of a full forward pass for scoring, we train a lightweight gate that predicts high-NLL tokens from early-layer hidden states, enabling token selection during mid-prefill via early exit. Across eight benchmarks (including MMLU, GSM8K, and RULER) and three model families (Qwen2.5, Llama3.2, Gemma4), PartRep retains most of the gains of full repetition while using only 59.4\% of its KV cache and 79.0\% of its prefill FLOPs.

AI.title_translation: PARTREP：学习解码器模型中哪些内容需要重复
AI.tldr: 通过选择性重复提示词中最关键的 token 而非全部，PartRep 在大幅降低计算和内存成本的同时，保持了模型优异的推理性能。
AI.motivation: 解码器模型因因果注意力机制导致信息流不对称，后续 token 的语境基础比早期 token 更丰富。虽然重复整个提示词能提升推理性能，但会导致 KV 缓存和注意力计算成本翻倍，在长上下文场景下不可行。
AI.method: 提出 PartRep 方法，通过计算 token 级负对数似然（NLL）来筛选最具信息量的 token 进行重复。为了降低计算开销，训练了一个轻量级门控网络，利用早期隐藏层状态预测高 NLL token，从而实现预填充阶段的快速选择。
AI.result: 在八个基准测试和三个模型系列上测试表明，PartRep 在仅使用全提示词重复 59.4% 的 KV 缓存和 79.0% 的预填充计算量的情况下，保留了大部分性能增益。
AI.conclusion: PartRep 是一种高效的提示词增强方法，通过选择性重复高信息量 token，在显著节省计算和内存资源的同时，保留了全提示词重复带来的推理性能增益。
AI.translation: 尽管解码器模型在各种自然语言任务中表现出色，但由于因果注意力的影响，它们存在信息流不对称的问题：后续 token 比早期 token 具有更丰富的语境基础。一种简单有效的补救措施是提示词重复——在生成前简单地附加第二份提示词副本，可以重新分配语境基础并提高推理性能。然而，完整重复原始提示词会使 KV 缓存占用翻倍，并在预填充阶段使注意力计算成本增加四倍，这使其在长上下文设置中变得不切实际。我们提出了 PartRep，这是一种选择性增强方法，只附加最具信息量的 token，而不是整个提示词。我们使用 token 级的负对数似然（NLL）作为选择信号，其动机是假设不可预测性较高的 token 更难从周围语境中恢复，因此从后期位置的重复中受益更多。为了避免全前向传播评分带来的沉重代价，我们训练了一个轻量级门控网络，从早期层隐藏状态预测高 NLL token，从而通过提前退出在预填充阶段实现 token 选择。在八个基准测试（包括 MMLU、GSM8K 和 RULER）和三个模型系列（Qwen2.5、Llama3.2、Gemma4）中，PartRep 在仅使用其 59.4% 的 KV 缓存和 79.0% 的预填充 FLOPs 的情况下，保留了全重复带来的大部分收益。
AI.summary: 论文提出了 PartRep 方法，旨在解决解码器模型在重复提示词时带来的高昂计算和内存开销问题。通过利用轻量级门控模型选择并重复提示词中的关键 token，该方法在显著提升推理性能的同时，有效地平衡了 KV 缓存占用与计算成本。
AI.keywords: 解码器模型, 提示词重复, KV缓存优化, 信息熵, 提示词工程
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个非常实用的优化方案，通过选择性地重复提示词中最关键的部分，在保持模型推理性能的同时，显著降低了KV缓存占用和计算开销，对于长上下文推理场景具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Safety Testing LLM Agents at Scale: From Risk Discovery to Evidence-Grounded Verification
summary: LLM agents increasingly perform autonomous actions through external tools, leading to complex and evolving safety risks. However, existing safety testing targets expert-designed safety violations, and the corresponding outcomes are evaluated by hard-coded rules, making them costly to extend as agents evolve. To this end, we present Vera, an end-to-end automated safety testing framework that instantiates software engineering testing principles for non-deterministic agents through a three-stage, self-reinforcing pipeline. First, a literature-driven exploration continuously discovers and structures emerging risks into taxonomies of safety risks, attack methods, and tool execution environments. Second, combinatorial composition across taxonomy dimensions produces executable safety cases, each specifying a concrete safety goal, a programmatically constructed initial state, and a deterministic verification predicate grounded in observable artifacts. Third, adaptive execution runs heterogeneous agents in isolated sandboxes where a control agent steers multi-turn interaction based on runtime observations, while evidence-grounded verifiers judge outcomes from environment state and tool-call evidence rather than model self-report. We evaluate Vera on four production agent frameworks (OpenClaw, Hermes, Codex, Claude Code), revealing substantial safety weaknesses, with average attack success rates reaching 93.9\% under multi-channel attacks; we also release Vera-Bench, comprising 1600 executable safety cases spanning 124 risk categories across three execution settings. These results indicate that modular, executable testing infrastructure is essential for rigorous and maintainable safety evaluation of rapidly evolving agentic systems at scale. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Yunhao-Feng/Vera.

AI.title_translation: 大规模LLM智能体安全测试：从风险发现到基于证据的验证
AI.tldr: Vera是一个自动化安全测试框架，通过风险分类、用例构建和基于环境证据的验证，解决了LLM智能体评估难以扩展的问题，并揭示了现有框架的高风险漏洞。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体安全测试依赖于专家设计的违规行为和硬编码规则，随着智能体能力的演进，这种方法成本高昂且难以扩展，无法应对复杂的自主行为风险。
AI.method: 提出了Vera框架，包含三个阶段：1. 基于文献的风险探索与分类；2. 通过组合分类维度构建可执行的安全用例；3. 在沙箱中进行自适应执行，并利用基于证据的验证器（而非模型自评）判断结果。
AI.result: 在四个主流智能体框架上进行了评估，发现显著的安全缺陷，多通道攻击的平均成功率达93.9%；并发布了包含1600个安全用例的Vera-Bench基准测试集。
AI.conclusion: 模块化、可执行的测试基础设施对于大规模、快速演进的智能体系统进行严谨且可维护的安全评估至关重要。
AI.translation: LLM智能体越来越多地通过外部工具执行自主行为，导致了复杂且不断演变的安全风险。然而，现有的安全测试针对的是专家设计的安全违规行为，并且结果通过硬编码规则进行评估，这使得随着智能体的演进，扩展测试的成本变得非常高昂。为此，我们提出了Vera，这是一个端到端的自动化安全测试框架，通过一个三阶段的自我强化流水线，为非确定性智能体实例化了软件工程测试原则。首先，基于文献的探索不断发现并将新兴风险结构化为安全风险、攻击方法和工具执行环境的分类法。其次，通过分类维度的组合构成可执行的安全案例，每个案例都指定了一个具体的安全目标、程序化构建的初始状态以及基于可观察制品的确定性验证谓词。第三，自适应执行在隔离的沙箱中运行异构智能体，其中控制智能体根据运行时观察引导多轮交互，而基于证据的验证器根据环境状态和工具调用证据而非模型自评来判断结果。我们在四个生产智能体框架（OpenClaw、Hermes、Codex、Claude Code）上评估了Vera，揭示了巨大的安全弱点，多通道攻击下的平均攻击成功率达到93.9%；我们还发布了Vera-Bench，包含跨越三种执行设置、124个风险类别的1600个可执行安全案例。这些结果表明，模块化、可执行的测试基础设施对于大规模、快速演进的智能体系统进行严谨且可维护的安全评估至关重要。代码已在 https://github.com/Yunhao-Feng/Vera 公开。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Vera，一个针对非确定性LLM智能体的端到端自动化安全测试框架。Vera通过自动化的风险发现、可执行的安全用例构建以及基于环境证据的验证机制，实现了对智能体系统的高效、严谨评估，并发布了大规模基准测试集Vera-Bench。
AI.keywords: LLM智能体, 安全测试, 自动化评估, 风险发现, 证据验证
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将软件工程中的测试原则引入LLM智能体安全领域，通过模块化和自动化流水线解决了传统基于硬编码规则测试的扩展性难题。其基于证据的验证方法（非模型自评估）显著提高了评估的客观性和严谨性。局限性在于测试范围仍受限于预定义的风险分类法。

title: Lightweight Safe Reinforcement Learning for End-to-End UAV Navigation
summary: With the rapid development of autonomous aerial systems, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed in applications such as inspection, environmental monitoring, and rescue, creating growing demand for reliable autonomous navigation. However, autonomous UAV navigation in dense environments remains challenging under sparse perception and dynamic constraints. Most reinforcement learning (RL) methods lack explicit safety mechanisms, leading to unsafe exploration, unstable training, and risky behaviors, especially during high-speed flight. Even in safe RL approaches, safety is often enforced by projecting policy outputs onto a safe action set, which may introduce instability. Meanwhile, many learning-based methods rely on dense inputs or large networks, increasing computational burden and limiting lightweight onboard deployment. Facing the above challenges, we propose a safety-constrained perception-control integrated framework for UAV navigation. A lightweight network encodes sparse observations into collision-risk-aware features using asymmetric and depthwise separable convolutions. We formulate the task as a constrained Markov decision process within a hierarchical control architecture and solve it using a Lagrangian-based safe PPO algorithm. Curriculum learning further improves training stability. Experiments with varying obstacle densities and flight speeds demonstrate higher success rates, improved safety, and better efficiency than existing reinforcement learning baselines.

title: Single-Channel EEG-Based Cognitive Load Assessment in Online Learning: A Hybrid Deep Learning Approach
summary: Monitoring cognitive load during online learning could help instructors identify content that learners find difficult, but remote settings remove the visual cues that support this judgement in a classroom. We study whether a single-channel, consumer-grade EEG device (the NeuroSky MindWave Mobile 2) can distinguish easy from difficult educational-video content, using the publicly available dataset of Wang et al. [24] (ten learners, one excluded for excessive noise, leaving nine). We implement a hybrid CNN+LSTM+Attention model that combines the raw waveform with band-power features. In a within-subject setting, the model reaches up to 78.5% accuracy, compared with 55% for conventional feature-based classifiers; regularization (dropout and L2) closes the large gap between training and validation accuracy that we observe without it, keeping validation accuracy stable at roughly 68-73%. We are deliberately cautious about these numbers: with only nine subjects, within-subject evaluation is optimistic, and we argue that subject-independent evaluation -- in which no learner appears in both training and test data -- should be the standard for this task. To that end we release a reproducible evaluation pipeline. We frame the work as a feasibility study rather than a deployable system, and pair it with an open, notebook-based tool that records EEG, runs inference, and visualizes estimated cognitive load as a heatmap over the video timeline to help educators locate potentially challenging segments.

AI.title_translation: 基于单通道EEG的在线学习认知负荷评估：一种混合深度学习方法
AI.tldr: 研究表明使用廉价的单通道EEG设备配合混合深度学习模型可以识别在线学习过程中的认知负荷，虽准确率尚可，但仍需进一步的跨被试验证。
AI.motivation: 在线学习环境下，教师缺乏视觉反馈以判断学生对课程内容的理解难度，因此需要一种基于EEG的客观手段来监测学生的认知负荷。
AI.method: 使用NeuroSky MindWave Mobile 2采集单通道EEG信号，构建了一个结合原始波形与频带功率特征的混合CNN+LSTM+Attention模型，并采用了dropout和L2正则化技术。
AI.result: 在被试内评估设置中，混合模型达到了最高78.5%的准确率，显著优于传统分类器的55%；在采用正则化后，验证集准确率稳定在68-73%。
AI.conclusion: 利用单通道EEG结合混合深度学习模型评估在线学习中的认知负荷是可行的，但要实现广泛应用，仍需克服样本量小和跨被试泛化能力不足的问题。
AI.translation: 在在线学习中监测认知负荷可以帮助教师识别学生感到困难的内容，但远程学习环境缺乏课堂中支持这种判断的视觉线索。我们研究了单通道、消费级EEG设备（NeuroSky MindWave Mobile 2）是否能够区分简单和困难的教学视频内容，使用的是Wang等人[24]公开发布的数据集（十名学习者，其中一人因噪声过大被排除，剩余九名）。我们实现了一个混合CNN+LSTM+Attention模型，结合了原始波形和频带功率特征。在被试内设置中，该模型的准确率高达78.5%，而传统特征分类器的准确率为55%；正则化（dropout和L2）缩小了我们在没有它时观察到的训练和验证准确率之间的巨大差距，使验证准确率稳定在68-73%左右。我们对这些数字保持谨慎态度：只有九名受试者时，被试内评估是乐观的，我们认为受试者独立评估——即没有学习者同时出现在训练和测试数据中——应该成为这项任务的标准。为此，我们发布了一个可重复的评估流程。我们将这项工作定位为可行性研究而非可部署系统，并配备了一个基于笔记本的开源工具，该工具可以记录EEG、运行推理并将估计的认知负荷可视化为视频时间轴上的热图，以帮助教育工作者定位潜在的挑战性片段。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了利用消费级单通道EEG设备评估在线学习认知负荷的可行性。研究通过混合CNN+LSTM+Attention模型处理EEG信号，在小样本数据集上取得了优于传统方法的分类效果，并开发了可视化工具辅助教师识别教学难点。
AI.keywords: 认知负荷, 在线学习, 单通道EEG, 混合深度学习, 脑机接口
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地使用消费级单通道EEG设备进行认知负荷评估，并提出了一个开源的评估流程。然而，样本量极小（仅9人）是其主要局限，作者非常理性地将其定位为可行性研究而非成熟系统，并强调了跨被试验证的重要性。

title: Approximate Attention Weighting for Sustainable FPGA-Based Vision Transformer Inference
summary: Vision Transformers have reshaped computer vision by using self-attention to capture global context across image regions. This makes them attractive for edge visual inspection and monitoring in applications such as renewable-energy infrastructure, industrial quality control, medical imaging, and autonomous-system sensing. However, deploying ViTs on small FPGAs remains challenging because the softmax stage in self-attention requires exponential evaluation and normalization, which are costly in hardware. Existing implementations often rely on CORDIC pipelines or BRAM-based look-up tables, increasing area and power consumption. This paper presents a BRAM-free approximate attention-weighting unit for FPGA-based ViT inference. The proposed design approximates the natural exponential in softmax using a 16-segment piecewise-linear function implemented entirely with distributed LUT fabric. Unlike base-2 approximations, the natural-exponential formulation preserves the pre-trained attention temperature and avoids model-specific recalibration. Implemented on a Xilinx Zynq-7020, the complete attention-row core uses 1444 LUTs, 77 DSPs, and no BRAM, while hardware-accurate emulation shows accuracy within a \(0.20\%\) absolute top-1 difference from the exact-softmax reference on ViT-family models. These results demonstrate the potential of the proposed core for energy-efficient ViT inference on resource-constrained edge-AI platforms.

AI.title_translation: 面向可持续FPGA视觉Transformer推理的近似注意力加权方法
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种在FPGA上实现ViT推理的低功耗近似方法，通过分段线性函数替代Softmax中的昂贵指数运算，无需BRAM即可实现高精度推理。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformers在FPGA上的部署受限于Softmax阶段昂贵的硬件开销（如指数运算和归一化），导致高功耗和资源占用。
AI.method: 提出了一种不使用BRAM的注意力加权单元，利用16段分段线性函数在分布式LUT架构上近似自然指数函数。
AI.result: 在Xilinx Zynq-7020上实现，仅使用1444个LUT和77个DSP，不占用BRAM，且准确度与精确Softmax相比仅有0.20%的绝对Top-1差异。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的BRAM-free注意力加权单元在资源受限的FPGA上实现了高精度且高效的ViT推理，是边缘计算应用的理想选择。
AI.translation: 视觉Transformer通过使用自注意力机制捕捉图像区域间的全局上下文，重塑了计算机视觉领域。这使其在可再生能源基础设施、工业质量控制、医学成像和自动系统传感等边缘视觉检测和监控应用中极具吸引力。然而，将ViT部署在小型FPGA上仍然具有挑战性，因为自注意力中的Softmax阶段需要指数评估和归一化，这在硬件中成本高昂。现有的实现通常依赖CORDIC流水线或基于BRAM的查找表，增加了面积和功耗。本文提出了一种用于FPGA的BRAM-free近似注意力加权单元。该设计使用完全由分布式LUT架构实现的16段分段线性函数来近似Softmax中的自然指数。与以2为底的近似不同，自然指数公式保留了预训练的注意力温度，避免了特定模型的重新校准。在Xilinx Zynq-7020上实现后，完整的注意力行核心使用了1444个LUT、77个DSP，且无需BRAM。硬件精确模拟显示，其在ViT系列模型上的绝对Top-1差异在0.20%以内。这些结果证明了所提出的核心在资源受限的边缘AI平台上实现节能ViT推理的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对FPGA的BRAM-free注意力加权单元，通过16段分段线性函数近似自然指数，有效降低了ViT推理的硬件复杂度和资源消耗，同时保持了高预测精度。
AI.keywords: Vision Transformers, FPGA, 硬件加速, Softmax近似, 边缘计算
AI.comments: 该论文通过创新的分段线性近似方法有效解决了ViT在FPGA上部署的硬件瓶颈，尤其在避免使用昂贵的BRAM方面具有重要意义，对边缘AI设备的高效部署提供了实用价值。

title: Expander Sparse Autoencoders: Parameter-Efficient Dictionaries for Mechanistic Interpretability
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose internal activations of neural networks into sparse linear combinations of learned features by fitting an overcomplete dictionary $\mathbf{W}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$ with $m<n$, and inferring a sparse code $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^n$ from $\mathbf{h}\approx\mathbf{W}\mathbf{x}$. This inference problem closely resembles the canonical setup of compressed sensing, but dense decoders requires $O(mn)$ learned values, which becomes costly at large feature counts. We introduce Expander SAEs: TopK SAEs whose decoder and tied encoder are supported on a left-$d$-regular expander mask with $d\ll m$, learning only $dn$ decoder values while keeping the sparse-coding problem $(m,n,k)$ fixed. The same structure reduces storage and turns the matching-pursuit correlation step $\mathbf{W}^\top \mathbf{r}$ in OMP into an $O(dn)$ gather-and-reduce operation. Our experiments show that across Pythia-70M/160M, Qwen2.5-3B, and Llama-3.2-1B residual-stream activations, varying $d$ traces a consistent storage--fidelity frontier, and that at the most compressed modern-LM setting, Qwen2.5-3B with $d=7$ uses $293\times$ fewer learned decoder values than the full dense decoder while retaining $84$% of dense CE-loss recovered. Control experiments show that the improved storage--fidelity tradeoff is driven by sparse, diverse decoder support structure rather than by fewer learned decoder values, and that when sparse and dense decoders are compared at matched parameter count, part of the remaining gap comes from encoder amortisation. On the theoretical side, we show that expansion and column flatness are sufficient for identifiability of noiseless $k$-sparse codes, and we derive complementary sufficient conditions under which OMP recovers the support exactly.

AI.title_translation: Expander 稀疏自编码器：用于机制可解释性的参数高效字典
AI.tldr: 通过引入扩展器图约束，Expander SAEs 在大幅压缩模型参数的同时，保持了与密集 SAE 相当的特征重构能力，有效解决了大规模模型可解释性研究中的存储难题。
AI.motivation: 传统的稀疏自编码器（SAE）在处理大规模特征时，由于密集解码器需要 $O(mn)$ 的参数，导致存储和计算成本极高，限制了其在大型语言模型中的应用。
AI.method: 引入 Expander SAEs，利用左-$d$-正则扩展器掩码（left-$d$-regular expander mask）对 SAE 的解码器权重进行稀疏约束，将传统的密集矩阵运算转化为 $O(dn)$ 的稀疏计算。
AI.result: 在多种模型（如 Qwen2.5-3B）上的实验表明，当 $d=7$ 时，Expander SAEs 可减少 293 倍的解码器参数，同时保留了 84% 的交叉熵损失恢复性能，证明了在存储与保真度之间存在极佳的权衡。
AI.conclusion: Expander SAEs 通过扩展器掩码实现了参数高效的字典学习，在保持高保真度的同时大幅减少了参数量，为大规模神经网络的机制可解释性提供了更具扩展性的工具。
AI.translation: 稀疏自编码器（SAEs）通过拟合超完备字典 $\mathbf{W}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times n}$（其中 $m<n$）并将激活 $\mathbf{h}\approx\mathbf{W}\mathbf{x}$ 分解为学习特征的稀疏线性组合，从而推断出稀疏编码 $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^n$。这一推断问题与压缩感知的典型设置非常相似，但密集解码器需要 $O(mn)$ 个学习值，这在特征数量较大时成本高昂。我们引入了 Expander SAEs：这是一种 TopK SAE，其解码器和绑定的编码器支持在左-$d$-正则扩展器掩码上（$d\ll m$），仅学习 $dn$ 个解码器值，同时保持稀疏编码问题 $(m,n,k)$ 不变。相同的结构减少了存储，并将 OMP 中的匹配追踪相关步骤 $\mathbf{W}^\top \mathbf{r}$ 转化为 $O(dn)$ 的聚集与归约操作。我们的实验表明，在 Pythia-70M/160M、Qwen2.5-3B 和 Llama-3.2-1B 残差流激活中，改变 $d$ 可以追踪到一致的存储-保真度边界；在最压缩的现代语言模型设置下，使用 $d=7$ 的 Qwen2.5-3B 比完整的密集解码器使用的解码器学习值少 293 倍，同时保留了 84% 的密集交叉熵损失恢复。对照实验表明，改进的存储-保真度权衡是由稀疏、多样化的解码器支持结构驱动的，而不是由较少的解码器学习值驱动的，并且当稀疏和密集解码器在匹配参数计数下进行比较时，剩余差距的部分原因是编码器摊销。在理论方面，我们证明了扩展性和列平坦性对于无噪声 $k$-稀疏编码的可识别性是充分的，并推导出了 OMP 精确恢复支持的补充充分条件。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Expander SAEs，这是一种通过扩展器图结构约束解码器权重的新型稀疏自编码器。该方法通过显著减少解码器参数量，降低了大规模神经网络特征解构的存储和计算负担，并在保持高保真度的前提下实现了极高的参数压缩比。
AI.keywords: 稀疏自编码器, 机制可解释性, 扩展器图, 参数效率, 压缩感知
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种极具创新性的方法来解决稀疏自编码器（SAE）在处理大规模特征时的参数量爆炸问题。通过引入图论中的“扩展器图”（expander graph）思想来约束解码器权重，该方法在保持特征提取能力的同时，显著降低了存储成本和计算复杂度，为大规模模型的可解释性研究提供了重要的工程范式。

title: Do LLMs Truly Generalize in the Molecular Domain? A Perturbation-Based Analysis
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently shown promise in molecular discovery, yet a gap remains between their probabilistic nature over discrete sequential tokens and the rigid topological constraints of chemical space. This raises the question of whether molecular LLMs can generalize beyond the local neighborhoods induced by their sequence-based representations. To systematically investigate this question, we introduce a Molecular Perturbation framework that generates syntax-valid structural variants of training molecules under controlled Graph Edit Distance (GED) to probe the manifold regularity of molecular LLMs. Our analysis shows that even a single edit can cause substantial performance drops on common molecular tasks, revealing a narrow local trust region and fragile sensitivity to structural changes. Since similar molecules tend to exhibit similar properties, In-Context Tuning (ICT), which anchors predictions on structurally similar molecules, offers a natural way to mitigate such fragility. Our experiments also examine whether ICT confers robustness under controlled structural perturbations, and the results suggest that it can partially expand the local trust region and offer a promising direction for stabilizing molecular LLMs against structural variation.

title: On the Limits of Steering Vectors for Preference-Aligned Generation
summary: Steering vectors have emerged as a promising approach to controlled text generation, offering interpretable, training-free mechanisms for shaping model outputs. However, their practical generality remains poorly understood. We study the limits of steering vector generalization along three dimensions: trait expressibility, task transfer, and multi-trait composition. Using the PLUME writing personalization benchmark, we extract steering vectors for a range of preferences and evaluate them on summarization and email-writing tasks across two open-source models (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama3.1-8B-Instruct). We find that steering effectiveness varies substantially across traits. We further show that steering effectiveness can degrade when vectors extracted from positive and negative style examples are transferred to downstream writing personalization tasks. Finally, we compare common methods for composing multiple steering vectors and find that all methods suffer significant drops in trait expression as more vectors are added, with a tradeoff between coherence and expressibility that requires per-setting hyperparameter tuning. Taken together, our results suggest that steering vectors face meaningful limits as a general-purpose tool for preference alignment.

AI.title_translation: 论偏好对齐生成中转向向量的局限性
AI.tldr: 研究表明，转向向量在实现精准的偏好对齐方面存在显著局限，特别是在任务迁移和多特征组合时表现欠佳，难以完全胜任通用对齐任务。
AI.motivation: 转向向量作为一种无需训练的受控文本生成方法虽然流行，但其在实际应用中的普适性和局限性尚不明确，需要系统性的实证研究来界定其能力边界。
AI.method: 利用PLUME写作个性化基准，在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama3.1-8B-Instruct模型上，从特征可表达性、任务迁移和多特征组合三个维度对转向向量进行了实验评估。
AI.result: 研究发现：1. 转向效果随特征不同而差异巨大；2. 从风格示例提取的向量在迁移至下游任务时效果会下降；3. 组合多个转向向量会导致特征表达能力显著降低，且在连贯性与表达力之间存在难以平衡的折衷。
AI.conclusion: 转向向量作为一种通用的偏好对齐工具存在显著局限性，其在不同特征、任务迁移及多向量组合场景下的表现并不稳定，难以作为一种完全可靠的通用对齐方案。
AI.translation: 转向向量已成为一种有前景的受控文本生成方法，为塑造模型输出提供了可解释且无需训练的机制。然而，其实际的普适性仍知之甚少。我们从特征可表达性、任务迁移和多特征组合三个维度研究了转向向量的推广极限。利用PLUME写作个性化基准，我们提取了多种偏好的转向向量，并在两个开源模型（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama3.1-8B-Instruct）上对摘要和电子邮件撰写任务进行了评估。我们发现，转向效果在不同特征间差异显著。我们进一步表明，当从正向和负向风格示例中提取的向量迁移到下游写作个性化任务时，转向效果会下降。最后，我们比较了组合多个转向向量的常用方法，发现随着向量数量的增加，所有方法在特征表达上都会出现显著下降，且在连贯性与表达力之间存在一种需要逐个设置超参数调优的权衡。综上所述，我们的结果表明转向向量作为偏好对齐的通用工具面临着实质性的局限。
AI.summary: 本文系统评估了转向向量在偏好对齐中的局限性。研究发现，尽管转向向量具有直观的控制能力，但其在特征表达、任务迁移和多向量组合方面表现不稳定，且随着组合向量数量增加，模型的表达能力和连贯性会受到严重影响，说明其作为通用对齐工具的能力有限。
AI.keywords: 转向向量, 偏好对齐, 受控文本生成, 模型可控性, 提示工程
AI.comments: 该研究对“转向向量（Steering Vectors）”这一热门技术进行了批判性评估，揭示了其在复杂任务和多目标组合中的局限性。这对于理解模型可控性研究的边界具有重要的指导意义，强调了在实际应用中不能过度依赖此类简单的推理时干预方法。

title: PixGS: Pixel-Space Diffusion for Direct 3D Gaussian Splat Generation
summary: Recent advances in 3D content generation from text or images have achieved impressive results, yet view inconsistency from 2D generators and the scarcity of high-quality 3D data remain significant bottlenecks. Existing solutions typically adapt large-scale pre-trained text-to-image latent diffusion models to generate 3D Gaussian Splats (3DGS). However, these approaches often rely on training complex cascade pipelines that are computationally expensive and scalability-limited. Most critically, the quality of generated 3D assets is inherently constrained by each component capacity and compressed latent space, leading to decoding artifacts and accumulated errors. To address these limitations, we propose PixGS, a single-stage pipeline for direct high-quality 3DGS generation, which leverages recent advances in pixel-space diffusion to bypass lossy latent compression while still benefiting from the vast 2D generative priors. By directly denoising 3D Gaussian attributes at each timestep, our method enables precise, splat-level regularization of both appearance and geometry. Furthermore, we introduce a comprehensive supervision strategy that incorporates surface normals, depth, and high-frequency structural information, which is often overlooked in prior works. Experiments demonstrate that PixGS outperforms current state-of-the-art methods while maintaining a fast inference speed (1s on a single A100 GPU), offering a robust and efficient alternative to multi-stage generation pipelines.

title: VLA-Corrector: Lightweight Detect-and-Correct Inference for Adaptive Action Horizon
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models have recently achieved strong progress in embodied intelligence. To reduce policy-call frequency while preserving temporal coherence, most generative policies adopt an action chunk mechanism, executing multiple future actions in an open-loop manner under a fixed action horizon. However, this "predict-then-blindly-execute" paradigm sacrifices closed-loop reactivity: in contact-rich physical interactions, even small local perturbations can rapidly amplify within the open-loop blind spot, leading to compounding errors and ultimately task failure. To address this limitation, we propose VLA-Corrector, a lightweight corrective inference framework for action-chunked VLA policies. Without modifying the backbone policy weights, VLA-Corrector introduces a lightweight Latent-space Vision Monitor (LVM) that continuously compares predicted and actual visual feature evolution, enabling online detection of visual dynamics deviations. Once persistent deviation is detected, the system triggers a truncation event, discards the remaining stale actions, and invokes corrective replanning via Online Gradient Guidance (OGG). The detect-and-correct mechanism of VLA-Corrector naturally induces an event-triggered adaptive action horizon: it preserves long-horizon execution when the current chunk remains reliable, and invokes short-horizon corrective replanning when execution begins to drift. In doing so, VLA-Corrector mitigates the trade-off imposed by static horizons between execution robustness and policy-call frequency. It can be integrated into different VLA models without further retraining the VLA backbone, interrupting compounding errors while preserving much of the efficiency benefit of action chunking and substantially improving robustness in long-horizon, contact-rich robotic manipulation tasks.

title: A Social Norms Approach to Youth Social Media Design
summary: Young people consistently say they want authentic self-expression, less judgment, and more interpersonal trust on social media, yet they rarely manage to engage that way. My dissertation argues that the obstacle is normative rather than individual: how youth engage is governed less by personal choice than by platform norms, peer perception, and beliefs about how others behave. I take a social norms approach to youth social media design organized around three claims. First, platform norms constrain individual behavior, producing a pluralistic ignorance in which youth enact norms they privately reject. Second, design interventions are themselves shaped by existing norms, so whether a feature works depends on the environment around it, which means relational goals such as privacy must be treated as social norms rather than individual settings. Third, a societal norm about what ``social media'' is -- equating it with a few mainstream platforms -- confines policy and design to mitigating those platforms rather than actively envisioning supportive alternatives. Together these claims motivate my dissertation research: engaging youth directly in designing and building an evidence-based independent platform whose features consistently signal that building trusted connections is what the space is for.

title: Archer: Towards Agentic Review for Compiler Optimizations
summary:
Modern compilers are frequently updated, but expert review capacity is highly limited, leading to delayed integration and, in some cases, subtle semantic bugs entering the compiler codebase. Automating the code review process with modern general code review agents may be feasible, but it faces critical challenges due to compiler complexity. In this paper, we use LLVM as our target compiler and present Archer, the first automated agentic code review tool for compiler optimizations. Archer constrains the agentic review process from both ends by using obligations to guide analysis and a deterministic validation guard to admit only findings backed by executable evidence.
  We evaluated Archer on 70 open PRs and 328 closed PRs in LLVM from the last two months. The review results are shocking and concerning: Archer discovers that 21% of open PRs and 11% of closed PRs are buggy, i.e, introducing semantic bugs such as miscompilations in LLVM. Our findings expose a critical gap in the capacity for critical review in large compiler projects and demonstrate the practical value of Archer as an additional reviewer.

title: Decoupling Code Complexity from Newcomer Participation: A Causal Study of AI Coding Agent Adoption in OSS
summary: Open-source projects depend on a steady inflow of newcomers. A growing concern is that AI coding agents (tools such as Cursor and Claude Code that write code from natural-language instructions) will crowd them out, by absorbing the simple tasks that beginners start with and by making code harder to read. We give this concern a causal answer. Using GitHub code search we identify 1,888 projects that adopted an agent, signaled by their first commit of a configuration file. We apply difference-in-differences against matched non-adopting controls, restricting the main analysis to the 603 adopters with a genuine pre-adoption period. We find no evidence of crowding-out: across estimators newcomer inflow shows no significant decline after adoption (point estimates run from a small increase to, under the most conservative trend specification, a slight and insignificant dip), onboarding and retention are unchanged, and a sparse, correlational beginner-task measure (good-first-issue labels, which we cannot test for parallel trends) shows no decline. The feared mechanism is real but decoupled: adoption raises per-function code complexity (about +11% on a cognitive metric for Python, a quarter of the prior estimate, and +3 to 4% in cyclomatic terms across all languages), yet in fixed-unit subsets where complexity rose (Python on the cognitive metric, and all languages on the cyclomatic metric), newcomer participation does not decline. These results suggest that, in established open-source projects, adopting an AI coding agent makes code modestly more complex but does not crowd out the human newcomers that a project depends on: the feared trade-off between AI assistance and human participation does not materialize.

AI.title_translation: 代码复杂性与新贡献者参与的解耦：开源项目中AI编码代理采用的因果研究
AI.tldr: 研究表明，在开源项目中引入AI编码助手虽然会略微增加代码复杂度，但并不会导致新贡献者减少，AI与人类参与之间不存在预期的冲突。
AI.motivation: 开源项目依赖于新贡献者的持续加入，人们担忧AI编码代理通过接管简单任务或增加代码阅读难度，从而挤出这些新手。本研究旨在通过因果研究方法验证这一担忧是否属实。
AI.method: 利用GitHub代码搜索识别出1,888个采用AI编码助手的项目；通过配置文件的首次提交作为采用标志；采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences）对603个具有明确采用前期的项目进行匹配分析，并对比未采用的对照组。
AI.result: 研究发现AI采用后新贡献者流入量无显著下降，新手入门和留存率保持不变；虽然AI采用导致代码复杂度提升（Python认知指标提升约11%，全语言循环复杂度提升3-4%），但在复杂度提升的子集中，新贡献者参与度并未出现下降。
AI.conclusion: 在开源项目中，采用AI编码助手虽然会导致代码复杂度适度增加，但并不会对新贡献者的参与度产生负面影响，即AI辅助与人类参与之间不存在预期的权衡关系。
AI.translation: 开源项目依赖于新贡献者的稳定流入。一个日益增长的担忧是，AI编码代理（如Cursor和Claude Code等根据自然语言指令编写代码的工具）将通过吸收初学者开始从事的简单任务，并使代码更难阅读，从而挤出他们。我们对这一担忧给出了因果性的回答。利用GitHub代码搜索，我们识别了1,888个采用了代理的项目，标志是它们配置文件的首次提交。我们针对匹配的非采用对照组应用了双重差分法，将主要分析限制在603个具有真实采用前期的采用者中。我们没有发现挤出效应的证据：在各种估计量中，AI采用后新贡献者的流入量没有显著下降（点估计值从轻微增加到最保守趋势规范下的轻微且不显著的下降），入门和留存率没有变化，且一个稀疏的相关性初学者任务指标（我们无法对其进行平行趋势测试的“良好首个议题”标签）显示没有下降。所担心的机制是真实的但已解耦：采用AI提高了每个函数的代码复杂度（Python在认知指标上约+11%，是之前估计值的四分之一；所有语言在循环复杂度上+3%至4%），然而在复杂度上升的固定单元子集中，新贡献者的参与度并未下降。这些结果表明，在成熟的开源项目中，采用AI编码代理使代码复杂度适度增加，但并未挤出项目所依赖的人类新贡献者：AI辅助与人类参与之间所担心的权衡并未实现。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了AI编码助手在开源项目中的采用对新贡献者参与的影响。通过对GitHub项目的双重差分分析，研究发现尽管AI的使用导致了代码复杂度的轻微增加，但并未出现预期的“挤出效应”，新贡献者的加入与留存并未受损。研究结论表明，AI辅助工具与开源项目的人类参与之间不存在负面权衡。
AI.keywords: AI编码助手, 开源项目, 新贡献者, 因果推断, 代码复杂度
AI.comments: 该研究通过严谨的因果推断方法（双重差分法）回应了开源社区关于AI编码助手是否会挤出新贡献者的担忧，具有很高的现实意义。其创新之处在于量化分析了AI对代码复杂度的影响，并明确指出代码复杂度提升与新贡献者参与度之间并不存在必然的负相关关系，为AI在开源生态中的应用提供了实证支持。

title: TO-Master: an LLM-agent framework for automated topology optimization
summary: Topology optimization (TO) has become a mature computational design method, but using it still requires substantial manual effort in geometry preparation, mesh generation, boundary-condition assignment, solver setup, and postprocessing. This implementation barrier limits the use of TO outside expert workflows, even when differentiable finite element solvers are available. This work introduces TO-Master, a large language model (LLM) agent framework that turns finite-element-based TO into a conversational, tool-orchestrated workflow. From natural language instructions and optional mesh, geometry, or image inputs, the agent selects computational tools, constructs finite element TO models, checks meshes and boundary conditions, and launches sensitivity-based optimization with typed solver arguments. The framework supports generated and uploaded meshes, image-to-mesh conversion, 2D and 3D structural compliance minimization, thermal conduction, multiple load cases, stress-constrained optimization, and engineering geometries. Numerical experiments show that TO-Master can reproduce standard benchmark results and solve more complex engineering examples while returning optimized results, field distributions, convergence histories, and interactive artifacts without user-written code. An instruction ablation study further shows that tool-usage rules, internal reasoning guidance, and few-shot examples are critical for robust formulation under ambiguous user input. By combining LLM-agent orchestration with deterministic finite element and optimization tools, TO-Master removes the burden of trivial setup and routine model construction, lowers the modeling barrier of TO, and preserves a reliable numerical workflow. The TO-Master platform is available online at https://www.bohrium.com/en/apps/to-master.

title: MMBench-Live: A Continuously Evolving Benchmark for Multimodal Models
summary: Evaluation benchmarks are essential for assessing vision-language models (VLMs), but most multimodal benchmarks are static, making them vulnerable to temporal staleness, data contamination, and costly maintenance. We present MMBench-Live, a continuously evolving multimodal benchmark built by a multi-agent-driven automated pipeline. Our framework treats benchmark evolution as task-guided dataset construction, integrating structured benchmark specification, feedback-controlled real-time data acquisition, and verifiable QA generation with executable reasoning. To maintain cross-version comparability, we introduce a distribution-consistent update strategy that extracts task-related visual patterns from the original benchmark to guide data collection and filtering. Instantiated from MMBench, MMBench-Live contains 5.9K newly generated evaluation instances with a high answer correctness rate, while each update costs about USD 30 and takes 1-2 hours. Extensive evaluations show that MMBench-Live preserves stable model rankings, maintains semantic alignment with the original benchmark, and exhibits weaker contamination-related memorization signals, suggesting a practical and scalable paradigm for sustainable multimodal benchmark evolution. The project is available at https://github.com/PRIS-CV/MMBench-Live.

title: MMIR-TCM: Memory-Integrated Multimodal Inference and Retrieval for TCM Clinical Decision Support
summary: Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) diagnosis, particularly through tongue inspection, faces persistent challenges in subjectivity and reproducibility. The application of multimodal artificial intelligence to TCM clinical tasks, such as syndrome differentiation and prescription generation, is significantly hampered by the semantic gap between visual tongue features and textual reasoning, as well as the lack of large-scale, standardized datasets. To address these challenges, we introduce MMIR-TCM, a novel framework that emulates the diagnostic process of TCM experts by integrating multimodal large language model(MLLM) with memory-augmented segmentation and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Employing a three-stage architecture, MMIR-TCM integrates a training-free Memory-SAM module for robust tongue extraction, a fine-tuned Qwen3-VL model for structured tongue diagnosis generation, and a Qwen3-based RAG component for evidence-grounded clinical decision support generation. The framework was developed and validated using MedTCM, a new large-scale multimodal dataset that we introduce specifically for advanced TCM research. To properly evaluate our framework's clinical accuracy, which existing metrics fail to capture, we also developed TDEU, a domain-specific evaluation metric incorporating semantic understanding and diagnostic importance. Our comprehensive experiments demonstrate that MMIR-TCM significantly outperforms leading models, including GPT-4o and Gemini 2.5 Flash.

AI.conclusion: MMIR-TCM 框架通过整合视觉特征提取、结构化诊断生成和证据导向的临床决策支持，有效解决了中医舌诊中主观性强、语义鸿沟大及数据缺乏的问题，在临床准确性上超越了 GPT-4o 等主流模型。

title: HCMS: Head-Chunked Multi-Stream Pipeline for Communication-Computation Overlap in Long-Sequence Parallel Attention
summary: All-to-all based sequence parallelism methods execute communication and computation strictly in serial when processing medium-long sequences, resulting in hardware resource underutilization. This paper proposes Head-Chunked Multi-Stream Pipeline (HCMS), which exploits the computational independence of multi-head attention by partitioning attention heads into multiple chunks and achieving fine-grained communication-computation overlap through dual CUDA streams. HCMS is orthogonally compatible with existing optimizations such as FlashAttention and SDPA, requires no modification to underlying kernels, supports uneven partitioning while maintaining numerical equivalence. Experiments validate the effectiveness across four GPU platforms at 2-8 GPU scales: for typical video generation sequence lengths of 31K-56K tokens, HCMS achieves 10\%-17.5\% speedup over the Ulysses baseline and 5\%-14.5\% speedup over Ring Attention; end-to-end acceleration of 6.8\% is achieved on the Wan2.2 model. Theoretical analysis shows that HCMS benefits are positively correlated with communication ratio $ρ$, and its use is recommended when $ρ>20\%$.

AI.method: 提出HCMS（Head-Chunked Multi-Stream Pipeline），将多头注意力划分为多个块，利用双CUDA流实现细粒度的通信与计算重叠。

title: Koopman operator theory: fundamentals, control, and applications
summary: The Koopman operator has gained considerable attention due to its ability to provide a global linear representation of highly complex dynamical systems. The operator describes nonlinear dynamics in a linear way through the lens of real- or complex-valued observable functions. Recently proposed data-driven techniques, like extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD), its kernelized variant, and machine-learning methods, can be used to generate finite-dimensional approximations accompanied by finite-data error bounds. In this tutorial paper, we provide a concise introduction into Koopman operator theory and its use in systems and control. A particular focus is put on data-driven surrogate models, their extension to systems with inputs, and controller design using Koopman operator theory. Moreover, we demonstrate the key techniques, i.e., EDMD and Koopman MPC. To this end, we provide simulation studies including source code on GitHub to enable the interested reader to experience the Koopman operator in systems and control step by step.

title: Congestion-Based Slot Pricing in a Railway Auction Game
summary:
We present a multi-agent system for studying the allocation of discrete, congested resources among heterogeneous strategic agents, motivated by the problem of railway slot allocation under deregulation. Multiple operator-agents, differing in size and capacity, interact through a shared auction mechanism over repeated rounds under time-constrained decision-making. The mechanism combines a congestion-based base price that increases with aggregate demand with an asymmetric corrective adjustment that penalises the agent requesting the most slots and rewards the agent requesting the fewest, and is designed to mitigate strategic dominance by large agents while preserving transparency and congestion sensitivity. We formulate the interaction as a repeated game with incomplete information and implement the system as a real-time, web-based multi-agent environment in which human participants control individual agents and observe live marginal-cost and competitor feedback.
  We report exploratory observations from two structured sessions with domain experts acting as operator-agents. The congestion mechanism responds to aggregate demand as designed and the corrective incentives are actively triggered, but agents representing large operators persist with high-request strategies despite the penalty, suggesting that corrective pricing is necessary but not sufficient to neutralise strategic dominance in this multi-agent setting. A post-session debrief indicates that participants' decisions were driven by the assumed agent role rather than personal disposition, and provides qualitative support for strategic motives, such as preserving market presence and raising rivals' costs, operating alongside short-term profit maximisation. We discuss implications for multi-agent mechanism design under asymmetric budgets and outline directions for analytical validation and larger-scale multi-agent experiments.

title: Gaming Consensus: Coordinated Manipulation in Crowdsourced Fact-Checking
summary: Crowdsourced fact-checking systems have been adopted by major social media companies such as X, Meta, TikTok and Google with the aim of combating misleading information at scale without relying on centralized editorial control. These systems have been developed around a common underlying concept: a bridging mechanism that identifies notes flagging misleading information when they receive support from people with different perspectives rather than simple majority support. To our knowledge the only publicly disclosed bridging algorithms deployed for fact-checking are based on matrix factorization, as deployed by both X and Meta, augmented with additional components addressing abuse, targeted manipulation, and contributor brigades. This work examines the core matrix factorization portion of these systems, presenting theoretical and empirical evaluations of the degree to which coordinated users could vote strategically by leveraging the latent representations to fabricate the appearance of synthetic consensus within the bridging mechanism. Using historic production data, we find that up to 10.7% of lower quality notes could be manipulated above consensus thresholds using less than 10 ratings. We complement these findings with a theoretical analysis, revealing counterintuitively that rating a note as "Not Helpful" can increase its helpfulness score, as well as a cost model quantifying manipulation effort. We have developed and deployed mitigations within X's Community Notes algorithm to address synthetic consensus.
