AI.title_translation: 一种面向可靠WebGIS开发的双螺旋智能体治理方法
AI.tldr: 通过引入双螺旋治理框架和三轨架构，该研究解决了智能体在WebGIS开发中的不稳定性问题，实现了更高质量的生产级地理空间工程。
AI.motivation: WebGIS开发对一致性要求极高，但现有的智能体（Agentic AI）常因大语言模型的上下文限制、遗忘、随机性、指令失效及适应性僵化而导致任务失败。
AI.method: 提出了一个“双螺旋”治理框架，采用“知识、行为、技能”三轨架构，并结合持久化知识图谱，通过外部化事实和强制执行协议来稳定Agent的执行过程。
AI.result: 在实验中，受治理的Agent成功重构了遗留WebGIS代码库，降低了圈复杂度；在受控实验中，输出方差降低了约一半；并在COVID-19制图消融研究中有效避免了常见的映射错误。
AI.conclusion: 通过外部化的治理框架和三轨架构，该研究显著提升了Agent在WebGIS开发任务中的一致性、可靠性和执行稳定性，证明了结构化治理对于生产级地理空间工程的重要性。
AI.translation: WebGIS的开发需要高度的一致性，但由于大语言模型的上下文限制、遗忘、随机性、指令失败和适应性僵化，智能体（Agentic AI）往往难以胜任。我们提出了一个双螺旋治理框架，将这些问题重新定义为结构性问题，而非单纯的能力缺陷。通过采用三轨架构（知识、行为、技能）和持久化知识图谱，该框架通过外部化事实和强制执行协议来稳定执行过程。验证表明，受治理的智能体成功重构了遗留的WebGIS代码库（降低了圈复杂度并提高了可维护性），在受控实验中将输出方差较静态提示词方法降低了约一半，并在COVID-19制图的五条件消融研究中防止了常见的映射错误。该方法通过开源工具包AgentLoom实现，为生产级的地理空间工程提供了必要的稳定性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于WebGIS开发的双螺旋治理框架，旨在解决智能体在开发过程中的不稳定性。通过三轨架构和持久化知识图谱，该方法成功将治理逻辑外部化，显著提升了Agent在代码重构和复杂制图任务中的一致性与可靠性。
AI.keywords: WebGIS开发, Agentic AI, 治理框架, 知识图谱, 可靠性提升
AI.comments: 该研究通过将Agent的可靠性问题从单纯的模型能力缺陷转化为结构治理问题，提供了一种新颖的视角。其创新之处在于引入了“双螺旋”治理框架和三轨架构，有效解决了WebGIS开发中常见的上下文丢失和随机性问题。局限性在于该框架的适用范围是否仅限于WebGIS领域，以及在大规模复杂系统中的扩展性尚需进一步验证。

title: Wiki-R1: Incentivizing Multimodal Reasoning for Knowledge-based VQA via Data and Sampling Curriculum
comments: Accepted by ICLR 26, code and weights are publicly available
summary: Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering (KB-VQA) requires models to answer questions about an image by integrating external knowledge, posing significant challenges due to noisy retrieval and the structured, encyclopedic nature of the knowledge base. These characteristics create a distributional gap from pretrained multimodal large language models (MLLMs), making effective reasoning and domain adaptation difficult in the post-training stage. In this work, we propose \textit{Wiki-R1}, a data-generation-based curriculum reinforcement learning framework that systematically incentivizes reasoning in MLLMs for KB-VQA. Wiki-R1 constructs a sequence of training distributions aligned with the model's evolving capability, bridging the gap from pretraining to the KB-VQA target distribution. We introduce \textit{controllable curriculum data generation}, which manipulates the retriever to produce samples at desired difficulty levels, and a \textit{curriculum sampling strategy} that selects informative samples likely to yield non-zero advantages during RL updates. Sample difficulty is estimated using observed rewards and propagated to unobserved samples to guide learning. Experiments on two KB-VQA benchmarks, Encyclopedic VQA and InfoSeek, demonstrate that Wiki-R1 achieves new state-of-the-art results, improving accuracy from 35.5\% to 37.1\% on Encyclopedic VQA and from 40.1\% to 44.1\% on InfoSeek. The project page is available at https://artanic30.github.io/project_pages/WikiR1/.

title: Restoring Linguistic Grounding in VLA Models via Train-Free Attention Recalibration
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable robots to perform manipulation tasks directly from natural language instructions and are increasingly viewed as a foundation for generalist robotic policies. However, their reliability under Out-of-Distribution (OOD) instructions remains underexplored. In this paper, we reveal a critical failure mode in which VLA policies continue executing visually plausible actions even when the language instruction contradicts the scene. We refer to this phenomenon as linguistic blindness, where VLA policies prioritize visual priors over instruction semantics during action generation. To systematically analyze this issue, we introduce ICBench, a diagnostic benchmark constructed from the LIBERO dataset that probes language-action coupling by injecting controlled OOD instruction contradictions while keeping the visual environment unchanged. Evaluations on three representative VLA architectures, including Pi0, Pi0.5 and OpenVLA OFT, show that these models frequently succeed at tasks despite logically impossible instructions, revealing a strong visual bias in action generation. To mitigate this issue, we propose Instruction-Guided Attention Recalibration (IGAR), a train-free inference-time mechanism that rebalances attention distributions to restore the influence of language instructions. IGAR operates without retraining or architectural modification and can be directly applied to existing VLA models. Experiments across 30 LIBERO tasks demonstrate that IGAR substantially reduces erroneous execution under OOD contradictory instructions while preserving baseline task performance. We additionally validate the approach on a real Franka robotic arm, where IGAR effectively prevents manipulation triggered by inconsistent instructions.

title: FlexServe: A Fast and Secure LLM Serving System for Mobile Devices with Flexible Resource Isolation
summary: Device-side Large Language Models (LLMs) have witnessed explosive growth, offering higher privacy and availability compared to cloud-side LLMs. During LLM inference, both model weights and user data are valuable, and attackers may even compromise the OS kernel to steal them. ARM TrustZone is the de facto hardware-based isolation technology on mobile devices, used to protect sensitive applications from a compromised OS. However, protecting LLM inference with TrustZone incurs significant overhead due to its inflexible isolation of memory and the NPU. To address these challenges, this paper introduces FlexServe, a fast and secure LLM serving system for mobile devices. It first introduces a Flexible Resource Isolation mechanism to construct Flexible Secure Memory (Flex-Mem) and Flexible Secure NPU (Flex-NPU). Both memory pages and the NPU can be efficiently switched between unprotected and protected modes. Based on these mechanisms, FlexServe designs a fast and secure LLM inference framework within TrustZone's secure world. The LLM-Aware Memory Management and Secure Inference Pipeline are introduced to accelerate inference. A Multi-Model Scheduler is proposed to optimize multi-model workflows. We implement a prototype of FlexServe and compare it with two TrustZone-based strawman designs. The results show that FlexServe achieves an average $10.05\times$ speedup in Time to First Token (TTFT) compared to the strawman, and an average $2.44\times$ TTFT speedup compared to an optimized strawman with pipeline and secure NPU enabled. For multi-model agent workflows, the end-to-end speedup is up to $24.30\times$ and $4.05\times$ compared to the strawman and optimized strawman, respectively.

AI.title_translation: FlexServe：一种具有灵活资源隔离能力的移动端快速安全LLM服务系统
AI.tldr: FlexServe通过创新的灵活资源隔离机制，解决了移动端TrustZone环境下LLM推理性能低下的瓶颈，实现了显著的加速。
AI.motivation: 移动端LLM推理需要保护模型权重和用户数据安全，但传统的ARM TrustZone隔离方案因内存和NPU隔离僵化导致性能开销过大。
AI.method: 提出FlexServe系统，包含灵活的资源隔离机制（Flex-Mem和Flex-NPU），并设计了LLM感知内存管理、安全推理流水线以及多模型调度器。
AI.result: FlexServe在TTFT指标上相比基础方案实现了平均10.05倍的加速，相比优化后的方案实现了2.44倍的加速；在多模型代理工作流中，端到端加速最高可达24.30倍和4.05倍。
AI.conclusion: FlexServe 通过灵活的资源隔离机制和针对性的推理优化，成功在移动端实现了兼顾安全与高效的LLM服务，显著优于传统的TrustZone隔离方案。
AI.translation: 端侧大语言模型（LLM）经历了爆炸式增长，与云端LLM相比具有更高的隐私性和可用性。在LLM推理过程中，模型权重和用户数据都极具价值，攻击者甚至可能通过破坏操作系统内核来窃取这些信息。ARM TrustZone是移动设备上事实上的硬件隔离技术，用于保护敏感应用免受受损操作系统的侵害。然而，由于其对内存和NPU的僵化隔离，使用TrustZone保护LLM推理会带来显著的开销。为了应对这些挑战，本文介绍了FlexServe，一种用于移动设备的快速且安全的LLM服务系统。它首先引入了一种灵活的资源隔离机制，以构建灵活安全内存（Flex-Mem）和灵活安全NPU（Flex-NPU）。内存页和NPU都可以在非保护模式和保护模式之间高效切换。基于这些机制，FlexServe在TrustZone的安全世界中设计了一个快速且安全的LLM推理框架。文中引入了LLM感知内存管理和安全推理流水线来加速推理，并提出了多模型调度器来优化多模型工作流。我们实现了FlexServe的原型，并将其与两个基于TrustZone的基准方案进行了比较。结果表明，与基准方案相比，FlexServe在首字生成时间（TTFT）上实现了平均10.05倍的加速，与启用了流水线和安全NPU的优化基准方案相比，平均TTFT加速为2.44倍。对于多模型代理工作流，端到端加速分别比基准方案和优化基准方案最高提高了24.30倍和4.05倍。
AI.summary: FlexServe是一个专为移动设备设计的快速且安全的LLM服务系统，通过引入灵活的资源隔离机制，实现了内存和NPU在安全与非安全模式间的高效切换，并配合专门的内存管理和流水线优化，大幅提升了端侧LLM的推理性能。
AI.keywords: 移动端LLM, TrustZone, 资源隔离, 推理加速, 安全计算
AI.comments: 本文创新性地解决了移动端LLM在可信执行环境（TrustZone）中运行性能低下的问题，通过提出灵活的资源隔离机制（Flex-Mem和Flex-NPU），在保证安全性的前提下显著提升了推理速度，对端侧AI部署具有极高的实用价值。

title: WikiCLIP: An Efficient Contrastive Baseline for Open-domain Visual Entity Recognition
comments: Accepted by CVPR26, codes and weights are publicly available
summary: Open-domain visual entity recognition (VER) seeks to associate images with entities in encyclopedic knowledge bases such as Wikipedia. Recent generative methods tailored for VER demonstrate strong performance but incur high computational costs, limiting their scalability and practical deployment. In this work, we revisit the contrastive paradigm for VER and introduce WikiCLIP, a simple yet effective framework that establishes a strong and efficient baseline for open-domain VER. WikiCLIP leverages large language model embeddings as knowledge-rich entity representations and enhances them with a Vision-Guided Knowledge Adaptor (VGKA) that aligns textual semantics with visual cues at the patch level. To further encourage fine-grained discrimination, a Hard Negative Synthesis Mechanism generates visually similar but semantically distinct negatives during training. Experimental results on popular open-domain VER benchmarks, such as OVEN, demonstrate that WikiCLIP significantly outperforms strong baselines. Specifically, WikiCLIP achieves a 16\% improvement on the challenging OVEN unseen set, while reducing inference latency by nearly 100 times compared with the leading generative model, AutoVER. The project page is available at https://artanic30.github.io/project_pages/WikiCLIP/

AI.title_translation: WikiCLIP：一种用于开放域视觉实体识别的高效对比学习基准
AI.tldr: WikiCLIP通过回归对比学习范式，在保持高效推理的同时，显著提升了开放域视觉实体识别的准确率。

AI.translation: 开放域视觉实体识别（VER）旨在将图像与维基百科等百科知识库中的实体相关联。近期针对VER定制的生成式方法展示了强大的性能，但带来了高昂的计算成本，限制了其可扩展性和实际部署。在这项工作中，我们重新审视了VER的对比学习范式，并介绍了WikiCLIP，一个简单而有效的框架，为开放域VER建立了强大且高效的基准。WikiCLIP利用大语言模型嵌入作为知识丰富的实体表示，并通过视觉引导知识适配器（VGKA）在补丁级别将文本语义与视觉线索对齐。为了进一步鼓励细粒度区分，困难负样本合成机制在训练期间生成视觉相似但语义不同的负样本。在OVEN等流行开放域VER基准上的实验结果表明，WikiCLIP显著优于强基准模型。具体而言，WikiCLIP在具有挑战性的OVEN未见集上实现了16%的提升，同时与领先的生成模型AutoVER相比，推理延迟降低了近100倍。项目页面见 https://artanic30.github.io/project_pages/WikiCLIP/

AI.keywords: 开放域视觉实体识别, 对比学习, WikiCLIP, 知识嵌入, 高效模型
AI.comments: WikiCLIP通过回归对比学习范式，成功解决了生成式模型在开放域视觉实体识别中推理成本过高的问题。其创新之处在于利用大语言模型嵌入作为先验知识，并通过VGKA适配器和困难负样本合成机制实现了高效且精准的识别。该方法在大幅降低推理延迟的同时提升了准确率，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Witnesses for Fixpoint Games on Lattices
summary:
We construct witnesses that can be used to derive strategies in fixpoint games and provide proof that the least fixpoint of a function is either above or not below some given bound. We rely on a lattice-theoretical approach, including a Galois connection that connects a lattice representing the "logic universe", where the witness lives, with another lattice representing the "behaviour universe", over which the function is defined. In fact we consider two types of games -- primal and dual games -- and in both cases show how to derive winning strategies in the game from witnesses and construct witnesses from strategies. The two games differ wrt. their rules and the choice of basis of the lattice.
  The theory can be instantiated to well-known examples: in particular we compare with the construction of distinguishing formulas in standard bisimilarity and behavioural metrics for probabilistic systems. As a new case study we consider witnesses for certifying lower bounds for the termination probability for Markov chains.

AI.title_translation: 格上不动点博弈的见证
AI.tldr: 论文通过格论建立了不动点博弈策略与逻辑见证之间的等价关系，为验证概率系统和马尔可夫链提供了统一的分析框架。
AI.motivation: 为了在不动点博弈中寻找一种形式化的方法，通过逻辑见证来推导获胜策略，并证明函数最小不动点的界限，从而更好地分析系统行为。
AI.method: 利用格论方法，建立连接“逻辑全集”与“行为全集”的伽罗瓦连接，通过构建见证来推导原博弈与对偶博弈的获胜策略，并实现策略与见证的相互转化。
AI.result: 成功构建了不动点博弈的见证理论，证明了策略与见证的对应关系，并将该理论应用于标准互模拟、行为度量以及马尔可夫链终止概率下界认证。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了在格论框架下，不动点博弈的策略与逻辑见证是等价的，并展示了该理论在验证概率系统属性方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 我们构建了可用于推导不动点博弈策略的见证，并证明了函数的最小不动点要么高于，要么不低于某个给定的界。我们依赖于格论方法，包括一个连接代表“逻辑全集”（见证存在于此）的格与代表“行为全集”（函数定义于此）的另一个格的伽罗瓦连接。事实上，我们考虑了两种类型的博弈——原博弈和对偶博弈，并在两种情况下都展示了如何从见证中推导出博弈的获胜策略，以及如何从策略中构造见证。这两种博弈在规则和格的基的选择方面有所不同。该理论可以实例化为众所周知的例子：特别是我们将其与标准互模拟和概率系统行为度量中区分公式的构造进行了比较。作为新的案例研究，我们考虑了用于认证马尔可夫链终止概率下界的见证。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于格论的不动点博弈见证构造方法。通过引入伽罗瓦连接，连接逻辑与行为两个层面，实现了博弈策略与逻辑见证之间的相互转换，并将其成功应用于概率系统的验证与马尔可夫链的分析。
AI.keywords: 不动点博弈, 格论, 伽罗瓦连接, 策略, 概率系统
AI.comments: 该论文通过格论和伽罗瓦连接，将博弈论中的策略与逻辑证明中的见证（witnesses）联系起来，为解决不动点博弈提供了一种统一的理论框架。其创新点在于能够系统地从见证导出策略，反之亦然，并成功应用于概率系统及马尔可夫链的终止概率下界认证，具有很高的理论价值和实际意义。

title: Disentangled Latent Dynamics Manifold Fusion for Solving Parameterized PDEs
summary: Generalizing neural surrogate models across different PDE parameters remains difficult because changes in PDE coefficients often make learning harder and optimization less stable. The problem becomes even more severe when the model must also predict beyond the training time range. Existing methods usually cannot handle parameter generalization and temporal extrapolation at the same time. Standard parameterized models treat time as just another input and therefore fail to capture intrinsic dynamics, while recent continuous-time latent methods often rely on expensive test-time auto-decoding for each instance, which is inefficient and can disrupt continuity across the parameterized solution space. To address this, we propose Disentangled Latent Dynamics Manifold Fusion (DLDMF), a physics-informed framework that explicitly separates space, time, and parameters. Instead of unstable auto-decoding, DLDMF maps PDE parameters directly to a continuous latent embedding through a feed-forward network. This embedding initializes and conditions a latent state whose evolution is governed by a parameter-conditioned Neural ODE. We further introduce a dynamic manifold fusion mechanism that uses a shared decoder to combine spatial coordinates, parameter embeddings, and time-evolving latent states to reconstruct the corresponding spatiotemporal solution. By modeling prediction as latent dynamic evolution rather than static coordinate fitting, DLDMF reduces interference between parameter variation and temporal evolution while preserving a smooth and coherent solution manifold. As a result, it performs well on unseen parameter settings and in long-term temporal extrapolation. Experiments on several benchmark problems show that DLDMF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in accuracy, parameter generalization, and extrapolation robustness.

title: SGMatch: Semantic-Guided Non-Rigid Shape Matching with Flow Regularization
comments: 29 pages, 13 figures, 17 tables. Project Page: https://yetianwei.github.io/SGMatch/
summary: Establishing accurate point-to-point correspondences between non-rigid 3D shapes remains a critical challenge, particularly under non-isometric deformations and topological noise. Existing functional map pipelines suffer from ambiguities that geometric descriptors alone cannot resolve, and spatial inconsistencies inherent in the projection of truncated spectral bases to dense pointwise correspondences. In this paper, we introduce SGMatch, a learning-based framework that couples 3D-lifted semantic cues with trajectory-level feature transport regularization. Specifically, we design a Semantic-Guided Local Cross-Attention module that integrates semantic features from vision foundation models into geometric descriptors while preserving local structural continuity. Furthermore, we adapt conditional flow matching as a time-conditioned feature transport regularizer that promotes spatially coherent point-wise recovery. Experimental results on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that SGMatch achieves competitive performance across near-isometric settings and consistent improvements under non-isometric deformations and topological noise.
comment: 29 pages, 13 figures, 17 tables. Project Page: https://yetianwei.github.io/SGMatch/

AI.title_translation: SGMatch：基于语义引导与流正则化的非刚性形状匹配
AI.tldr: SGMatch 是一种结合了视觉语义信息和条件流正则化的新型 3D 非刚性形状匹配框架，有效解决了传统方法在应对非等距形变和拓扑噪声时的匹配精度问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的功能映射方法在处理非等距形变和拓扑噪声时，仅依赖几何描述子会导致匹配模糊，且将截断谱基投影到稠密点对应关系时存在空间不一致性。
AI.method: 提出 SGMatch 框架，包含两个核心模块：一是语义引导的局部交叉注意力模块（Semantic-Guided Local Cross-Attention），将视觉基础模型的语义特征融入几何描述子；二是基于条件流匹配的特征传输正则化器，用于提升点对点匹配的空间一致性。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，SGMatch 在近等距场景下表现出竞争优势，并在面对非等距形变和拓扑噪声时表现出显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: SGMatch 通过整合语义先验和流正则化，显著提升了在非等距形变和拓扑噪声干扰下的非刚性形状匹配精度，验证了该方法的鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.translation: 在非刚性 3D 形状之间建立准确的点对点对应关系仍然是一个关键挑战，特别是在非等距形变和存在拓扑噪声的情况下。现有的功能映射流程存在仅靠几何描述子无法解决的模糊性，以及在将截断谱基投影到稠密点对应关系时固有的空间不一致性。在本文中，我们引入了 SGMatch，这是一个基于学习的框架，它将 3D 提升后的语义线索与轨迹级特征传输正则化相结合。具体而言，我们设计了一个语义引导的局部交叉注意力模块，该模块将来自视觉基础模型的语义特征集成到几何描述子中，同时保持局部结构的连续性。此外，我们采用了条件流匹配作为时间条件特征传输正则化器，以促进空间连贯的点对点恢复。在多个基准测试上的实验结果表明，SGMatch 在近等距设置下实现了具有竞争力的性能，并在非等距形变和拓扑噪声下实现了持续的性能提升。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 SGMatch 的学习框架，旨在解决非刚性 3D 形状匹配中的挑战。该方法通过引入语义引导的局部交叉注意力模块，利用视觉基础模型的语义信息增强几何特征，并采用条件流匹配作为正则化手段，确保了点对应关系在空间上的连贯性，从而在复杂形变和噪声条件下实现了更精确的匹配。
AI.keywords: 非刚性形状匹配, 语义引导, 条件流匹配, 3D 几何, 视觉基础模型
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将视觉基础模型中的语义信息与非刚性形状匹配结合，并引入条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）作为正则化手段，有效解决了传统方法在处理非等距形变和拓扑噪声时的局限性。此方法为解决形状匹配中的模糊性和空间不一致性提供了新的思路。

title: PhaseJumps: fast computation of zeros from planar grid samples
comments: 40 pages, 9 figures. Minor corrections and update code
summary:
We consider complex-valued functions on the complex plane and the task of computing their zeros from samples taken along a finite grid. We introduce PhaseJumps, an algorithm based on comparing changes in the complex phase and local oscillations among neighboring grid points. The algorithm is applicable to possibly non-analytic input functions, and also computes the direction of phase winding around zeros.
  PhaseJumps provides a first effective means to compute the zeros of the short-time Fourier transform of an analog signal with respect to a general analysis window, and makes certain recent signal processing insights more widely applicable, overcoming previous constraints to analytic transformations. We study the performance of (a variant of) PhaseJumps under a stochastic input model motivated by signal processing applications and show that the input instances that may cause the algorithm to fail are fragile, in the sense that they are regularized by additive noise (smoothed analysis). Precisely, given samples of a function on a grid with spacing $δ$, we show that our algorithm computes zeros with accuracy $\sqrtδ$ in the Wasserstein metric with failure probability $O\big(\log^2(\tfrac{1}δ) δ\big)$, while numerical experiments suggest even better performance.
comment: 40 pages, 9 figures. Minor corrections and update code

AI.title_translation: PhaseJumps：从平面网格样本中快速计算零点的方法
AI.tldr: PhaseJumps是一种从平面网格采样中快速、稳健地定位复函数零点的新算法，特别适用于处理非解析函数和信号处理中的短时傅里叶变换。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决从有限网格采样中计算复函数零点的计算问题，特别是克服现有方法仅限于解析变换的局限性，使其能应用于短时傅里叶变换等更广泛的信号处理场景。
AI.method: 提出PhaseJumps算法，通过比较相邻网格点间的复相位变化和局部振荡来识别零点，并利用平滑分析方法验证了算法在噪声干扰下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在Wasserstein度量下，算法以 $\sqrt{\delta}$ 的精度计算零点，且失败概率受 $O(\log^2(1/\delta) \delta)$ 约束，数值实验表现优于理论预期。
AI.conclusion: PhaseJumps 是一种高效且鲁棒的从平面网格采样计算复函数零点的算法，在信号处理领域具有重要的应用价值。
AI.translation: 我们考虑复平面上的复数值函数，以及根据有限网格上的采样计算其零点的任务。我们引入了PhaseJumps算法，这是一种基于比较相邻网格点之间的复相位变化和局部振荡的算法。该算法适用于可能的非解析输入函数，并能计算零点周围的相位缠绕方向。PhaseJumps为计算模拟信号相对于通用分析窗的短时傅里叶变换的零点提供了一种首选的有效方法，使得某些近期的信号处理见解得到更广泛的应用，克服了以往对解析变换的限制。我们研究了受信号处理应用启发的随机输入模型下（该算法的变体）的性能，并表明可能导致算法失败的输入实例是脆弱的，即它们可以通过加性噪声（平滑分析）进行正则化。准确地说，给定网格间距为 $\delta$ 的函数采样，我们证明了我们的算法在 Wasserstein 度量下以 $\sqrt{\delta}$ 的精度计算零点，失效概率为 $O(\log^2(1/\delta) \delta)$，而数值实验表明其性能甚至更好。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了PhaseJumps算法，这是一种用于从平面网格采样中计算复函数零点的高效方法。该算法通过分析相邻网格点的相位变化和振荡，能够处理非解析函数并确定相位缠绕方向，特别适用于短时傅里叶变换的零点分析。通过平滑分析，证明了该算法在噪声存在下具有良好的鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.keywords: 复函数, 零点计算, 相位缠绕, 短时傅里叶变换, 平滑分析
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的算法PhaseJumps，解决了从平面网格样本中计算复函数零点的难题。其核心优势在于适用于非解析函数，并能计算相位缠绕方向，这为短时傅里叶变换的零点分析提供了有效工具。平滑分析（smoothed analysis）的使用增强了结果的理论说服力。

title: Efficient Federated Conformal Prediction with Group-Conditional Guarantee
summary: Deploying trustworthy AI systems requires principled uncertainty quantification. Conformal prediction (CP) is a widely used framework for constructing prediction sets with distribution-free coverage guarantees. In many practical settings, including healthcare, finance, and mobile sensing, the calibration data required for CP are distributed across multiple clients, each with its own local data distribution. In this federated setting, data can often be partitioned into, potentially overlapping, groups, which may reflect client-specific strata or cross-cutting attributes such as demographic or semantic categories. We propose group-conditional federated conformal prediction (GC-FCP), a federated extension of conditional conformal calibration for a target mixture over prespecified groups. GC-FCP constructs mergeable, atom-stratified coresets from local calibration scores, enabling compact aggregation at the server when the number of active atoms is moderate. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets validate the performance of GC-FCP compared to centralized calibration baselines. The code of our work can be found at https://github.com/HaifengWen/GC-FCP.

title: EPOFusion: Exposure aware Progressive Optimization Method for Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
summary: Overexposure caused by strong daylight and oncoming headlights frequently overwhelms visible sensors, resulting in critical information loss in visual perception. Infrared and visible image fusion can compensate for such degradation via multimodal complementarity. However, most fusion methods lack region-aware optimization for overexposed areas and cannot effectively exploit infrared cues in saturated regions, resulting in insufficient infrared detail preservation or redundant information in the fused results. To address this, we propose EPOFusion, an exposure-aware fusion framework. It uses a spatial guidance module to selectively preserve informative infrared cues in overexposed regions. In addition, an iterative decoding head equipped with a multiscale context fusion module progressively refines fused representations, enabling effective infrared compensation in degraded regions while maintaining visual consistency in normal regions. The infrared and visible overexposure (IVOE) dataset is constructed with a synthetic training subset for controlled supervision and a real-world test subset for generalization assessment, supporting exposure-aware learning and evaluation. Extensive experiments on MSRS, FMB, and the proposed IVOE benchmark show that EPOFusion improves information preservation and visual fidelity, achieving an average full-image MI gain of 28.7% over the best competing methods. Qualitative results further demonstrate effective compensation in saturated regions, and downstream evaluations confirm its benefits under challenging overexposed conditions. Code, results, and the IVOE dataset will be made available at https://github.com/warren-wzw/EPOFusion.

AI.title_translation: EPOFusion：一种用于红外与可见光图像融合的曝光感知渐进式优化方法
AI.tldr: EPOFusion 是一种新型图像融合框架，通过感知过曝区域并利用红外信息进行渐进式补偿，有效解决了强光下可见光传感器信息丢失的问题。
AI.motivation: 强光环境下可见光传感器易产生过曝，导致关键信息丢失。现有融合方法缺乏对过曝区域的区域感知优化，无法有效利用红外信息补偿过曝区域，导致融合结果中红外细节保留不足或存在冗余信息。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为EPOFusion的曝光感知融合框架，包含空间引导模块（用于在过曝区域选择性保留红外信息）和带有多尺度上下文融合模块的迭代解码头（用于渐进式细化融合表示）。此外，构建了红外与可见光过曝（IVOE）数据集用于训练与评估。
AI.result: 在MSRS、FMB及IVOE数据集上的实验表明，EPOFusion在信息保留和视觉保真度方面表现优异，MI（互信息）指标较现有最佳方法平均提升28.7%，在下游任务中也表现出显著优势。
AI.conclusion: EPOFusion 框架成功解决了可见光传感器在强光下的过曝问题，通过空间引导和渐进式优化，显著提升了融合图像在过曝区域的信息保留能力和整体视觉一致性。
AI.translation: 强日光和迎面而来的前照灯导致的过曝经常使可见光传感器不堪重负，导致视觉感知中关键信息的丢失。红外与可见光图像融合可以通过多模态互补来补偿这种退化。然而，大多数融合方法缺乏针对过曝区域的区域感知优化，无法有效利用红外线索来处理饱和区域，导致融合结果中红外细节保留不足或存在冗余信息。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 EPOFusion，这是一个曝光感知的融合框架。它使用空间引导模块来选择性地保留过曝区域中信息丰富的红外线索。此外，配备多尺度上下文融合模块的迭代解码头可以渐进地细化融合表示，从而在退化区域实现有效的红外补偿，同时保持正常区域的视觉一致性。红外与可见光过曝（IVOE）数据集被构建出来，其中包含用于受控监督的合成训练子集和用于泛化评估的真实世界测试子集，以支持曝光感知学习和评估。在 MSRS、FMB 和所提出的 IVOE 基准上的广泛实验表明，EPOFusion 提高了信息保留和视觉保真度，平均全图像 MI 比最佳竞争方法提高了 28.7%。定性结果进一步证明了其在饱和区域的有效补偿，下游评估证实了其在具有挑战性的过曝条件下的优势。代码、结果和 IVOE 数据集将在 https://github.com/warren-wzw/EPOFusion 上提供。
AI.summary: EPOFusion 是一种针对可见光过曝问题的红外与可见光融合框架。该方法通过空间引导模块和渐进式迭代解码策略，实现了过曝区域的有效红外补偿与图像视觉一致性的平衡，并通过构建专项IVOE数据集验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 红外与可见光图像融合, 曝光感知, 渐进式优化, 图像恢复, IVOE数据集
AI.comments: 该研究通过针对性地解决过曝区域信息丢失问题，填补了现有红外与可见光融合技术在极端光照条件下的不足。其创新点在于引入了曝光感知机制与迭代优化策略，不仅提升了融合图像的视觉质量，还通过构建IVOE数据集为该领域的研究提供了重要的评估基准。

title: Adaptive Contracts for Cost-Effective AI Delegation
summary: When organizations delegate text generation tasks to AI providers via pay-for-performance contracts, expected payments rise when evaluation is noisy. As evaluation methods become more elaborate, the economic benefits of decreased noise are often overshadowed by increased evaluation costs. In this work, we introduce adaptive contracts for AI delegation, which allow detailed evaluation to be performed selectively after observing an initial coarse signal in order to conserve resources. We make three sets of contributions: First, we provide efficient algorithms for computing optimal adaptive contracts under natural assumptions or when core problem dimensions are small, and prove hardness of approximation in the general unstructured case. We then formulate alternative models of randomized adaptive contracts and discuss their benefits and limitations. Finally, we empirically demonstrate the benefits of adaptivity over non-adaptive baselines using question-answering and code-generation datasets.

AI.title_translation: 用于成本效益AI委托的自适应合约
AI.tldr: 通过引入自适应合约，根据初步评估结果有选择地进行深入评价，从而在降低评估成本的同时维持AI任务委托的经济效益。
AI.motivation: 在AI任务委托中，评估噪声会导致支付成本上升，而现有的精细评估方法往往因成本过高而抵消了减少噪声带来的经济效益，需要一种更经济的机制。
AI.method: 提出自适应合约框架，允许在观察到初步粗略信号后，有选择地进行详细评估；设计了计算最优自适应合约的有效算法，并构建了随机化自适应合约模型。
AI.result: 实验证明，相比非自适应基线模型，自适应合约在问答和代码生成任务中表现出显著的成本效益优势；同时分析了该问题的计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 自适应合约通过选择性评估策略，能够有效降低AI委托任务中的评估成本，并在保持性能的同时实现更具成本效益的激励机制。
AI.translation: 当组织通过按绩效付费的合同将文本生成任务委托给AI提供商时，当评估存在噪声时，预期支付会增加。随着评估方法的日益复杂，减少噪声所带来的经济效益往往被增加的评估成本所掩盖。在这项工作中，我们引入了用于AI委托的自适应合约，允许在观察到初始粗略信号后，有选择地执行详细评估，以节省资源。我们做出了三方面的贡献：首先，我们提供了在自然假设下或核心问题维度较小时计算最优自适应合约的有效算法，并证明了一般非结构化情况下近似的难度。然后，我们制定了随机自适应合约的替代模型，并讨论了它们的优点和局限性。最后，我们使用问答和代码生成数据集，实证证明了自适应性相对于非自适应基线的优势。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于AI委托的自适应合约机制，旨在通过初步筛选和有选择的详细评估来平衡评估噪声与成本。研究不仅提供了最优合约的计算算法，还通过实证分析验证了其在降低成本方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: AI委托, 自适应合约, 激励机制, 评估成本, 文本生成
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入“自适应合约”机制，巧妙地平衡了AI评估的准确性与成本开销。创新点在于将序列决策思想应用于AI任务委托，为解决AI评估中的噪声与成本困境提供了经济学视角下的解决方案，具有极高的实用价值。

title: DriveVLM-RL: Neuroscience-Inspired Reinforcement Learning with Vision-Language Models for Safe and Deployable Autonomous Driving
summary: Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) methods rely on manually engineered rewards or sparse collision signals, which fail to capture the rich contextual understanding required for safe driving and make unsafe exploration unavoidable in real-world settings. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) offer promising semantic understanding capabilities; however, their high inference latency and susceptibility to hallucination hinder direct application to real-time vehicle control. To address these limitations, this paper proposes DriveVLM-RL, a neuroscience-inspired framework that integrates VLMs into RL through a dual-pathway architecture for safe and deployable autonomous driving. Inspired by the human brain's habitual and deliberative visual processing, DriveVLM-RL decomposes semantic reward learning into a Static Pathway for continuous spatial safety assessment via CLIP-based contrasting language goals, and a Dynamic Pathway for attention-gated multi-frame semantic risk reasoning via a lightweight detection model and large VLM (LVLM). A hierarchical reward synthesis mechanism fuses these signals with vehicle state information, while an asynchronous training pipeline decouples expensive LVLM inference from environment interaction. Critically, all VLM components operate exclusively during offline training and are completely removed at deployment, eliminating inference latency at test time. Extensive experiments in the CARLA simulator demonstrate that DriveVLM-RL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in collision avoidance and task success, attaining the highest success rate while reducing collision severity from 10.09 to 1.75 km/h relative to the strongest VLM-based baseline. The demo video, code, and model checkpoints are available at: https://zilin-huang.github.io/DriveVLM-RL-website/

title: GenHOI: Generalized Hand-Object Pose Estimation with Occlusion Awareness
summary: Generalized 3D hand-object pose estimation from a single RGB image remains challenging due to the large variations in object appearances and interaction patterns, especially under heavy occlusion. We propose GenHOI, a framework for generalized hand-object pose estimation with occlusion awareness. GenHOI integrates hierarchical semantic knowledge with hand priors to enhance model generalization under challenging occlusion conditions. Specifically, we introduce a hierarchical semantic prompt that encodes object states, hand configurations, and interaction patterns via textual descriptions. This enables the model to learn abstract high-level representations of hand-object interactions for generalization to unseen objects and novel interactions while compensating for missing or ambiguous visual cues. To enable robust occlusion reasoning, we adopt a multi-modal masked modeling strategy over RGB images, predicted point clouds, and textual descriptions. Moreover, we leverage hand priors as stable spatial references to extract implicit interaction constraints. This allows reliable pose inference even under significant variations in object shapes and interaction patterns. Extensive experiments on the challenging DexYCB and HO3Dv2 benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in hand-object pose estimation.

AI.title_translation: GenHOI：具有遮挡感知能力的广义手-物姿态估计
AI.tldr: GenHOI通过引入语义提示和多模态掩码建模，有效解决了单目图像中手-物交互在遮挡情况下的姿态估计难题，实现了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 从单张RGB图像进行手-物姿态估计时，面对物体外观多样性、交互模式复杂性以及严重遮挡情况，现有方法泛化能力不足，难以准确推断姿态。
AI.method: 提出GenHOI框架，主要包含：1. 层级化语义提示（Hierarchical Semantic Prompt），编码物体状态、手部配置及交互模式；2. 多模态掩码建模策略，针对RGB图像、点云和文本进行联合学习；3. 利用手部先验作为空间参考，提取隐含的交互约束。
AI.result: 在DexYCB和HO3Dv2数据集上的实验表明，GenHOI在手-物姿态估计任务中取得了当前最优（SOTA）的性能。
AI.conclusion: GenHOI通过整合语义知识、手部先验及多模态掩码建模，在处理遮挡手-物交互姿态估计任务上达到了当前最优水平，证明了该框架在复杂场景下的鲁棒性与泛化性。
AI.translation: 从单张RGB图像进行广义三维手-物姿态估计，由于物体外观和交互模式的巨大变化，特别是在严重遮挡下，仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了GenHOI，一个具有遮挡感知能力的广义手-物姿态估计框架。GenHOI集成了层级化语义知识和手部先验，以增强模型在复杂遮挡条件下的泛化能力。具体而言，我们引入了一种层级化语义提示，通过文本描述对物体状态、手部配置和交互模式进行编码。这使得模型能够学习手-物交互的抽象高层表示，从而泛化到未见过的物体和新颖的交互中，同时弥补缺失或模糊的视觉线索。为了实现稳健的遮挡推理，我们在RGB图像、预测点云和文本描述上采用了多模态掩码建模策略。此外，我们利用手部先验作为稳定的空间参考来提取隐含的交互约束。这使得即使在物体形状和交互模式发生显著变化的情况下，也能进行可靠的姿态推断。在具有挑战性的DexYCB和HO3Dv2基准测试上的大量实验表明，我们的方法在手-物姿态估计方面达到了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: GenHOI是一个用于手-物姿态估计的遮挡感知框架。它利用层级化语义提示和多模态掩码建模，将文本信息、视觉特征与手部先验相结合，从而在严重遮挡及未见过的交互场景下，实现了稳健且高精度的姿态推断。
AI.keywords: 手-物交互, 姿态估计, 遮挡感知, 语义提示, 多模态建模
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入层级化语义提示（Hierarchical Semantic Prompt）和多模态掩码建模策略，有效解决了手-物交互中因遮挡导致的视觉信息缺失问题。其创新点在于利用文本描述作为高层抽象特征来弥补视觉模糊性，并结合手部先验约束，在未见过的物体和交互模式上表现出良好的泛化能力，是手-物交互领域的重要进展。

title: Under One Sun: Multi-Object Generative Perception of Materials and Illumination
summary: We introduce Multi-Object Generative Perception (MultiGP), a generative inverse rendering method for stochastic sampling of all radiometric constituents -- reflectance, texture, and illumination -- underlying object appearance from a single image. Our key idea to solve this inherently ambiguous radiometric disentanglement is to leverage the fact that while their texture and reflectance may differ, objects in the same scene are all lit by the same illumination. MultiGP exploits this consensus to produce samples of reflectance, texture, and illumination from a single image of known shapes based on four key technical contributions: a cascaded end-to-end architecture that combines image-space and angular-space disentanglement; Coordinated Scheduling for diffusion convergence to a single consistent illumination estimate; Axial Attention applied to facilitate ``cross-talk'' between objects of different reflectance; and a Texture Extraction ControlNet to preserve high-frequency texture details while ensuring decoupling from estimated lighting. Experimental results demonstrate that MultiGP effectively leverages the complementary spatial and frequency characteristics of multiple object appearances to recover individual texture and reflectance as well as the common illumination.

AI.title_translation: 同一阳光下：基于多物体的材质与光照生成式感知
AI.tldr: MultiGP 是一种通过利用场景内物体共享光照的共识，从单张图像中同时恢复物体纹理、反射率和场景照明的生成式逆渲染方法。
AI.motivation: 从单张图像中恢复物体的反射率、纹理和光照是一个极具挑战性的病态逆问题，因为这些因素在图像中往往是耦合的且具有高度不确定性。作者旨在利用场景中多个物体共享同一光源这一先验信息，来解决这一歧义性解耦问题。
AI.method: 提出 MultiGP 架构，包含四个核心技术：1. 结合图像空间与角度空间的级联端到端架构；2. 用于实现一致性光照估计的协同调度（Coordinated Scheduling）；3. 用于物体间信息交换的轴向注意力机制（Axial Attention）；4. 用于保持高频纹理细节并确保其与光照解耦的纹理提取 ControlNet。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，MultiGP 能够利用多个物体在空间和频率特征上的互补性，从单张图像中有效恢复出每个物体的纹理和反射率，以及场景共同的光照信息。
AI.conclusion: MultiGP 成功证明了利用多物体共享光照的共识，可以有效解决单图逆渲染中材质与照明的解耦难题，为从单张图像恢复复杂场景属性提供了鲁棒的生成式方案。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了多物体生成式感知（MultiGP），这是一种生成式逆渲染方法，用于从单张图像中对物体外观背后的所有辐射成分（反射率、纹理和照明）进行随机采样。我们解决这种内在模糊的辐射解耦的关键思想是利用这样一个事实：尽管物体在纹理和反射率上可能不同，但同一场景中的物体都受到相同的光照。MultiGP 利用这一共识，基于四个关键技术贡献，从已知形状的单张图像中生成反射率、纹理和照明样本：一种结合了图像空间和角度空间解耦的级联端到端架构；用于扩散收敛到单一一致照明估计的协同调度；用于促进不同反射率物体之间“串扰”的轴向注意力机制；以及一种纹理提取 ControlNet，在确保与估计照明解耦的同时保留高频纹理细节。实验结果表明，MultiGP 有效地利用了多个物体外观的互补空间和频率特征，以恢复单个纹理和反射率以及共同的照明。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 MultiGP 的生成式逆渲染方法，旨在从单张图像中恢复物体的反射率、纹理和光照。通过利用场景内所有物体共享同一光源这一关键先验，MultiGP 使用级联架构、协同调度、轴向注意力机制和纹理提取 ControlNet，成功解耦并生成了物体外观的各个组成部分。
AI.keywords: 逆渲染, 多物体感知, 生成式模型, 材质解耦, 光照估计
AI.comments: 该研究通过利用场景内共享光源这一物理先验，巧妙地解决了单图逆渲染中的歧义性问题。其创新点在于将多物体协同生成与解耦相结合，通过级联架构、联合调度和注意力机制，实现了对材质和光照的高质量恢复，是计算机视觉领域生成式逆渲染的重要进展。

title: Dynamic analysis enhances issue resolution
summary:
Resolving complex code defects from natural language descriptions remains a fundamental software engineering challenge. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have driven the creation of agent-based automated repair systems. While improving repository-level problem-solving, current methods struggle with complex defects like intricate polymorphic control flows and implicit type degradation. These approaches rely on static analysis and shallow execution feedback, lacking the ability to monitor intermediate execution states. Consequently, agents often fall into speculative exploration, consuming significant tokens without identifying the root cause.
  We introduce DAIRA (Dynamic Analysis-enhanced Issue Resolution Agent), a pioneering automated repair framework deeply embedding dynamic analysis into the agent's decision loop. DAIRA employs a Test Tracing-Driven workflow, using lightweight tools to capture runtime evidence (e.g., call stacks and variable states) and convert it into structured semantic reports. By illuminating execution paths and causal dependencies, DAIRA enables precise fault localization and prevents context window flooding from irrelevant code retrievals. This shifts the agent's approach from speculative reasoning to deterministic inference.
  Evaluations on the SWE-bench Verified benchmark show DAIRA achieves a state-of-the-art 79.4% resolution rate when powered by Gemini 3 Flash Preview. Furthermore, it demonstrates robustness in addressing deep-seated logical defects, securing a 44.4% resolution rate on the most demanding tasks. Compared to baselines, DAIRA uniquely resolves complex edge cases and improves operational efficiency. Across various LLMs, it reduces inference costs by approximately 10% and input token consumption by 25%.

AI.title_translation: 动态分析增强问题解决能力
AI.tldr: DAIRA通过在AI代码修复Agent中引入运行时动态分析，实现了从“盲目试错”到“精准推理”的转变，大幅提升了复杂缺陷的修复率并降低了Token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于LLM的自动化修复系统主要依赖静态分析和浅层执行反馈，在处理复杂的多态控制流和隐式类型退化等缺陷时，往往陷入盲目的推测性探索，导致资源浪费且难以定位根因。
AI.method: 提出DAIRA框架，采用测试跟踪驱动的工作流，利用轻量级工具捕获运行时调用栈和变量状态等证据，将其转化为结构化语义报告，从而辅助Agent进行精确的故障定位。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified基准测试中，DAIRA实现了79.4%的整体修复率，在最困难任务上达到44.4%；同时相比基准方法，推理成本降低约10%，输入Token消耗减少25%。
AI.conclusion: DAIRA框架通过引入动态分析证据，成功将自动化代码修复从推测性推理转变为确定性推理，显著提升了处理复杂缺陷的能力和效率。
AI.translation: 从自然语言描述中解决复杂的代码缺陷仍然是软件工程的一项基本挑战。最近，大型语言模型（LLMs）推动了基于代理的自动化修复系统的创建。虽然提高了存储库层面的问题解决能力，但现有方法在处理复杂的缺陷（如复杂的多态控制流和隐式类型退化）时仍存在困难。这些方法依赖于静态分析和浅层执行反馈，缺乏监控中间执行状态的能力。因此，代理往往陷入推测性探索，在未找到根本原因的情况下消耗大量Token。我们引入了DAIRA（动态分析增强的问题解决代理），这是一个开创性的自动化修复框架，将动态分析深度嵌入到代理的决策循环中。DAIRA采用测试跟踪驱动的工作流，使用轻量级工具捕获运行时证据（如调用栈和变量状态），并将其转换为结构化的语义报告。通过阐明执行路径和因果依赖关系，DAIRA实现了精确的故障定位，并防止了因无关代码检索导致的上下文窗口溢出。这使代理的方法从推测性推理转变为确定性推理。在SWE-bench Verified基准上的评估表明，当由Gemini 3 Flash Preview驱动时，DAIRA达到了79.4%的SOTA分辨率。此外，它在处理深层逻辑缺陷方面表现出鲁棒性，在最苛刻的任务上获得了44.4%的解决率。与基准相比，DAIRA独特地解决了复杂的边缘情况并提高了运营效率。在各种LLM中，它将推理成本降低了约10%，输入Token消耗降低了25%。
AI.summary: DAIRA是一种新型自动化修复框架，通过将动态分析深度融入Agent决策循环，利用运行时证据进行确定性推理，有效解决了复杂代码缺陷修复中的推测性偏差，在提升修复成功率的同时显著优化了计算效率。
AI.keywords: 自动化代码修复, 大型语言模型, 动态分析, 故障定位, 软件工程
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将动态分析（运行时证据捕获）深度集成到基于LLM的自动化修复Agent的决策循环中，而非仅仅依赖静态分析。这种方法有效地解决了传统Agent在处理复杂逻辑缺陷时的盲目试错问题，显著提升了修复成功率并降低了推理成本。其局限性在于对测试用例的依赖以及动态分析带来的额外运行时开销。

title: CaP-X: A Framework for Benchmarking and Improving Coding Agents for Robot Manipulation
summary: "Code-as-Policy" considers how executable code can complement data-intensive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) methods, yet their effectiveness as autonomous controllers for embodied manipulation remains underexplored. We present CaP-X, an open-access framework for systematically studying Code-as-Policy agents in robot manipulation. At its core is CaP-Gym, an interactive environment in which agents control robots by synthesizing and executing programs that compose perception and control primitives. Building on this foundation, CaP-Bench evaluates frontier language and vision-language models across varying levels of abstraction, interaction, and perceptual grounding. Across 12 models, CaP-Bench reveals a consistent trend: performance improves with human-crafted abstractions but degrades as these priors are removed, exposing a dependence on designer scaffolding. At the same time, we observe that this gap can be mitigated through scaling agentic test-time computation--through multi-turn interaction, structured execution feedback, visual differencing, automatic skill synthesis, and ensembled reasoning--substantially improves robustness even when agents operate over low-level primitives. These findings allow us to derive CaP-Agent0, a training-free framework that recovers human-level reliability on several manipulation tasks in simulation and on real embodiments. We further introduce CaP-RL, showing reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves success rates and transfers from sim2real with minimal gap. Together, CaP-X provides a principled, open-access platform for advancing embodied coding agents.

title: ForeSea: AI Forensic Search with Multi-modal Queries for Video Surveillance
summary:
Despite decades of work, surveillance still struggles in searching and reasoning about specific targets across long, multi-camera videos. Existing methods - tracking, retrieval, and video LLMs require heavy manual filtering, capture only shallow attributes, and fail at temporal understanding. Prior benchmarks are also limited to basic retrieval and question answering, without addressing real world challenges that often involve multimodal queries and temporal grounding (e.g., "When did this person join the fight?" with the person's image). To address this gap, we introduce ForeSeaQA, a new benchmark specifically designed for video QA with image-and-text queries and timestamped annotations of key events. The dataset consists of long-horizon surveillance footage paired with diverse multimodal questions, enabling systematic evaluation of retrieval, temporal grounding, and multimodal reasoning in realistic forensic conditions.
  Not limited to this benchmark, we propose ForeSea, an AI forensic search system with a 3-stage, plug-and-play pipeline. (1) A tracking module filters irrelevant footage; (2) a multimodal embedding module indexes the remaining clips; and (3) during inference, the system retrieves top-K candidate clips for a video LLM to answer queries and localize events.
  On ForeSeaQA benchmark, ForeSea improves accuracy by 3.1 points and temporal IoU by 10.1 points over prior retrieval-augmented baselines. To our knowledge, ForeSeaQA is the first benchmark to support complex multimodal queries with precise temporal grounding, and ForeSea is the first VideoRAG system built to excel in this setting.

title: High-Fidelity Transcranial Ultrasound Multi-focal Stimulation via Physics-Aware Hologram Technique
comments: Accepted for publication in Brain Stimulation. This version incorporates revisions made during peer review
summary: Transcranial ultrasound stimulation (TUS) offers non-invasive deep-brain neuromodulation with high spatial precision, but reliably generating complex multi-target acoustic fields through the skull remains challenging. Here, we introduce a physics-aware hologram technique that directly generates fabrication-ready holographic implementations while preserving consistency between numerical field synthesis and physical acoustic realization. The method enables single-, dual-, and tri-focal transcranial stimulation patterns and was validated through in silico simulations, ex vivo skull measurements, and in vivo experiments. Compared with representative state-of-the-art methods, the proposed approach improved focal reconstruction and energy confinement at intended targets while reducing off-target acoustic leakage. In a neuropathic-pain mouse model, simultaneous bilateral stimulation of thalamic nuclei reduced c-Fos expression and showed preliminary improvements in pain-related behavioral responses. These findings support the use of fabrication-consistent holographic design for spatially localized and reproducible multi-target transcranial neuromodulation.
comment: Accepted for publication in Brain Stimulation. This version incorporates revisions made during peer review

AI.title_translation: 基于物理感知全息技术的经颅超声高保真多焦点刺激研究
AI.tldr: 提出了一种物理感知全息技术，实现了高精度、多焦点的经颅超声刺激，并在神经病理性疼痛模型中验证了其改善疼痛行为的效果。
AI.motivation: 经颅超声刺激虽然具有高空间精度，但在穿透颅骨实现复杂多目标声场调控时，数值模拟与物理实现之间存在偏差，导致刺激精度受限。
AI.method: 提出了一种物理感知全息技术（physics-aware hologram technique），确保数值模拟合成的声场与物理实测的一致性，支持单、双及三焦点刺激模式的设计与制造。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在焦点重建和能量聚集方面优于现有技术，显著降低了非目标区域的声泄漏。在神经病理性疼痛小鼠模型中，实现了双侧丘脑核团的同时刺激，有效降低了c-Fos表达并改善了疼痛相关行为。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知全息技术能够实现高保真、多焦点的经颅超声刺激，并在动物模型中有效改善了神经病理性疼痛，证明了该方法在空间定位神经调控中的可靠性。
AI.translation: 经颅超声刺激（TUS）提供了一种具有高空间精度的非侵入性深部脑神经调控手段，但在穿透颅骨可靠地生成复杂的多目标声场方面仍面临挑战。本文介绍了一种物理感知全息技术，该技术在保持数值场合成与物理声学实现之间一致性的同时，直接生成可用于制造的全息实现方案。该方法支持单、双和三焦点经颅刺激模式，并通过计算机模拟、离体颅骨测量和活体实验进行了验证。与现有的代表性先进方法相比，该方法改进了焦点重建和目标区域的能量约束，同时减少了非目标区域的声泄漏。在神经病理性疼痛小鼠模型中，同时对丘脑核团进行双侧刺激降低了c-Fos的表达，并显示出疼痛相关行为反应的初步改善。这些发现支持使用制造一致性的全息设计来实现空间定位和可重复的多目标经颅神经调控。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种物理感知全息技术，用于生成高保真的多焦点经颅超声刺激声场。该方法通过确保数值模拟与物理实现的一致性，提升了刺激的目标聚焦精度并减少了非目标区域的声损伤。通过模拟、离体颅骨测量及活体实验验证，证实了该技术在精准神经调控及缓解神经病理性疼痛方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 经颅超声刺激, 物理感知全息, 多焦点调控, 神经调控, 声场合成
AI.comments: 该研究通过结合物理感知模型与全息技术，解决了经颅超声刺激中复杂声场合成与实际物理实现不一致的核心难题。其创新性在于实现了“所见即所得”的声场制造，为神经调控的精准化提供了强有力的工具，具有很高的临床转化潜力和科学价值。

title: COVTrack++: Learning Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking from Continuous Videos via a Synergistic Paradigm
summary: Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) has traditionally focused on a few specific categories, restricting its applicability to real-world scenarios involving diverse objects. Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking (OVMOT) addresses this by enabling tracking of arbitrary categories, including novel objects unseen during training. However, current progress is constrained by two challenges: the lack of continuously annotated video data for training, and the lack of a customized OVMOT framework to synergistically handle detection and association. We address the data bottleneck by constructing C-TAO, the first continuously annotated training set for OVMOT, which increases annotation density by 26x over the original TAO and captures smooth motion dynamics and intermediate object states. For the framework bottleneck, we propose COVTrack++, a synergistic framework that achieves a bidirectional reciprocal mechanism between detection and association through three modules: (1) Multi-Cue Adaptive Fusion (MCF) dynamically balances appearance, motion, and semantic cues for association feature learning; (2) Multi-Granularity Hierarchical Aggregation (MGA) exploits hierarchical spatial relationships in dense detections, where visible child nodes (e.g., object parts) assist occluded parent objects (e.g., whole body) for association feature enhancement; (3) Temporal Confidence Propagation (TCP) recovers flickering detections through high-confidence tracked objects boosting low-confidence candidates across frames, stabilizing trajectories. Extensive experiments on TAO demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, with novel TETA reaching 35.4% and 30.5% on validation and test sets, improving novel AssocA by 4.8% and novel LocA by 5.8% over previous methods, and show strong zero-shot generalization on BDD100K.

AI.title_translation: COVTrack++：通过协同范式从连续视频中学习开放词汇多目标跟踪
AI.tldr: 本文提出了COVTrack++，通过构建大规模连续标注数据集C-TAO和创新的检测-关联协同框架，实现了高效的开放词汇多目标跟踪，性能优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统MOT局限于特定类别，而现有OVMOT面临连续标注视频数据稀缺以及缺乏专门协同检测与关联的框架这两个关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 1. 构建了C-TAO数据集；2. 提出了COVTrack++框架，包含多线索自适应融合（MCF）、多粒度分层聚合（MGA）和时间置信度传播（TCP）三个核心模块。
AI.result: 在TAO数据集上达到了SOTA性能，novel TETA在验证集和测试集分别达到35.4%和30.5%，并显著提升了关联和定位准确率，在BDD100K上也表现出强劲的零样本泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: COVTrack++通过协同检测与关联机制，有效解决了开放词汇多目标跟踪中的数据匮乏和框架适配问题，在多项基准测试中达到了SOTA水平，并具备强大的零样本泛化能力。
AI.translation: 多目标跟踪（MOT）传统上侧重于少数特定类别，限制了其在涉及多样化物体的现实场景中的适用性。开放词汇多目标跟踪（OVMOT）通过支持跟踪任意类别（包括训练中未见的新颖物体）解决了这一问题。然而，目前的进展受到两个挑战的限制：缺乏用于训练的连续标注视频数据，以及缺乏用于协同处理检测和关联的定制化OVMOT框架。我们通过构建C-TAO来解决数据瓶颈，这是第一个用于OVMOT的连续标注训练集，其标注密度比原始TAO增加了26倍，并捕捉到了平滑的运动动态和物体的中间状态。针对框架瓶颈，我们提出了COVTrack++，这是一个协同框架，通过三个模块实现了检测与关联之间的双向互惠机制：（1）多线索自适应融合（MCF）动态平衡外观、运动和语义线索以进行关联特征学习；（2）多粒度分层聚合（MGA）利用密集检测中的分层空间关系，其中可见的子节点（如物体部件）辅助被遮挡的父对象（如全身）进行关联特征增强；（3）时间置信度传播（TCP）通过高置信度跟踪对象提升跨帧的低置信度候选对象，从而恢复闪烁检测并稳定轨迹。在TAO上的大量实验证明了其最先进的性能，新颖的TETA在验证集和测试集上分别达到35.4%和30.5%，较之前的方法在关联准确率（AssocA）和定位准确率（LocA）上分别提升了4.8%和5.8%，并显示出在BDD100K上的强大零样本泛化能力。
AI.summary: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OVMOT）的数据稀缺与框架适配难题，本文构建了高密度标注的C-TAO数据集，并提出了COVTrack++协同跟踪框架，通过MCF、MGA和TCP模块实现了检测与关联的互惠优化，显著提升了跟踪性能与泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 开放词汇多目标跟踪, 连续视频, 数据集构建, 协同机制, 零样本泛化
AI.comments: 该论文通过构建新的大规模连续标注数据集C-TAO解决了OVMOT的数据瓶颈，并提出了COVTrack++框架，其创新的双向互惠机制（检测与关联协同）在处理遮挡和零样本泛化方面表现出色，是开放词汇多目标跟踪领域的重要进展。

title: Formal Semantics for Agentic Tool Protocols: A Process Calculus Approach
summary: The emergence of large language model agents capable of invoking external tools has created urgent need for formal verification of agent protocols. Two paradigms dominate this space: Schema-Guided Dialogue (SGD), a research framework for zero-shot API generalization, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an industry standard for agent-tool integration. While both enable dynamic service discovery through schema descriptions, their formal relationship remains unexplored. We present the first process calculus formalization of SGD and MCP, proving they are structurally bisimilar under a well-defined mapping Phi. We demonstrate that the reverse mapping Phi-1 is partial and lossy, revealing critical gaps in MCP's expressivity. Through bidirectional analysis, we identify four principles - semantic completeness, explicit action boundaries, failure mode documentation, and inter-tool relationship declaration -- as necessary and sufficient conditions for full behavioral equivalence. We formalize these principles as type-system extensions MCP+, proving MCP+ is fully equivalent to SGD. Our work provides the first formal foundation for verified agent systems and establishes schema quality as a provable safety property. Practically, this means that the current MCP specification has expressiveness gaps compared to SGD and would benefit from the proposed extensions.

title: PASDiff: Physics-Aware Semantic Guidance for Joint Real-World Low-Light Face Enhancement and Restoration
summary: Face images captured in real-world low light suffer multiple degradations-low illumination, blur, noise, and low visibility, etc. Existing cascaded solutions often suffer from severe error accumulation, while generic joint models lack explicit facial priors and struggle to resolve clear face structures. In this paper, we propose PASDiff, a Physics-Aware Semantic Diffusion with a training-free manner. To achieve a plausible illumination and color distribution, we leverage inverse intensity weighting and Retinex theory to introduce photometric constraints, thereby reliably recovering visibility and natural chromaticity. To faithfully reconstruct facial details, our Style-Agnostic Structural Injection (SASI) extracts structures from an off-the-shelf facial prior while filtering out its intrinsic photometric biases, seamlessly harmonizing identity features with physical constraints. Furthermore, we construct WildDark-Face, a real-world benchmark of 700 low-light facial images with complex degradations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PASDiff significantly outperforms existing methods, achieving a superior balance among natural illumination, color recovery, and identity consistency. Code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/IVIPLab/PASDiff.

AI.title_translation: PASDiff：用于真实世界低光照人脸增强与修复的物理感知语义引导方法
AI.tldr: 一种无需训练的物理感知扩散模型，通过结合Retinex理论和结构注入，有效解决了真实世界低光照人脸图像的增强难题。
AI.motivation: 现有低光照人脸增强方案存在级联错误积累，且通用模型缺乏明确的面部先验，导致难以还原清晰的人脸结构和真实的色彩。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为PASDiff的物理感知语义扩散模型。通过结合Retinex理论和反向强度加权引入光度约束，并设计了Style-Agnostic Structural Injection (SASI) 模块从面部先验中提取结构特征，同时过滤掉不必要的光度偏见。此外，构建了WildDark-Face数据集进行评估。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，PASDiff在自然光照、色彩恢复和身份一致性方面均优于现有方法，且在新建的WildDark-Face基准测试中表现出色。
AI.conclusion: PASDiff通过物理感知引导和结构注入策略，在无训练前提下实现了高质量的低光照人脸增强，并在构建的新基准测试中表现卓越。
AI.translation: 真实世界中拍摄的人脸图像常受到低照度、模糊、噪声和低可见度等多种退化影响。现有的级联方案往往会出现严重的误差累积，而通用的联合模型缺乏明确的人脸先验，难以解析清晰的人脸结构。在本文中，我们提出了一种无需训练的物理感知语义扩散模型——PASDiff。为了实现合理的光照和色彩分布，我们利用反向强度加权和Retinex理论引入光度约束，从而可靠地恢复可见度和自然的色彩。为了忠实地重建面部细节，我们的风格无关结构注入（SASI）模块从现成的面部先验中提取结构，同时过滤掉其内在的光度偏差，将身份特征与物理约束无缝融合。此外，我们构建了WildDark-Face，这是一个包含700张具有复杂退化的真实世界低光照人脸图像的基准数据集。大量实验表明，PASDiff显著优于现有方法，在自然光照、色彩恢复和身份一致性之间取得了卓越的平衡。代码和数据集可在 https://github.com/IVIPLab/PASDiff 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为PASDiff的无训练物理感知语义扩散模型，专门用于解决真实场景下低光照人脸图像的增强与修复。该模型通过物理约束恢复光照，并利用结构注入机制精确还原面部细节，有效提升了图像的清晰度与身份一致性。
AI.keywords: 低光照人脸增强, 扩散模型, 物理感知, 结构注入, 图像恢复
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将物理模型（Retinex理论）与扩散模型相结合，通过无需训练的引导机制解决低光照人脸增强问题，有效地解决了传统方法中常见的错误积累和面部特征丢失问题。其提出的SASI模块在保留结构信息的同时去除了偏见，具有很强的实用价值。

title: Proofdoors and Efficiency of CDCL Solvers
summary:
We propose a new parameter called proofdoor in an attempt to explain the efficiency of CDCL SAT solvers over formulas derived from circuit (esp., arithmetic) verification applications. Informally, given an unsatisfiable CNF formula F over n variables, a proofdoor decomposition consists of a chunking of the clauses into A1, . . . , Ak together with a sequence of interpolants connecting these chunks. Intuitively, a proofdoor captures the idea that an unsatisfiable formula can be refuted by reasoning chunk by chunk, while maintaining only a summary of the information (i.e., interpolants) gained so far for subsequent reasoning steps.
  We prove several theorems in support of the proposition that proofdoors can explain the efficiency of CDCL solvers for some class of circuit verification problems. First, we show that formulas with small proofdoors (i.e., where each interpolant is O(n) sized, each chunk Ai has small pathwidth, and each interpolant clause has at most O(log(n)) backward dependency on the previous interpolant) have short resolution (Res) proofs. Second, we show that certain configurations of CDCL solvers can compute such proofs in time polynomial in n. Third, we show that commutativity (miter) formulas over floating-point addition have small proofdoors and hence short Res proofs, even though they have large pathwidth. Fourth, we characterize the limits of the proofdoor framework by connecting proofdoors to the partially ordered resolution proof system: we show that a poor decomposition of arithmetic miter instances can force exponentially large partially ordered resolution proofs, even when a different decomposition (i.e., small proofdoors) permits short proofs.

title: A Large-Scale Comprehensive Measurement of AI-Generated Code in Real-World Repositories
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming software engineering by enabling developers to generate code ranging from small snippets to entire projects. As AI-assisted code becomes increasingly integrated into real-world systems, understanding its characteristics and impact is critical. Existing study on AI-generated code is usually limited in the lab setting with synthetic benchmarks and small-scale coding tasks and covers limited metrics. AI-assisted code's manifestation in real-world codebases and its differences between human-written one remain unclear. To close this gap, we perform a first large-scale measurement study of AI-assisted code, in comparison with the human-written, in real-world repositories. We study a comprehensive set of metrics including both code-level aspects (e.g., structural and graph-level complexity, coding style, security quality, etc.) and commit-level characteristics (e.g., commit size, frequency, post-commit stability, etc.). Our results provide new findings and insights: some contrast previous observations in the lab setting (e.g., we conclude that real-world AI-Human differences on code-level metrics are rather small instead of more pronounced), some extend prior results with finer-grained observations (e.g., the variance of security quality across different programming languages), yet more are presented for the first time on aspects not covered before (e.g., code duplication rate, commit size and stability, etc.). Based on these comprehensive real-world results, we also discuss the practical implications of AI-assisted programming.

AI.title_translation: 真实世界存储库中AI生成代码的大规模综合测量
AI.tldr: 本研究通过大规模实证分析发现，真实世界中AI生成的代码与人类代码的差距比实验室研究显示的要小。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多局限于实验室环境下的合成基准测试，缺乏对真实世界代码库中AI辅助代码表现及其与人类编写代码差异的深入了解。
AI.method: 在大规模真实世界存储库中，从代码级（结构/图形复杂度、编程风格、安全质量）和提交级（提交大小、频率、稳定性）两个维度，对比分析AI辅助代码与人类编写代码的特征。
AI.result: 发现真实世界中AI与人类代码在代码级度量上的差异较小，提供了关于不同编程语言间安全性差异的细粒度观察，并首次分析了代码重复率、提交大小和稳定性等维度。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助代码与人类编写的代码在真实世界中的差异远比实验室环境下观察到的要小。研究揭示了代码复杂度、安全性和提交特征在真实环境中的分布情况，为评估AI编程工具提供了科学依据。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）通过使开发人员能够生成从小型代码片段到整个项目的代码，正在迅速改变软件工程。随着AI辅助代码越来越多地集成到真实系统中，理解其特性和影响至关重要。现有的关于AI生成代码的研究通常局限于具有合成基准和小型编码任务的实验室设置，且涵盖的指标有限。AI辅助代码在真实代码库中的表现及其与人类编写代码之间的差异尚不清楚。为了弥补这一差距，我们对真实世界存储库中的AI辅助代码与人类编写的代码进行了首次大规模测量研究。我们研究了一套全面的指标，包括代码级方面（如结构和图形级复杂度、编码风格、安全质量等）和提交级特征（如提交大小、频率、提交后稳定性等）。我们的结果提供了新的发现和见解：一些发现与实验室环境下的先前观察结果形成对比（例如，我们得出结论，现实世界中AI与人类在代码级指标上的差异相当小，而不是更显著），一些通过更细粒度的观察扩展了先前的结果（例如，不同编程语言之间安全质量的差异），还有一些是首次在以前未涵盖的方面提出的（例如，代码重复率、提交大小和稳定性等）。基于这些全面的真实世界结果，我们还讨论了AI辅助编程的实际意义。
AI.summary: 本文对真实世界存储库中的AI辅助代码进行了首次大规模综合测量，通过对比人类编写的代码，深入分析了代码级和提交级的多维度指标，揭示了AI辅助编程在实际应用中的真实特征与影响。
AI.keywords: AI生成代码, 软件工程, 大规模测量, 代码质量, 真实世界存储库
AI.comments: 该研究通过大规模实证分析填补了实验室环境研究与真实世界开发场景之间的空白，指出了实验室结论在真实代码库中可能存在的偏差，对于理解AI辅助编程在工业界的实际表现具有重要的参考价值。

title: Spectral Method attacks Sparse LWE, Sparse LPN and Beyond
summary: Given a set of $k$-sparse linear equations over a ring $R$, we give algorithms to determine whether the right-hand sides are random or have a secret assignment planted with noise. For a parameter $k/2\leq l\leq n$, we give a spectral method to solve this problem in $\widetilde{O}\left(\binom{n}{l}\lvert{R}\rvert^l\right)$ time except with probability at most $n^{-Ω(l)}$, provided the number of samples is roughly at least $\left(\frac{\lvert{R}\rvert n}{l}\right)^{k/2}$. This attack generalizes the Kikuchi method described by Wein et. al. (Journal of the ACM 2019) for $\mathbb{Z}_2$ to (commutative) rings of any finite size. We also give a simpler algorithm with better runtime than the spectral method and better sample complexity when $\lvert{R}\rvert=ω(n/l)$. As a consequence, we obtain new sample-time tradeoffs for the decision problem of sparse LWE, sparse LPN over higher modulus $q$, and in general the distinguishing random vs planted $\mathbb{Z}_q$-linear equations for a large class of noise distributions. Our results imply a tightness of the hardness claims of Jain, Lin, Saha (Annual International Cryptology Conference, 2024) for sparse LWE.

AI.title_translation: 谱方法攻击稀疏LWE、稀疏LPN及更广范围问题
AI.tldr: 本文将稀疏线性方程组的攻击方法推广至任意有限环，并为稀疏LWE和LPN问题提供了新的安全性分析工具，验证了相关硬度声明的紧致性。
AI.motivation: 针对稀疏LWE、稀疏LPN以及更广泛的带噪声线性方程组问题，现有攻击方法在不同环结构上的通用性和效率有待提升，且需要验证相关硬度假设的紧致性。
AI.method: 利用谱方法（Spectral Method）及一种更简化的算法，通过对$k$-稀疏线性方程组进行分析，在给定的样本数量下区分随机方程组与带噪声的隐藏分配方程组。
AI.result: 提出了复杂度为$\widetilde{O}\left(\binom{n}{l}\lvert{R}\lvert^l\right)$的谱方法攻击；对于$\lvert{R}\rvert=\omega(n/l)$的情况，给出了样本复杂度更优的简化算法；证明了Jain等人在2024年提出的稀疏LWE硬度声明的紧致性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一系列针对稀疏线性方程组的攻击算法，不仅在理论上扩展了适用范围，还通过改进的算法在特定条件下实现了更好的时间复杂度和样本复杂度，对评估密码学中稀疏LWE和LPN问题的安全性具有重要意义。
AI.translation: 给定环R上的一组k-稀疏线性方程组，我们提供了算法来确定其右侧是随机的还是植入了带噪声的隐藏分配。对于参数$k/2\leq l\leq n$，我们给出了一种谱方法，在样本数至少约为$\left(\frac{\lvert{R}\rvert n}{l}\right)^{k/2}$的情况下，该方法能以至少$1-n^{-\Omega(l)}$的概率在$\widetilde{O}\left(\binom{n}{l}\lvert{R}\rvert^l\right)$时间内解决该问题。这一攻击将Wein等人（2019年ACM期刊）描述的针对$\mathbb{Z}_2$的Kikuchi方法推广到了任意有限大小的（交换）环。我们还给出了一种比谱方法运行时间更好，且当$\lvert{R}\rvert=\omega(n/l)$时样本复杂度更优的简单算法。因此，我们获得了稀疏LWE、高模数q下的稀疏LPN以及更广泛的噪声分布下区分随机与植入$\mathbb{Z}_q$-线性方程组决策问题的新样本-时间权衡。我们的结果暗示了Jain、Lin、Saha（2024年密码学年会）关于稀疏LWE硬度声明的紧致性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了任意有限交换环上的稀疏线性方程组识别问题。作者提出了一种基于谱方法的攻击算法，并将其推广至一般的环结构，同时提供了一种针对特定参数条件下更高效的简化算法，从而为稀疏LWE和LPN问题提供了新的样本-时间权衡分析。
AI.keywords: 稀疏LWE, 稀疏LPN, 谱方法, 密码分析, 样本-时间权衡
AI.comments: 该研究通过推广Kikuchi方法，成功将稀疏线性方程组的攻击范围从二元域扩展到了任意有限交换环，为评估稀疏LWE和LPN问题的安全性提供了重要的理论基准，并验证了Jain等人近期关于稀疏LWE硬度声明的紧致性。

title: MetaTune: Adjoint-based Meta-tuning via Robotic Differentiable Dynamics
summary: Disturbance observer-based control has shown promise in robustifying robotic systems against uncertainties. However, tuning such systems remains challenging due to the strong coupling between controller gains and observer parameters. In this work, we propose MetaTune, a unified framework for joint auto-tuning of feedback controllers and disturbance observers through differentiable closed-loop meta-learning. MetaTune integrates a portable neural policy with physics-informed gradients derived from differentiable system dynamics, enabling adaptive gains across tasks and operating conditions. We develop an adjoint method that efficiently computes the meta-gradients with respect to adaptive gains backward in time to directly minimize the cost-to-go. Compared to existing forward methods, our approach reduces the computational complexity to be linear in the data horizon. On quadrotor control tasks, MetaTune achieves competitive or improved tracking performance while reducing gradient computation time by more than 50\%. In PX4-Gazebo hardware-in-the-loop simulation, the learned policy transfers zero-shot and reduces tracking RMSE by about 15--20\% in aggressive flight and up to 40\% under strong disturbances.

AI.title_translation: MetaTune：基于伴随方法的机器人微分动力学元调优
AI.tldr: MetaTune 提出了一种利用微分动力学和伴随方法对机器人控制器与观测器进行高效联合调优的框架，显著提升了计算效率和复杂环境下的跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 由于机器人控制器增益与观测器参数之间存在强耦合，传统的扰动观测器控制系统调优非常困难，缺乏统一且高效的自动化方法。
AI.method: 提出 MetaTune 框架，结合便携式神经网络策略与基于微分系统动力学的物理信息梯度；采用伴随方法（adjoint method）高效计算元梯度，将计算复杂度降低至与数据时域呈线性关系。
AI.result: 在四旋翼控制任务中，计算时间缩短了 50% 以上；在 PX4-Gazebo 硬件在环仿真中实现零样本迁移，激进飞行场景下跟踪 RMSE 降低 15-20%，强干扰下降低高达 40%。
AI.conclusion: MetaTune 成功实现了一种高效的联合自动调优方法，在降低计算开销的同时，显著增强了机器人在动态环境下的鲁棒性和跟踪精度。
AI.translation: 基于扰动观测器的控制在增强机器人系统对抗不确定性的鲁棒性方面显示出潜力。然而，由于控制器增益与观测器参数之间存在强耦合，此类系统的调优仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们提出了 MetaTune，这是一个通过微分闭环元学习对反馈控制器和扰动观测器进行联合自动调优的统一框架。MetaTune 将便携式神经策略与源自微分系统动力学的物理信息梯度相结合，实现了跨任务和操作条件的自适应增益。我们开发了一种伴随方法，可以有效地计算相对于自适应增益的时间反向元梯度，以直接最小化成本。与现有的前向方法相比，我们的方法将计算复杂度降低到与数据时域呈线性关系。在四旋翼控制任务中，MetaTune 在实现竞争性或改进的跟踪性能的同时，将梯度计算时间减少了 50% 以上。在 PX4-Gazebo 硬件在环仿真中，学习到的策略实现了零样本迁移，并在激进飞行中将跟踪 RMSE 降低了约 15-20%，在强干扰下降低了高达 40%。
AI.summary: MetaTune 是一种用于机器人反馈控制器和扰动观测器联合自动调优的统一框架。该方法利用微分闭环元学习，通过伴随方法高效计算元梯度，在保持计算效率的同时实现了跨任务的自适应增益调整，显著提升了机器人在复杂环境下的控制性能。
AI.keywords: 机器人控制, 元学习, 微分动力学, 扰动观测器, 伴随方法
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了基于伴随方法（adjoint method）的元学习框架，解决了机器人控制器与观测器参数耦合的调优难题。其不仅提升了计算效率（线性时间复杂度），还在复杂环境（如强干扰和激进飞行）下展现了出色的零样本迁移能力，是机器人控制领域在微分动力学应用上的重要进展。

title: On the Asymptotics of Self-Supervised Pre-training: Two-Stage M-Estimation and Representation Symmetry
summary: Self-supervised pre-training, where large corpora of unlabeled data are used to learn representations for downstream fine-tuning, has become a cornerstone of modern machine learning. While a growing body of theoretical work has begun to analyze this paradigm, existing bounds leave open the question of how sharp the current rates are, and whether they accurately capture the complex interaction between pre-training and fine-tuning. In this paper, we address this gap by developing an asymptotic theory of pre-training via two-stage M-estimation. A key challenge is that the pre-training estimator is often identifiable only up to a group symmetry, a feature common in representation learning that requires careful treatment. We address this issue using tools from Riemannian geometry to study the intrinsic parameters of the pre-training representation, which we link with the downstream predictor through a notion of orbit-invariance, precisely characterizing the limiting distribution of the downstream test risk. We apply our main result to several case studies, including spectral pre-training, factor models, and Gaussian mixture models, and obtain substantial improvements in problem-specific factors over prior art when applicable.

AI.title_translation: 关于自监督预训练的渐近性：两阶段M-估计与表示对称性
AI.tldr: 本文通过两阶段M-估计和黎曼几何技术，建立了一套严谨的自监督预训练渐近理论，解决了表示学习中的对称性难题，并精确刻画了下游任务的性能极限。
AI.motivation: 现有理论界限未能准确刻画预训练与微调之间的复杂交互，且缺乏对表示学习中常见群对称性问题的严谨处理，导致对收敛速率的理解不够精确。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于两阶段M-估计的预训练渐近理论，利用黎曼几何工具处理表示学习中的群对称性，并通过轨道不变性概念将预训练表示与下游预测器关联。
AI.result: 精确刻画了下游测试风险的极限分布，并在谱预训练、因子模型和高斯混合模型等案例中，相比现有技术显著改进了特定问题的分析因子。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功建立了一套处理自监督预训练渐近性质的通用理论框架，能够精确刻画下游任务的风险分布，并在多种模型中证明了其理论优越性。
AI.translation: 自监督预训练利用大规模无标签数据学习下游微调所需的表示，已成为现代机器学习的基石。尽管越来越多的理论工作开始分析这一范式，但现有的界限仍未回答当前速率有多精确，以及它们是否准确捕捉了预训练与微调之间的复杂交互。在本文中，我们通过两阶段M-估计开发了一种预训练的渐近理论来填补这一空白。一个关键挑战是预训练估计量通常仅在群对称性下可识别，这是表示学习中的一个常见特征，需要仔细处理。我们利用黎曼几何工具研究预训练表示的内在参数，并通过轨道不变性的概念将其与下游预测器联系起来，从而精确刻画了下游测试风险的极限分布。我们将我们的主要结果应用于几个案例研究，包括谱预训练、因子模型和高斯混合模型，并在适用时在特定问题的因子上比现有技术取得了实质性的改进。
AI.summary: 本文针对自监督预训练提出了一种基于两阶段M-估计的渐近理论框架。通过引入黎曼几何工具解决表示学习中的群对称性问题，并结合轨道不变性，论文精确刻画了下游任务的测试风险极限，并验证了该方法在多种模型下的有效性。
AI.keywords: 自监督预训练, M-估计, 渐近理论, 群对称性, 黎曼几何
AI.comments: 该论文通过黎曼几何和M-估计理论为自监督学习提供了严谨的渐近分析框架，特别是在处理表示学习中常见的群对称性问题上具有显著的理论创新，为理解预训练与微调的交互提供了更精确的工具。

title: ExFusion: Efficient Transformer Training via Multi-Experts Fusion
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models substantially improve performance by increasing the capacity of dense architectures. However, directly training MoE models requires considerable computational resources and introduces extra overhead in parameter storage and deployment. Therefore, it is critical to develop an approach that leverages the multi-expert capability of MoE to enhance performance while incurring minimal additional cost. To this end, we propose a novel pre-training approach, termed ExFusion, which improves the efficiency of Transformer training through multi-expert fusion. Specifically, during the initialization phase, ExFusion upcycles the feed-forward network (FFN) of the Transformer into a multi-expert configuration, where each expert is assigned a weight for later parameter fusion. During training, these weights allow multiple experts to be fused into a single unified expert equivalent to the original FFN, which is subsequently used for forward computation. As a result, ExFusion introduces multi-expert characteristics into the training process while incurring only marginal computational cost compared to standard dense training. After training, the learned weights are used to integrate multi-experts into a single unified expert, thereby eliminating additional overhead in storage and deployment. Extensive experiments on a variety of computer vision and natural language processing tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

title: CLIP-AUTT: Test-Time Personalization with Action Unit Prompting for Fine-Grained Video Emotion Recognition
summary: Personalization in emotion recognition (ER) is essential for accurate interpretation of subtle and subject-specific expressive patterns. Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs), such as CLIP, demonstrate strong potential for leveraging joint image-text representations in ER. However, existing CLIP-based methods either rely on CLIP's contrastive pretraining or use LLMs to generate descriptive text prompts, which can be noisy, computationally expensive, and often fail to capture fine-grained expressions, leading to degraded performance. In this work, Action Units (AUs) are leveraged as structured textual prompts within CLIP to model fine-grained facial expressions. AUs encode the subtle muscle activations underlying expressions, providing localized and interpretable semantic cues for more robust facial expression recognition (FER). We introduce CLIP-AU, a lightweight AU-guided temporal learning method that integrates interpretable AU semantics into CLIP. It learns generic, subject-agnostic representations by aligning AU prompts with facial dynamics, enabling fine-grained FER without CLIP fine-tuning or LLM-generated text supervision. Although CLIP-AU models fine-grained AU semantics, it does not adapt to subject-specific variability in subtle expressions. To address this limitation, we propose CLIP-AUTT, a video-based test-time personalization method that dynamically adapts AU prompts to videos from unseen subjects. By combining entropy-guided temporal window selection with prompt tuning, CLIP-AUTT enables subject-specific adaptation while preserving temporal consistency. Our experiments on three challenging video-based datasets, BioVid, StressID, and BAH, indicate that CLIP-AU and CLIP-AUTT outperform state-of-the-art CLIP-based FER and TTA methods.

AI.title_translation: CLIP-AUTT：用于细粒度视频情绪识别的带动作单元提示的测试时个性化方法
AI.tldr: 通过利用结构化的Action Units作为提示并结合测试时个性化微调，显著提升了CLIP在细粒度视频情绪识别中的准确性和个体适应性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于CLIP的情绪识别方法依赖LLM生成提示词，存在噪声大、计算昂贵且难以捕捉细粒度表情的问题，且缺乏对个体差异的自适应能力。
AI.method: 提出CLIP-AU，利用Action Units作为结构化文本提示引导CLIP进行时序学习；进一步提出CLIP-AUTT，通过熵引导的时序窗口选择与提示微调（Prompt Tuning）实现针对测试视频的个性化动态调整。
AI.result: 在BioVid、StressID和BAH三个数据集上的实验表明，CLIP-AU和CLIP-AUTT在细粒度情绪识别任务中均优于现有的CLIP基准方法和测试时适应（TTA）方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入AU语义引导和测试时个性化提示调整，CLIP-AUTT有效提升了视频情绪识别的细粒度表现和对未见个体的适应能力。
AI.translation: 在情绪识别（ER）中，个性化对于准确解读细微和特定于主体的表达模式至关重要。视觉-语言模型（VLMs，如CLIP）的最新进展展示了在ER中利用图文联合表征的巨大潜力。然而，现有的基于CLIP的方法要么依赖CLIP的对比预训练，要么使用大语言模型（LLM）生成描述性文本提示，这些方法往往伴随着噪声、高计算成本，且难以捕捉细粒度表情，导致性能下降。在这项工作中，我们将动作单元（AUs）作为结构化文本提示引入CLIP，以建模细粒度的面部表情。AUs编码了表情背后的细微肌肉激活，为更稳健的面部表情识别（FER）提供了局部化且可解释的语义线索。我们引入了CLIP-AU，这是一种轻量级的AU引导时序学习方法，将可解释的AU语义集成到CLIP中。它通过将AU提示与面部动态对齐来学习通用的、与主体无关的表征，从而在无需CLIP微调或LLM生成文本监督的情况下实现细粒度FER。虽然CLIP-AU建模了细粒度的AU语义，但它无法适应细微表情中特定于主体的变异性。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了CLIP-AUTT，这是一种基于视频的测试时个性化方法，可动态调整AU提示以适应来自未见主体视频。通过结合熵引导的时序窗口选择与提示微调，CLIP-AUTT在保持时序一致性的同时实现了特定于主体的适应。我们在三个具有挑战性的视频FER数据集（BioVid、StressID和BAH）上的实验表明，CLIP-AU和CLIP-AUTT的表现优于现有的基于CLIP的FER和TTA方法。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了CLIP-AUTT，这是一种用于细粒度视频情绪识别的测试时个性化方法。它利用Action Units (AUs) 作为结构化文本提示，避免了复杂的LLM生成过程，并通过熵引导的提示微调机制实现了对不同个体表情差异的动态适应。
AI.keywords: 情绪识别, CLIP, Action Units, 测试时个性化, 细粒度分析
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将Action Units (AUs) 作为语义先验引入CLIP，解决了传统基于LLM生成提示词时的噪声和计算开销问题。其核心创新在于引入了测试时个性化（TTA）机制，通过动态调整提示词来捕捉个体差异，在细粒度情绪识别领域具有很强的实用价值和可解释性。

title: ManipArena: Comprehensive Real-world Evaluation of Reasoning-Oriented Generalist Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and world-action models have emerged as central paradigms for general-purpose robotic intelligence, yet their empirical progress remains constrained by the absence of evaluation protocols that are both physically realistic and diagnostically controlled. Simulator-centric benchmarks provide scale and reproducibility, but cannot fully capture the reality gap induced by perception noise, contact dynamics, latency, calibration error, and hardware constraints. Conversely, real-robot evaluations are often fragmented across platforms, scenes, objects, and scoring rules, making fair comparison and failure attribution difficult. We introduce ManipArena, a standardized real-robot evaluation framework for studying manipulation generalization under matched physical conditions. ManipArena comprises 20 tasks, 10,812 expert trajectories, 13.5M frames, and approximately 188 robot hours across tabletop and mobile manipulation. The framework combines schema-defined task variation, stratified in-domain, visualshift, and semantic-OOD trials, subtask-level partial-credit scoring, three-level language annotations, low-level motor signals, and paired real-to-sim environments reconstructed from physical scenes. Using ManipArena, we evaluate seven tabletop configurations spanning VLA and world-action-model policies. The results show that real-robot conclusions depend not only on architecture, but also on model provenance, fine-tuning regime, data sampling, and annotation granularity. ManipArena thus provides a reproducible and interpretable foundation for diagnosing capability boundaries and failure modes in embodied generalization.

AI.title_translation: ManipArena：面向推理的通用机器人操作的综合真实世界评估
AI.tldr: ManipArena是一个新的标准化真实机器人评估框架，旨在解决现有基准在物理真实性和诊断控制上的不足，通过大规模实验揭示了模型架构、数据和训练策略对机器人泛化能力的深层影响。
AI.motivation: 当前机器人操作领域缺乏既符合物理真实性又具备诊断价值的评估协议，现有的模拟器基准难以模拟真实世界的感知噪声、动力学及硬件限制，而零散的真实机器人实验又难以实现公平比较。
AI.method: 构建了ManipArena框架，包含20项涵盖桌面及移动操作任务，通过模式定义的任务变化、分层分布内/外测试、子任务分段评分、多级语言标注以及真实环境向模拟环境的配对重构，对七种不同的机器人策略进行了系统化评估。
AI.result: 研究发现，真实机器人策略的性能表现高度依赖于模型来源、微调机制、数据采样策略及标注粒度，而非单纯取决于模型架构。该框架通过大量实验揭示了模型在不同泛化场景下的能力边界和失效模式。
AI.conclusion: ManipArena通过提供标准化的评估协议和大规模真实机器人数据集，揭示了机器人策略性能不仅取决于模型架构，还受训练范式、数据采样和标注粒度等多重因素影响，为具身智能研究提供了可解释的基准。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界-动作模型已成为通用机器人智能的核心范式，但其经验性进展受限于缺乏既物理真实又具备诊断控制的评估协议。以模拟器为中心的基准提供了规模和可复现性，但无法完全捕捉感知噪声、接触动力学、延迟、校准误差和硬件约束带来的现实差距。相反，真实机器人评估通常在平台、场景、对象和评分规则上各不相同，使得公平比较和失效归因变得困难。我们引入了ManipArena，这是一个用于研究匹配物理条件下操作泛化的标准化真实机器人评估框架。ManipArena包含20个任务、10,812条专家轨迹、1350万帧数据以及约188小时的桌面和移动操作机器人运行时间。该框架结合了模式定义的任务变化、分层域内/视觉偏移/语义分布外（OOD）测试、子任务分段得分、三级语言标注、低级运动信号以及从物理场景重构的真实到模拟配对环境。利用ManipArena，我们评估了跨越VLA和世界-动作模型策略的七种桌面配置。结果表明，真实机器人的结论不仅取决于架构，还取决于模型来源、微调机制、数据采样和标注粒度。因此，ManipArena为诊断具身泛化中的能力边界和失效模式提供了可复现且可解释的基础。
AI.summary: ManipArena是一个旨在解决通用机器人操作评估难题的标准化真实世界框架。它通过构建包含20个任务的大规模实验集，结合精细化的任务分层、分段评分及真实场景模拟重构，为机器人策略（如VLA模型）提供了公平、可复现的性能评估工具，从而深入诊断具身智能的泛化能力与局限。
AI.keywords: 机器人操作, 视觉-语言-动作模型, 真实世界评估, 泛化能力, 具身智能
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入标准化、可复现的真实机器人评估框架，解决了目前具身智能领域缺乏统一真实世界基准的痛点。其创新之处在于将复杂的真实环境量化，并细化了评估维度（如分层任务、部分得分），为理解VLA模型在真实场景下的泛化能力提供了关键工具。

title: Fisheye3R: Adapting Unified 3D Feed-Forward Foundation Models to Fisheye Lenses
summary: Feed-forward foundation models for multi-view 3-dimensional (3D) reconstruction have been trained on large-scale datasets of perspective images; when tested on wide field-of-view images, e.g., from a fisheye camera, their performance degrades. This degradation arises from changes in spatial arrangements of pixels induced by the non-linear projection model that maps 3D points onto the 2D image plane. While one may surmise that training on fisheye images would resolve this problem, there are far fewer fisheye images with ground truth than perspective images, which limits generalization. To enable inference on imagery exhibiting high radial distortion, we propose \textit{Fisheye3R}, a novel adaptation framework that extends these multi-view 3D reconstruction foundation models to natively accommodate fisheye inputs without performance regression on perspective images. To address the scarcity of fisheye images and ground truth, we introduce flexible learning schemes that support self-supervised adaptation using only unlabeled perspective images and supervised adaptation without any fisheye training data. Extensive experiments across three foundation models, including VGGT, $π^3$, and MapAnything, demonstrate that our approach consistently improves camera pose, depth, point map, and field-of-view estimation on fisheye images. Code is available at https://github.com/android-xr/fisheye3r.

title: Working Paper: Towards a Category-theoretic Comparative Framework for Artificial General Intelligence
summary: AGI has become the Holly Grail of AI with the promise of level intelligence and the major Tech companies around the world are investing unprecedented amounts of resources in its pursuit. Yet, there does not exist a single formal definition and only some empirical AGI benchmarking frameworks currently exist. The main purpose of this paper is to develop a general, algebraic and category theoretic framework for describing, comparing and analysing different possible AGI architectures. Thus, this Category theoretic formalization would also allow to compare different possible candidate AGI architectures, such as, RL, Universal AI, Active Inference, CRL, Schema based Learning, etc. It will allow to unambiguously expose their commonalities and differences, and what is even more important, expose areas for future research. From the applied Category theoretic point of view, we take as inspiration Machines in a Category to provide a modern view of AGI Architectures in a Category. More specifically, this first position paper provides, on one hand, a first exercise on RL, Causal RL and SBL Architectures in a Category, and on the other hand, it is a first step on a broader research program that seeks to provide a unified formal foundation for AGI systems, integrating architectural structure, informational organization, agent realization, agent and environment interaction, behavioural development over time, and the empirical evaluation of properties. This framework is also intended to support the definition of architectural properties, both syntactic and informational, as well as semantic properties of agents and their assessment in environments with explicitly characterized features. We claim that Category Theory and AGI will have a very symbiotic relation.

AI.title_translation: 工作论文：迈向通用人工智能的范畴论比较框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出利用范畴论建立统一的数学语言，以形式化地描述、对比和分析各种通用人工智能（AGI）架构。
AI.motivation: 当前AGI领域缺乏统一的形式化定义和对比框架，导致各类架构难以进行科学的比较与评估，限制了技术的发展。
AI.method: 利用范畴论中的“范畴中的机器”（Machines in a Category）理论，对强化学习（RL）、因果强化学习（CRL）和基于模式的学习（SBL）等架构进行初步的形式化建模与对比。
AI.result: 提出了一个初步的范畴论框架，能够对RL、CRL和SBL等架构进行数学描述，并展示了该框架在揭示不同架构共性、差异及潜在研究方向方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 范畴论为理解和构建通用人工智能（AGI）提供了一个强有力的形式化工具，有望成为连接不同AGI架构并指导未来研究的统一基础。
AI.translation: 通用人工智能（AGI）已成为人工智能领域的“圣杯”，承诺实现人类水平的智能，全球各大科技公司正投入前所未有的资源进行追逐。然而，目前尚不存在统一的形式化定义，仅有一些经验性的AGI基准测试框架。本文的主要目的是开发一个通用的、代数的和范畴论的框架，用于描述、比较和分析不同的AGI架构。这种范畴论形式化方法将允许比较各种可能的AGI候选架构，如强化学习（RL）、通用人工智能（Universal AI）、主动推理（Active Inference）、因果强化学习（CRL）、基于模式的学习（SBL）等。它将能够明确地揭示它们的共性和差异，更重要的是，揭示未来的研究领域。从应用范畴论的角度来看，我们以“范畴中的机器”为灵感，提供了AGI架构的现代视角。具体而言，这篇立场论文一方面对范畴内的RL、CRL和SBL架构进行了初步尝试，另一方面，它是一个更广泛研究计划的第一步，旨在为AGI系统提供统一的形式化基础，整合架构结构、信息组织、智能体实现、智能体与环境交互、随时间发展的行为以及属性的经验评估。该框架还旨在支持架构属性（包括语法和信息属性）的定义，以及智能体的语义属性及其在具有明确特征的环境中的评估。我们认为，范畴论与AGI之间将存在非常共生的关系。
AI.summary: 本文旨在构建一个基于范畴论的通用框架，用于描述、分析和比较不同的AGI架构。通过将现有的AI范式纳入统一的数学结构，该研究为理解AGI的架构特性、交互机制及评估方法提供了一种严谨的形式化路径。
AI.keywords: 通用人工智能 (AGI), 范畴论, 架构对比, 形式化框架, 智能系统分析
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入范畴论（Category Theory）为AGI提供了一种严谨的数学框架，旨在解决当前AGI领域缺乏统一形式化定义的瓶颈。其创新之处在于将多种不同的AI架构（如RL、Active Inference等）纳入统一的数学语言进行对比，具有很高的理论价值，但目前仍处于探索阶段，实际应用效能有待进一步验证。

title: An Isotropic Approach to Efficient Uncertainty Quantification with Gradient Norms
summary: Existing methods for quantifying predictive uncertainty in neural networks are either computationally intractable for large language models or require access to training data that is typically unavailable. We derive a lightweight alternative through two approximations: a first-order Taylor expansion that expresses uncertainty in terms of the gradient of the prediction and the parameter covariance, and an isotropy assumption on the parameter covariance. Together, these yield epistemic uncertainty as the squared gradient norm and aleatoric uncertainty as the Bernoulli variance of the point prediction, from a single forward-backward pass through an unmodified pretrained model. We justify the isotropy assumption by showing that covariance estimates built from non-training data introduce structured distortions that isotropic covariance avoids, and that theoretical results on the spectral properties of large networks support the approximation at scale. Validation against reference Markov Chain Monte Carlo estimates on synthetic problems shows strong correspondence that improves with model size. We then use the estimates to investigate when each uncertainty type carries useful signal for predicting answer correctness in question answering with large language models, revealing a benchmark-dependent divergence: the combined estimate achieves the highest mean AUROC on TruthfulQA, where questions involve genuine conflict between plausible answers, but falls to near chance on TriviaQA's factual recall, suggesting that parameter-level uncertainty captures a fundamentally different signal than self-assessment methods.

AI.title_translation: 一种基于梯度范数的高效不确定性量化各向同性方法
AI.tldr: 通过梯度范数实现高效大模型不确定性量化，无需训练数据，仅需单次传递。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络不确定性量化方法在大模型上计算开销过大，或依赖于通常无法获取的训练数据，因此需要一种更轻量且无需训练数据的替代方案。
AI.method: 利用一阶泰勒展开将不确定性表达为预测梯度与参数协方差的函数，并引入参数协方差的各向同性假设，最终仅需单次前向-后向传递即可分别计算出认知不确定性（梯度范数平方）和偶然不确定性（Bernoulli方差）。
AI.result: 在合成问题上与MCMC估计高度一致，且随模型规模增大效果提升。在TruthfulQA上表现优异，但在TriviaQA等事实检索任务上表现一般，表明参数级不确定性与自评估方法捕捉到了不同的信号。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过梯度范数提供了一种高效且无需训练数据的不确定性评估手段，为理解大型语言模型的不确定性来源提供了新视角，并揭示了不同任务中不确定性信号的差异性。
AI.translation: 现有的神经网络预测不确定性量化方法，要么对于大型语言模型而言计算上不可行，要么需要访问通常无法获取的训练数据。我们通过两种近似推导了一种轻量级的替代方案：一种一阶泰勒展开，将不确定性表示为预测梯度和参数协方差的函数；以及对参数协方差的各向同性假设。两者结合，使得仅需对未经修改的预训练模型进行单次前向-后向传递，即可得出作为梯度范数平方的认知不确定性，以及作为点预测伯努利方差的偶然不确定性。我们通过证明由非训练数据构建的协方差估计会引入各向同性协方差所能避免的结构性失真，以及大型网络谱性质的理论结果支持该规模下的近似，从而论证了各向同性假设。针对合成问题的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）参考估计进行的验证显示，两者具有很强的对应关系，且随模型规模增大而改善。随后，我们利用这些估计来探讨每种不确定性类型在大型语言模型问答中预测答案正确性时的有用信号，揭示了基准测试相关的差异：组合估计在TruthfulQA上实现了最高的平均AUROC（此时问题涉及合理答案之间的真正冲突），但在TriviaQA的事实检索任务上降至接近随机水平，这表明参数级不确定性捕获的信号与自评估方法有着本质的不同。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种基于梯度范数的高效不确定性量化方法，通过一阶泰勒展开和各向同性假设，实现了仅需单次前向-后向传递即可估计大模型的认知和偶然不确定性。实验验证了该方法在不同任务中的表现及与现有方法的差异。
AI.keywords: 不确定性量化, 梯度范数, 各向同性假设, 大型语言模型, 认知不确定性
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种极具创新性的轻量级不确定性量化方法，通过各向同性假设极大地简化了计算，使得在无需访问训练数据的情况下即可对大型语言模型进行不确定性评估。其局限性在于该方法基于近似假设，在某些特定任务（如事实检索）上的表现可能不如任务特定的自评估方法。

title: Video-Oasis: Rethinking Evaluation of Video Understanding
summary: The inherent complexity of video understanding makes it difficult to determine whether Video-LLM benchmark performance stems from visual perception, linguistic reasoning, or knowledge priors. While many benchmarks have emerged to assess high-level reasoning, shared criteria for evaluating video understanding remain largely overlooked. Instead of introducing yet another benchmark, we take a step back to re-examine the criteria for evaluating video understanding. In this work, we introduce Video-Oasis, a sustainable diagnostic suite for systematically auditing existing video understanding benchmarks. This audit reveals that 55\% of existing benchmark samples are solvable without visual input or temporal context. After filtering these shortcuts, the remaining video-native challenges expose a substantial capability gap: state-of-the-art models perform only marginally above random guessing. Building on these findings, we use the distilled challenges as a testbed to investigate which algorithmic design choices contribute to robust video understanding. We hope our work provides a practical foundation for constructing rigorous video benchmarks and evaluating future Video-LLMs. Code is available at https://github.com/sejong-rcv/Video-Oasis.
