title: GroundEval: A Deterministic Replacement for LLM-as-Judge in Stateful Agent Evaluation
summary:
Before letting an agent operate over real context, can you prove it used the right evidence? GroundEval turns that question into a deterministic test of what the agent searched, fetched, cited, and was permitted to access. In one case study, two frontier LLM judges scored a plausible agent response 0.85 and higher. But the trace told a different story: the agent had never retrieved the artifact its answer depended on, yielding a GroundEval score of 0.000.
  We introduce GroundEval, a judge-free framework for evaluating agents against grounded, time-bounded, and access-controlled evidence. GroundEval uses a domain configuration to generate questions, lets the agent choose how to answer, and then scores both the final answer and the recorded trajectory that produced it. The benchmark targets three failures that LLM-as-judge evaluation struggles to detect: whether an agent checked before claiming absence, reasoned only from evidence available to the actor at the relevant time, and used the correct causal mechanism rather than a plausible one. These correspond to three tracks: Silence, Perspective, and Counterfactual. GroundEval exposes when plausible answers rest on invalid evidence paths, and produces structured per-question diagnostics that pair tool activity with the agent's turn-level narration, making each score inspectable rather than merely reported. Our case studies suggest this failure mode is common rather than exceptional, one that final-answer and judge-based evaluation cannot detect by construction.

AI.title_translation: GroundEval：状态化智能体评估中LLM-as-judge的确定性替代方案
AI.tldr: GroundEval通过确定性地检查智能体的操作轨迹（而非仅看结果），解决了LLM作为评判员时无法发现证据使用错误的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM-as-judge评估方法往往只关注最终答案的合理性，无法检测智能体是否真正利用了正确的证据，导致智能体可能通过错误或无效的路径得出“看似合理”的结论。
AI.method: 引入GroundEval框架，通过领域配置生成问题，并对智能体的最终答案及其记录的轨迹（搜索、获取、引用和访问权限）进行确定性评分，分为Silence、Perspective和Counterfactual三个评估轨道。
AI.result: 案例研究表明，LLM-as-judge可能给错误的回答打出高分，而GroundEval能够通过分析轨迹识别出证据缺失，从而给出准确的0分，证明了该方法在检测隐蔽失效模式方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: GroundEval通过引入确定性的轨迹评估，有效解决了传统LLM-as-judge无法检测的智能体溯源和逻辑错误，为智能体评估提供了更透明、可解释的基准。
AI.translation: 在让智能体处理真实上下文之前，你能证明它使用了正确的证据吗？GroundEval将这个问题转化为对智能体搜索、获取、引用和被允许访问内容的确定性测试。在一个案例研究中，两个前沿大模型裁判给一个看似合理的智能体回答打出了0.85及以上的分数。但轨迹显示情况完全不同：智能体从未检索到其答案所依赖的工件，导致GroundEval得分为0.000。我们引入了GroundEval，这是一个用于评估智能体在有根据、有时间限制和有访问控制的证据下表现的无裁判框架。GroundEval使用领域配置生成问题，让智能体选择如何回答，然后对最终答案和产生该答案的记录轨迹进行评分。该基准针对LLM-as-judge难以检测的三种失败：智能体在声称缺失前是否进行了检查、是否仅根据相关时间点可用的证据进行推理、以及是否使用了正确的因果机制而非仅仅是看似合理的机制。这些对应于三个轨道：沉默（Silence）、视角（Perspective）和反事实（Counterfactual）。GroundEval揭示了看似合理的答案建立在无效证据路径上的情况，并生成结构化的逐题诊断，将工具活动与智能体的轮次叙述配对，使每个分数可审查，而不仅仅是报告。我们的案例研究表明，这种失败模式是常见的，而非个例，这是基于最终答案和基于裁判的评估在架构上无法检测到的。
AI.summary: GroundEval是一个无裁判的评估框架，通过确定性的轨迹验证来评估智能体在状态化环境下的表现。它通过检查智能体的搜索、获取和引用行为，解决了LLM-as-judge无法识别“看似正确但证据无效”的评估难题。
AI.keywords: 智能体评估, 确定性测试, 溯源验证, 轨迹分析, 无裁判评估
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种“无裁判”（judge-free）的评估框架，针对当前LLM-as-judge在评估智能体时存在的“幻觉”和“逻辑盲区”问题，通过确定性的轨迹验证提供了更可靠的评估手段。其局限性在于需要针对特定领域进行配置，可能不如通用的LLM评估那样灵活。

title: Distilling Collaborative Dynamics into Latent Space for Implicit Coordination in Decentralized Multi-Agent Manipulation
comments: Accepted to IROS 2026 | Project Page: https://cosdeneb.github.io/cls-dp/
summary: Multi-arm manipulation demands precise spatiotemporal coordination, yet many centralized approaches scale poorly as team size increases. To address this, we propose CLS-DP, a decentralized multi-agent framework that enables implicit coordination under partial observability without shared global views, explicit state information, or inter-agent communication. Under the centralized training and decentralized execution (CTDE) paradigm, CLS-DP distills privileged multi-agent dynamics into a latent space. At deployment, each agent infers a collaborative latent from its local RGB observation and a shared task instruction; it then conditions the diffusion denoising process on this latent. This design enables implicit coordination with a per-agent cost independent of team size. Across six RoboFactory benchmark tasks spanning two to four agents, CLS-DP achieves a 38% mean success rate, outperforming the best centralized baseline (20%) and a decentralized ablation without the collaborative latent (9%). It also maintains superior parameter efficiency across all agent configurations. Attribution maps show that an agent conditioned on the collaborative latent places high attribution on the joints and grippers of both itself and its teammates throughout execution. This suggests that the learned latent efficiently encodes collaborative dynamics from local observation, which facilitates implicit coordination in realistic settings characterized by partial observability.
comment: Accepted to IROS 2026 | Project Page: https://cosdeneb.github.io/cls-dp/

AI.title_translation: 将协作动力学蒸馏至潜在空间：去中心化多智能体操作中的隐式协调
AI.tldr: 通过将多智能体协作动力学蒸馏至潜在空间，CLS-DP使智能体无需通信即可在去中心化环境下实现高效的隐式协作。
AI.motivation: 现有的集中式多智能体操作方法在团队规模扩大时扩展性差，且去中心化场景下缺乏有效的隐式协调机制，难以处理部分可观测环境。
AI.method: 提出CLS-DP框架，采用集中式训练和去中心化执行（CTDE）范式，将特权多智能体动力学蒸馏至潜在空间；在部署时，智能体仅根据局部RGB观测和任务指令推断协作潜在变量，并以此作为扩散去噪过程的条件。
AI.result: 在RoboFactory基准测试中，CLS-DP取得了38%的平均成功率，优于集中式基线（20%）和无协作潜在变量的消融模型（9%），并表现出优秀的参数效率。
AI.conclusion: CLS-DP框架通过在潜在空间内蒸馏协作动力学，实现了高效的去中心化多智能体协作，在保持低计算成本的同时显著提升了任务成功率，且具有良好的参数效率。
AI.translation: 多臂操作任务需要精确的时空协调，但许多集中式方法在团队规模增加时扩展性较差。为解决此问题，我们提出了CLS-DP，这是一个去中心化的多智能体框架，能够在部分可观测、无共享全局视图、无显式状态信息及无智能体间通信的情况下实现隐式协调。在集中式训练和去中心化执行（CTDE）范式下，CLS-DP将特权多智能体动力学蒸馏到一个潜在空间中。在部署时，每个智能体从其局部RGB观测和共享任务指令中推断出一个协作潜在变量；然后以此为条件进行扩散去噪处理。这种设计使得隐式协调的单智能体成本与团队规模无关。在涵盖两到四个智能体的六项RoboFactory基准测试任务中，CLS-DP实现了38%的平均成功率，优于最佳的集中式基线（20%）和没有协作潜在变量的去中心化消融模型（9%）。它还在所有智能体配置中保持了优越的参数效率。归因图显示，受协作潜在变量调节的智能体在执行过程中会将高归因分配给自身及其队友的关节和夹爪。这表明学习到的潜在空间能够有效地从局部观测中编码协作动力学，从而促进了部分可观测现实场景下的隐式协调。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为CLS-DP的去中心化多智能体操作框架。该方法通过在集中式训练阶段将协作动力学蒸馏到潜在空间，使智能体在去中心化执行阶段能够仅凭局部观测信息，通过条件扩散模型实现高效的隐式协作，从而摆脱了对全局视图或智能体间通信的依赖。
AI.keywords: 多智能体协作, 去中心化操作, 潜在空间蒸馏, 扩散模型, 隐式协调
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入潜在空间蒸馏技术，成功解决了去中心化多智能体操作中的隐式协作难题。其创新之处在于将协作动力学编码至潜在空间，使智能体无需通信即可实现精确的时空协调，证明了CTDE范式在多机器人协作任务中的有效性。

title: SPAR: Semantic-Pixel Self-Alignment and Adaptive Routing for Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable success in visual understanding but remain constrained in visual generation due to the fundamental feature discrepancy between semantic perception and pixel-level reconstruction. Bridging this gap requires overcoming two core challenges: endowing semantic encoders with high-fidelity reconstruction capabilities, and effectively aligning generative models with semantic spaces without relying on external teachers. To this end, we propose a novel unified multimodal framework featuring \textbf{S}emantic-\textbf{P}ixel self-alignment and \textbf{A}daptive \textbf{R}outing (\textbf{SPAR}). First, to reconcile semantic perception with pixel-level reconstruction, we introduce an asymmetric dual-stream unified tokenizer. A lightweight semantic stream anchors discriminative features, while a Transformer-augmented pixel stream recovers fine-grained visual details into a unified compact latent space. Second, to eliminate external dependencies, we propose a self-aligned generation paradigm that natively leverages this optimized tokenizer as an internal alignment teacher for the diffusion model. Furthermore, to facilitate flexible multimodal interaction within this unified space, we introduce Dynamic Token Routing, which enables each token to adaptively aggregate multi-layer MLLM features based on its distinct semantic demands. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SPAR establishes the state-of-the-art for unified architectures, achieving exceptional generation and reconstruction quality while preserving foundational visual understanding capabilities.

AI.title_translation: SPAR：统一多模态模型的语义-像素自对齐与自适应路由
AI.tldr: 提出一种名为SPAR的新型统一多模态模型，通过双流标记器和自对齐生成技术，在无需外部教师的情况下实现了高质量的视觉生成与理解。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在视觉理解与生成之间存在特征差异，且现有的生成模型往往高度依赖外部教师模型，缺乏统一的感知与生成能力。
AI.method: 提出SPAR框架，包含：1. 非对称双流统一标记器（语义流+像素流）；2. 自对齐生成范式（利用标记器作为内部教师）；3. 动态令牌路由（自适应聚合多层特征）。
AI.result: 实验表明，SPAR在统一架构中达到了最先进水平，在保证视觉理解能力的同时，显著提升了视觉生成和重建质量。
AI.conclusion: SPAR框架成功统一了多模态感知与生成任务，在无需外部教师的情况下实现了高质量的视觉重建与生成，同时保持了强大的视觉理解能力，刷新了统一架构的性能记录。
AI.translation: 多模态大模型（MLLMs）在视觉理解方面取得了显著成功，但由于语义感知与像素级重建之间的根本特征差异，其在视觉生成方面仍受到限制。弥合这一差距需要克服两个核心挑战：赋予语义编码器高保真重建能力，以及在不依赖外部教师的情况下有效地将生成模型与语义空间对齐。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的统一多模态框架，即语义-像素自对齐与自适应路由（SPAR）。首先，为了协调语义感知与像素级重建，我们引入了一种非对称双流统一标记器。轻量级语义流锚定判别特征，而Transformer增强的像素流将细粒度的视觉细节恢复到统一的紧凑潜在空间中。其次，为了消除外部依赖，我们提出了一种自对齐生成范式，将这种优化后的标记器作为扩散模型的内部对齐教师。此外，为了促进统一空间内的灵活多模态交互，我们引入了动态令牌路由，使每个令牌能够根据其独特的语义需求自适应地聚合多层MLLM特征。广泛的实验表明，SPAR为统一架构建立了最先进的标准，在保持基础视觉理解能力的同时，实现了卓越的生成和重建质量。
AI.summary: SPAR是一种统一的多模态模型框架，通过非对称双流标记器协调语义感知与像素重建，利用自对齐生成范式消除外部依赖，并引入动态令牌路由实现特征的灵活交互，从而在保持理解能力的同时提升了生成质量。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 视觉生成, 统一架构, 自对齐, 动态令牌路由
AI.comments: 该研究通过创新的双流标记器和自对齐生成范式，成功解决了统一多模态模型在感知与生成任务间的特征鸿沟。其最大的亮点在于消除了对外部教师模型的依赖，并通过动态路由机制提升了模型处理不同语义需求时的灵活性，为实现真正的通用多模态模型提供了有效路径。

title: FlexServe: A Fast and Secure LLM Serving System for Mobile Devices with Flexible Resource Isolation
comments: Repeated paper uploading due to mistakes. See arXiv:2603.09046
summary:
Device-side Large Language Models (LLMs) have grown explosively, offering stronger privacy and higher availability than their cloud-side counterparts. During LLM inference, both the model weights and the user data are valuable, and attackers may compromise the OS kernel to steal them. ARM TrustZone is the de facto hardware-based isolation technology on mobile devices, used to protect sensitive applications from a compromised OS. However, protecting LLM inference with TrustZone incurs significant overhead to both the secure inference and the normal aplications, due to two challenges: the inflexible resource isolation and the inefficient secure resource management.
  To address these challenges, this paper presents FlexServe, a fast and secure LLM inference system for mobile devices. The key idea is to decouple the access permission from the management permission of secure resources, so that the normal-world OS cannot access them but can still manage them as usual. First, FlexServe introduces a Recallable Resource Isolation mechanism to construct Recallable Secure Memory (Flex-Mem) and a Recallable Secure NPU (Flex-NPU). They can only be accessed by the secure world, but can be efficiently allocated and reclaimed by the normal-world OS. Based on them, FlexServe further introduces a FlexServe Framework to run secure LLM inference in the secure world. It works together with the normal-world OS to perform cooperative secure memory management. We implement a prototype of FlexServe and compare it with two TrustZone-based strawman designs. The results show that FlexServe achieves average TTFT speedups of 10.05X over the strawman and 2.44X over an optimized strawman.

title: PatternGSL: A Structured Specification Language for Template-Free and Simulation-Ready 3D Garments
summary: Reconstructing realistic, physically plausible garments from a single image remains a fundamental challenge. Template-free methods capture surface geometry but lack explicit sewing structure for simulation; while programmatic systems are simulation-ready but constrained by predefined templates. This reveals a fundamental representation gap between geometric reconstruction and structured garment construction. We present PatternGSL, a structured garment representation in the form of a template-free and learnable specification language that encodes complete sewing patterns, including panel boundaries, parameterized seams, and explicit stitch topology, in a compact and standardized form. PatternGSL preserves the physical rigor of pattern-based models while removing template dependence, elevating sewing structure as a first-class target for generative modeling. We further propose a vision-language framework that predicts PatternGSL specifications directly from a single image and decodes them into garments using lightweight deterministic validity handling, without optimization-based refinement or manual cleanup. In addition, we introduce PatternGSLData, the first large-scale image-to-GSL paired dataset comprising 300K samples with complete sewing pattern annotations, enabling supervised VLM training for structured garment reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate improved pattern accuracy over prior baselines, explicit sewing-structure recovery, reliable cloth simulation, and pattern-level editing through the same deterministic decoding pipeline. Code and data-processing scripts will be released at https://lagrangeli.github.io/PatternGSL/.

AI.title_translation: PatternGSL：一种用于无模板且可仿真3D服装的结构化规范语言
AI.tldr: PatternGSL提出了一种新型规范语言，能从单张图像直接生成包含完整缝纫结构、可用于物理仿真的3D服装，克服了传统方法在几何真实感与仿真可用性之间的限制。
AI.motivation: 现有技术在无模板几何重建（缺乏缝纫结构）和基于模板的程序化系统（受限于模板）之间存在鸿沟，导致无法直接生成既具备真实感又可用于物理仿真的服装。
AI.method: 提出PatternGSL规范语言以编码缝纫模式；构建包含30万样本的PatternGSLData数据集；设计一个视觉-语言框架，从单张图像直接预测PatternGSL规范，并通过确定性解码器生成服装。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在缝纫模式准确性上优于现有基准，能有效恢复缝纫结构，支持可靠的布料仿真，并允许进行模式级别的编辑。
AI.conclusion: PatternGSL成功实现了从单张图像到可仿真、结构化服装的直接生成，为服装生成建模提供了一种兼具灵活性和物理严谨性的新范式。
AI.translation: 从单张图像中重建逼真且符合物理规律的服装仍然是一个基础挑战。无模板方法虽然能捕捉表面几何形状，但缺乏用于仿真的显式缝纫结构；而程序化系统虽然可直接用于仿真，却受限于预定义的模板。这揭示了几何重建与结构化服装构建之间存在本质的表示鸿沟。我们提出了PatternGSL，这是一种以无模板且可学习的规范语言形式存在的结构化服装表示，它以紧凑且标准化的形式编码了完整的缝纫模式，包括衣片边界、参数化接缝和显式缝合拓扑。PatternGSL在保持基于模式模型物理严谨性的同时，消除了对模板的依赖，将缝纫结构提升为生成建模的一等目标。我们进一步提出了一种视觉-语言框架，可以直接从单张图像预测PatternGSL规范，并使用轻量级的确定性有效性处理将其解码为服装，无需基于优化的细化或手动清理。此外，我们引入了PatternGSLData，这是第一个包含30万个带有完整缝纫模式标注的图像到GSL配对样本的大规模数据集，支持结构化服装重建的监督式VLM训练。实验表明，与先前的基准相比，该方法提高了模式准确性，实现了显式的缝纫结构恢复、可靠的布料仿真，并可通过相同的确定性解码流水线进行模式级的编辑。代码和数据处理脚本将在 https://lagrangeli.github.io/PatternGSL/ 发布。
AI.summary: PatternGSL是一种用于3D服装的结构化规范语言，旨在解决从单张图像重建服装时几何与结构脱节的问题。该方法通过可学习的语言编码缝纫模式，结合专门设计的视觉-语言框架和大规模数据集，实现了无需模板、可直接用于物理仿真的高质量服装生成。
AI.keywords: 服装重建, 缝纫模式, 规范语言, 物理仿真, 生成建模
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于填补了几何重建与结构化服装构建之间的鸿沟，通过引入一种可学习的规范语言，实现了在无模板限制下保留物理仿真所需的缝纫结构。这对于计算机图形学和计算机视觉在服装建模领域的实际应用（如虚拟试穿、动画制作）具有重要的推动作用。

title: Generating Realistic Individual Activity Schedules via Activity Location Allocation Based on Simulated Travel Times
comments: 8 pages, 5 figures. This is the author version of a short paper accepted for presentation in the poster session at the 17th Conference on Spatial Information Theory (COSIT 2026)
summary: Individual level daily activity schedules are essential for a wide range of applications, including infectious disease control, urban transportation planning, and policy design. In practice, such schedules are typically generated by combining population data with travel survey data. These data sources are used because they are often publicly available, whereas observed individual activity schedules are difficult to obtain due to privacy concerns. However, because of the complexity of mobility modelling, it is difficult to generate realistic activity schedules that also preserve travel times consistent with those reported in travel surveys. To address this issue, we propose a framework for generating activity schedules that iteratively applies a dynamic programming method to allocate activity locations based on simulated travel times. Numerical experiments with dummy data show that the proposed method reduces the discrepancy between simulated travel times and those reported in travel surveys by 52.2% relative to the first iteration through iterative refinement.

AI.title_translation: 通过基于模拟旅行时间的活动地点分配生成真实的个体活动计划
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种迭代动态规划框架，通过基于模拟旅行时间的活动地点分配，生成与旅行调查数据一致的真实个体活动计划，显著减少了模拟旅行时间与调查数据之间的差异。
AI.motivation: 个体日常活动计划对于传染病控制、城市交通规划和政策设计等应用至关重要。现有方法难以生成既真实又与旅行调查数据旅行时间一致的活动计划，因为观测到的个体活动计划难以获取且移动建模复杂。
AI.method: 提出了一种迭代应用动态规划方法的框架，通过基于模拟旅行时间来分配活动地点，从而生成活动计划。
AI.result: 使用虚拟数据进行的数值实验表明，与第一次迭代相比，所提出的方法通过迭代优化，将模拟旅行时间与旅行调查报告的旅行时间之间的差异减少了52.2%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效生成与旅行调查数据一致的真实个体活动计划，显著改善了模拟旅行时间的准确性。
AI.translation: 个体层面的日常活动计划对于广泛的应用至关重要，包括传染病控制、城市交通规划和政策设计。在实践中，此类计划通常通过结合人口数据和旅行调查数据来生成。使用这些数据源是因为它们通常是公开可用的，而由于隐私问题，观测到的个体活动计划难以获取。然而，由于移动建模的复杂性，很难生成既真实又保留与旅行调查中报告的旅行时间一致的活动计划。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一个框架，通过迭代应用动态规划方法，根据模拟旅行时间分配活动地点，从而生成活动计划。使用虚拟数据进行的数值实验表明，与第一次迭代相比，所提出的方法通过迭代优化将模拟旅行时间与旅行调查报告的旅行时间之间的差异减少了52.2%。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种生成真实个体活动计划的框架，该框架通过迭代应用动态规划方法，基于模拟旅行时间来分配活动地点。鉴于现有方法难以生成与旅行调查数据中旅行时间一致的真实活动计划，该框架旨在解决这一问题。数值实验结果显示，与初始迭代相比，该方法能将模拟旅行时间与调查报告旅行时间之间的差异减少52.2%，表明其在提高活动计划真实性方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 个体活动计划, 旅行时间, 动态规划, 活动地点分配, 移动建模
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的迭代动态规划方法，用于生成更真实的个体活动计划，其创新之处在于将活动地点分配与模拟旅行时间相结合，并利用迭代优化显著减少了与实际旅行时间的偏差。这对于需要高精度个体活动数据的领域，如城市规划和疾病传播建模，具有重要意义。

title: When Do Conservation Laws Survive Learned Representations? Certified Horizons for Latent World Models
comments: 16 pages, including appendices. v2: second soft-survival system (Duffing double well, pre-registered) with a linear-oscillator anchor; 5-seed and step-size hardening of the state-Kepler result; 8-seed SympNet confirmation of the lift null. Code: https://github.com/TimothyWang418/se3-ejepa
summary: We ask a representation-learning question about physical world models: when does a conservation law remain certifiable after a model learns a latent representation? A certified horizon bounds -- in advance, from measurable model defects -- how many steps a rollout provably stays on a physical invariant's level set. The key design choice is what is certified: not a learned latent Hamiltonian or a learned scalar witness (a model can conserve either while drifting in true energy), but the decoded physical invariant obtained by decoding the latent state and evaluating the known invariant. Around this object we derive shell-horizon certificates whose budget decomposes into representation, readout, and latent-dynamics defects, with a monotone alignment bridge through which a soft learned witness yields a certified horizon for the decoded invariant, and test them across state, learned-lift, and pixel observations on conservative systems. Conservation certificates can survive learned representation, but not all geometric priors survive equally. Hard canonical symplectic structure yields the longest horizons in known phase coordinates yet does not cross a learned chart, whereas a controlled-Lipschitz-aligned soft invariant survives in the nonlinear learned-representation settings we test -- two lift systems, with the gain growing with nonlinearity, and pixels. Pixel certification is recovered on a readout-stable sub-tube, and the Kepler problem exposes a geometric boundary. The central object is therefore not a latent Hamiltonian, but a decoded physical invariant whose robustness to representation learning can be measured, certified, and falsified.
