title: Patnaik-Pearson intrinsic dimension for internal representations of neural networks
comments: 35 pages, 19 figures. Version Two : Minor edits and corrections
summary: We define a new measure of intrinsic dimension of a data manifold, which we call the Patnaik-Pearson dimension, and apply this to internal representations of neural networks, in particular transformers. The inspiration for this comes from the HTSR and SETOL work of Martin, Mahoney and Hinrichs, combined with the TwoNN intrinsic dimension estimator of Facco et al. We prove various properties of this intrinsic dimension estimator. Treating weight matrices of neural networks as data manifolds, for weight matrices whose Empirical Spectral Density follows a Pareto (Power Law) distribution, we relate the Patnaik-Pearson dimension to the HTSR and SETOL analysis, and show that critical values of the tail exponent coincide for the two approaches. Using a combination of theoretical and numerical techniques, we study the behaviour of the Patnaik-Pearson dimension of a data manifold under the transformations typical to neural networks. We apply this machinery to the BERT-base and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1 models, to investigate first the Patnaik-Pearson dimension of the initial data manifold of token embeddings, and second the evolution of the Patnaik-Pearson dimension as token embeddings pass through the layers of the model. Code and notebooks used for the numerical results presented here is available at https://github.com/tdhadfield/PatnaikPearson

AI.title_translation: 用于神经网络内部表示的Patnaik-Pearson内在维度分析
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Patnaik-Pearson的新型内在维度度量指标，用于量化神经网络内部表示（如Transformer权重和嵌入）的维度及其演化过程。
AI.motivation: 旨在建立一种新的度量标准，以更准确地刻画神经网络内部表示（特别是Transformer中的权重矩阵和词嵌入）的内在维度，并探究其与现有幂律分布理论（如HTSR/SETOL）的联系。
AI.method: 提出Patnaik-Pearson维度估计器；基于HTSR和SETOL方法论，结合TwoNN估计器；利用经验谱密度分析权重矩阵；结合理论推导与数值实验分析数据流形在网络变换下的行为。
AI.result: 证明了Patnaik-Pearson维度在特定条件下的属性；发现当经验谱密度遵循帕累托分布时，该维度与HTSR/SETOL分析中的关键尾部指数值相吻合；通过对BERT-base和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1模型的实验，揭示了词嵌入在神经网络层间演化的维度特征。
AI.conclusion: Patnaik-Pearson维度为评估神经网络内部表示的复杂性和维度演化提供了一个稳健的理论框架，并成功揭示了Transformer模型中嵌入表示随层数变化的动态过程。
AI.translation: 我们定义了一种新的数据流形内在维度度量方法，称之为Patnaik-Pearson维度，并将其应用于神经网络（特别是Transformer）的内部表示。其灵感来源于Martin、Mahoney和Hinrichs的HTSR和SETOL工作，并结合了Facco等人的TwoNN内在维度估计器。我们证明了该内在维度估计器的多种属性。将神经网络的权重矩阵视为数据流形，对于经验谱密度遵循帕累托（幂律）分布的权重矩阵，我们将Patnaik-Pearson维度与HTSR和SETOL分析联系起来，并证明了两种方法中尾部指数的临界值是一致的。通过结合理论与数值技术，我们研究了数据流形在神经网络典型变换下的Patnaik-Pearson维度行为。我们将该工具应用于BERT-base和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1模型，首先研究了标记嵌入初始数据流形的Patnaik-Pearson维度，其次研究了标记嵌入在通过模型各层时该维度的演化过程。文中使用的代码和笔记本可在https://github.com/tdhadfield/PatnaikPearson获取。
AI.summary: 本文引入了一种名为Patnaik-Pearson维度的内在维度衡量方法，并将其应用于分析Transformer模型的内部表示。研究通过结合统计物理理论与矩阵分析，建立了该维度与HTSR/SETOL方法的数学联系，并通过对BERT和DeepSeek模型进行实验，量化了词嵌入在网络层间的维度演化规律。
AI.keywords: 内在维度, 神经网络, Transformer, 谱密度, 嵌入表示
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新的内在维度衡量指标，通过结合统计物理和矩阵理论的方法，为理解神经网络（尤其是Transformer架构）内部表示提供了新的视角。其创新点在于将权重矩阵视为数据流形，并与现有的HTSR/SETOL分析建立了数学联系。局限性在于该方法在处理非幂律分布的复杂权重矩阵时的鲁棒性需进一步验证。

title: Orthogonal Discrepancy Kernels for Learning with Partial Physics
summary: We introduce a semi-parametric framework for nonlinear system identification, which decouples discrepancy functions from physics-based components. Orthogonal Gaussian process regression balances sparse parameter selection (the white box) with discrepancy learning (the black box) to produce interpretable models from incomplete physics.

AI.title_translation: 用于部分物理知识学习的正交偏差核方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合物理模型与高斯过程的半参数化框架，通过正交化处理实现了不完整物理知识下的可解释非线性系统辨识。
AI.motivation: 现有的非线性系统辨识方法难以平衡物理模型的准确性与黑盒模型的灵活性，尤其是在物理知识不完整的情况下。
AI.method: 提出了一种半参数化框架，利用正交高斯过程回归将基于物理的组件与偏差函数解耦，并结合稀疏参数选择进行学习。
AI.result: 该方法能够产生具有可解释性的模型，并有效处理不完整物理信息带来的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 通过正交高斯过程回归，该框架能够有效地从不完整的物理知识中学习，实现物理模型与数据驱动偏差学习的平衡。
AI.translation: 我们引入了一种用于非线性系统辨识的半参数化框架，将偏差函数与基于物理的组件进行解耦。正交高斯过程回归在稀疏参数选择（白盒）与偏差学习（黑盒）之间取得平衡，从而从不完整的物理信息中生成可解释的模型。
AI.summary: 本文引入了一种用于非线性系统辨识的半参数化框架，通过正交高斯过程回归将物理模型组件与偏差函数解耦，从而在利用不完整物理知识的同时，保持了模型的可解释性和灵活性。
AI.keywords: 非线性系统辨识, 正交高斯过程回归, 物理信息机器学习, 模型可解释性
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种巧妙结合物理模型（白盒）与高斯过程（黑盒）的方法，通过正交化处理解决了两者之间的耦合问题，在保证可解释性的同时提高了非线性系统辨识的灵活性。其局限性在于未在摘要中明确计算复杂度和在大规模数据集上的扩展性。

title: List $3$-coloring $C_4$-free graphs of diameter-$2$ in polynomial-time
summary: We show that list $3$-coloring a~$C_4$-free graph of diameter-$2$ can be done in polynomial-time. Our algorithm is based on a structural characterization showing that many such graphs are not~$3$-colorable. In particular, we show that~$C_4$-free graphs of diameter-$2$ without universal vertices, where the maximum degree is at least~$17$, are not~$3$-colorable.

AI.title_translation: 在多项式时间内对直径为2的无$C_4$图进行列表3-着色
AI.tldr: 本文证明了直径为2且无$C_4$的图的列表3-着色问题可在多项式时间内求解，并给出了其不可3-着色的结构条件。
AI.motivation: 探索在特定图结构约束（无$C_4$且直径为2）下，列表3-着色问题的计算复杂性。
AI.method: 利用图的结构化特征分析，证明了在特定结构约束下，许多此类图并非3-可着色，从而简化了着色问题的判定过程。
AI.result: 证明了列表3-着色问题在直径为2且无$C_4$的图上可以在多项式时间内完成，并确定了该类图中不可3-着色的结构临界条件（最大度数$\ge 17$且无全能顶点）。
AI.conclusion: 对于直径为2且无$C_4$的图，列表3-着色问题可以在多项式时间内求解。此外，当此类图不包含全能顶点且最大度数至少为17时，它们必定不可3-着色。
AI.translation: 我们证明了直径为2且无$C_4$的图的列表3-着色问题可以在多项式时间内完成。我们的算法基于一种结构特征，该特征表明许多此类图是不可3-着色的。特别地，我们证明了直径为2且无$C_4$的图中，若不含全能顶点且最大度数至少为17，则该图不可3-着色。
AI.summary: 本文研究了直径为2且不含$C_4$诱导子图的图的列表3-着色问题。作者通过结构化分析证明，该类图的列表3-着色问题可以在多项式时间内求解。此外，研究还发现，当此类图不含全能顶点且最大度数至少为17时，该图一定不是3-可着色的。
AI.keywords: 列表3-着色, $C_4$-free图, 直径2, 多项式时间算法
AI.comments: 该论文通过结构化分析，将一个原本困难的图着色问题限制在特定条件下，从而实现了多项式时间算法。其创新点在于利用了直径和无$C_4$子图的结构约束，特别是对于最大度数较大的图给出了非3-可着色的结论。这一研究对于理解图的结构性质与着色复杂性之间的联系具有重要意义。

title: A Geometry-Adaptive Regularized Newton-Type Method for Manifold-Affine Intersection Problems
summary: We propose Regularized Newton-SLRA (RN-SLRA), a regularized Newton-type method for local manifold--affine intersection problems motivated by structured low-rank approximation. Classical Newton-SLRA achieves fast local convergence under transversality, but its tangent-space intersection step may become ill-defined, singular, or severely ill-conditioned when transversality fails. RN-SLRA overcomes this difficulty by replacing the exact tangent-space intersection step with a regularized quadratic subproblem over the affine space. Under intrinsic transversality, we prove local linear convergence to the intersection. Under transversality, we show that a residual-dependent choice of the regularization parameter yields higher-order local convergence; in particular, the method converges quadratically for the linear residual rule. We also analyze an inexact variant based on quasioptimal manifold projections. When the quasioptimality constant is sufficiently accurate, the inexact method retains local residual convergence. Numerical experiments on constructed degenerate SLRA instances and Hankel-structured examples illustrate the robustness of RN-SLRA in settings where Newton-SLRA may fail, and show that the inexact variant can reduce the projection cost in large-scale problems.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于流形-仿射交集问题的几何自适应正则化牛顿型方法
AI.tldr: RN-SLRA通过正则化子问题解决了流形-仿射交集问题中传统牛顿法在病态情况下的失效问题，并实现了稳健的局部收敛。
AI.motivation: 传统的Newton-SLRA方法在横截性失效时，切空间交集步可能变得未定义、奇异或严重病态，导致算法失效。
AI.method: 提出了一种正则化牛顿型方法（RN-SLRA），用正则化二次子问题取代了传统的切空间交集步；同时分析了基于准最优流形投影的非精确变体。
AI.result: 在内蕴横截性下证明了局部线性收敛；在横截性下，通过残差依赖的正则化参数选择可实现高阶收敛（线性残差规则下实现二次收敛）；非精确变体在准最优常数足够准确时保持局部残差收敛。实验证实了其在退化SLRA实例中的稳健性。
AI.conclusion: RN-SLRA通过引入正则化机制，成功解决了流形-仿射交集问题中传统方法在横截性失效时的不稳定性，并在理论和实验上证明了其收敛性和稳健性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于局部流形-仿射交集问题的正则化牛顿型方法（RN-SLRA），其灵感源于结构化低秩逼近。经典的Newton-SLRA在横截性条件下可实现快速局部收敛，但当横截性失效时，其切空间交集步可能变得未定义、奇异或严重病态。RN-SLRA通过将切空间交集步替换为仿射空间上的正则化二次子问题，克服了这一困难。在内蕴横截性下，我们证明了其对交集的局部线性收敛性。在横截性下，我们证明了残差依赖的正则化参数选择可产生高阶局部收敛；特别是，该方法在线性残差规则下表现为二次收敛。我们还分析了一种基于准最优流形投影的非精确变体。当准最优常数足够准确时，非精确方法保留了局部残差收敛性。在构建的退化SLRA实例和Hankel结构示例上的数值实验表明，RN-SLRA在Newton-SLRA可能失效的设置中具有稳健性，并显示非精确变体可以降低大规模问题中的投影成本。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为RN-SLRA的正则化牛顿型方法，用于解决流形-仿射交集问题。通过将传统的切空间交集步替换为正则化二次子问题，该方法克服了在横截性失效时传统方法存在的数值不稳定问题，并证明了其在多种条件下的局部收敛性及非精确变体的有效性。
AI.keywords: 流形-仿射交集, 结构化低秩逼近, 牛顿法, 正则化, 局部收敛性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了正则化二次子问题来解决传统Newton-SLRA方法在横截性失效时的病态问题，增强了数值稳定性。其重要性在于为结构化低秩逼近（SLRA）提供了一种更稳健的求解方案，特别是在处理退化情形时。局限性在于该方法主要针对局部收敛性，未提及全局收敛性保证。

title: Spectral Geometry and Bosonic-Bloch Probes: Explorations in Quantum Learning
summary: This paper studies how spectral geometry emerges in quantum learning models and how it can be diagnosed with physically grounded probes. In graph-regularized quantum networks, training reorganizes the output similarity graph, increases the effective spectral dimension Delta S = +0.23, and reshapes the Laplacian spectrum. Edge-resolved two-boson interference directly probes this restructuring: the bosonic enhancement Delta P_uv correlates with the Fiedler edge split |Delta v_2| (r = -0.50), linking learned spectral partitions to interference signatures. A phase diagram shows a nonmonotonic dependence of performance on coupling strength gamma and noise delta, with graph regularization improving fidelity only in a restricted regime; hardware experiments confirm the predicted interference behavior within shot-noise uncertainty. We also analyze a hybrid quantum autoencoder and introduce Bloch-space drift as a geometric diagnostic of its latent representation. With an unsupervised benign-data threshold, the model achieves high ranking performance (ROC-AUC about 0.99) and negligible false-negative rates. Absolute Bloch drift strongly discriminates anomalies (ROC-AUC at least about 0.9), while consecutive drift is near random (ROC-AUC about 0.5), showing that detection arises from persistent state-space displacement rather than local fluctuations. Through the geometry of reduced single-qubit states and associated quantum Fisher information, these results show that learning-induced spectral organization appears as measurable quantum-state structure, establishing a unified spectral-geometric framework for diagnosing quantum learning systems with bosonic and Bloch probes.

AI.title_translation: 谱几何与玻色子-Bloch探针：量子学习探索
AI.tldr: 本文通过玻色子干涉和Bloch空间漂移等物理手段，揭示了量子学习模型中的谱几何结构，并验证了其在性能诊断和异常检测中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 探索量子学习模型中谱几何的涌现机制，并寻找能够诊断这些几何结构的物理基础探针。
AI.method: 利用图正则化量子网络进行训练，通过边解析的双玻色子干涉测量拉普拉斯谱的重构，并引入Bloch空间漂移作为混合量子自动编码器潜在表示的几何诊断工具。
AI.result: 实验发现训练增加了有效谱维数，玻色子增强与Fiedler边分裂显著相关；混合量子自动编码器在异常检测中表现优异（ROC-AUC约0.99），且Bloch漂移能有效区分异常状态。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一个统一的谱几何框架，证明了量子学习过程中产生的谱组织可以通过玻色子和Bloch探针进行测量，为诊断量子学习系统提供了有效方法。
AI.translation: 本文研究了谱几何如何在量子学习模型中涌现，以及如何利用具有物理基础的探针对其进行诊断。在图正则化量子网络中，训练过程会重组输出相似度图，增加有效谱维数（Delta S = +0.23），并重塑拉普拉斯谱。边解析的双玻色子干涉直接探测了这种重构：玻色子增强（Delta P_uv）与Fiedler边分裂（|Delta v_2|）相关（r = -0.50），将学习到的谱划分与干涉特征联系起来。性能随耦合强度和噪声的依赖关系呈现非单调性，相图显示图正则化仅在特定范围内提高保真度；硬件实验证实了预测的干涉行为。此外，本文分析了混合量子自动编码器，并引入Bloch空间漂移作为其潜在表示的几何诊断工具。通过无监督的良性数据阈值，模型实现了高排序性能（ROC-AUC约0.99）和极低的假阴性率。绝对Bloch漂移能有效识别异常（ROC-AUC至少约0.9），而连续漂移表现接近随机（ROC-AUC约0.5），表明检测源于持久的状态空间位移而非局部波动。通过约化单量子位态的几何结构及相关的量子Fisher信息，这些结果表明学习诱导的谱组织表现为可测量的量子态结构，为利用玻色子和Bloch探针诊断量子学习系统建立了统一的谱几何框架。
AI.summary: 本文研究了量子学习模型中的谱几何涌现，提出利用玻色子干涉和Bloch空间漂移作为物理探针，通过实验验证了学习过程如何重构网络谱结构，并证明这些几何特征可用于诊断量子学习系统的性能与异常。
AI.keywords: 量子学习, 谱几何, 玻色子干涉, Bloch空间漂移, 量子神经网络
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将谱几何与量子机器学习相结合，通过玻色子干涉和Bloch空间漂移等物理探针，为理解量子神经网络的内部学习机制提供了全新的几何视角，具有重要的理论与实验意义。

title: Sample Complexities of Estimating Gumbel--Max Watermark Proportions with and without Reduction to Pivotal Statistics
summary: Watermarking promises statistical traceability of large language model (LLM) uses, but real documents rarely arrive as purely human-written or purely LLM-generated. This motivates a quantitative question beyond detection: what proportion of a document is generated from a pre-specified watermarked LLM? We study this watermark proportion estimation problem under the Gumbel--max watermarking mechanism, treating the next-token prediction distributions as unknown and arbitrary nuisance parameters subject to a non-degeneracy condition. We compare two observation regimes: in the full observation regime, the estimator observes the pseudorandom vector and the selected token at each position; in the more prevalent setting of pivotal reduction, it observes only a scalar pivot, which follows a one-dimensional Uniform--Beta mixture distribution. Under pivotal reduction, we develop a Laguerre-polynomial estimator and establish a matching information-theoretic lower bound for the sample complexity. For full observation, we introduce an event-counting estimator and show a matching lower bound, yielding a substantially smaller sample complexity. As our results imply, although reducing to pivotal statistics is an elegant and prevalent choice, it is not always sample-efficient for estimating the proportion of watermarks.

AI.title_translation: 估计Gumbel-Max水印比例的样本复杂度：论枢轴统计量简化的得与失
AI.tldr: 本文研究了如何准确估计文档中由LLM生成的水印比例。研究发现，虽然将数据简化为枢轴统计量是常见的做法，但这会降低估计效率；相比之下，直接使用完整观察数据可以显著减少所需的样本量。
AI.motivation: 现有的水印研究多关注“是否由LLM生成”的二分类检测，但实际应用中更需要定量分析文档中LLM生成内容的比例，且需解决在未知且任意的下一词预测分布（冗余参数）下的估计问题。
AI.method: 针对枢轴简化情形，开发了拉盖尔（Laguerre）多项式估计器；针对完整观察情形，引入了事件计数估计器；并为两种情形分别推导了信息论下界以验证匹配性。
AI.result: 在枢轴简化下，建立了拉盖尔估计器及其匹配的样本复杂度下界；在完整观察下，证明了事件计数估计器具有显著更小的样本复杂度，并给出了匹配下界。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，虽然将问题简化为枢轴统计量在分析上很优雅，但在估计水印比例时并非总是样本高效的。在完整观察下，可以实现显著更低的样本复杂度。
AI.translation: 水印技术为追踪大语言模型（LLM）的使用提供了统计学上的可能性，但在现实中，文档很少是纯粹的人类撰写或纯粹的LLM生成。这激发了一个超出检测范围的定量问题：一份文档中有多少比例是由预设的水印LLM生成的？本文在Gumbel-max水印机制下研究了这一水印比例估计问题，将下一词预测分布视为受非退化条件约束的未知且任意的冗余参数。我们比较了两种观察方案：在完整观察方案中，估计器观察每个位置的伪随机向量和所选token；在更常见的枢轴简化设置中，它仅观察一个标量枢轴，该枢轴服从一维均匀-Beta混合分布。在枢轴简化下，我们开发了一种拉盖尔（Laguerre）多项式估计器，并建立了匹配的信息论样本复杂度下界。对于完整观察，我们引入了一种事件计数估计器并展示了匹配的下界，证明了其具有显著更小的样本复杂度。正如我们的结果所暗示的，尽管简化为枢轴统计量是一种优雅且普遍的选择，但在估计水印比例时，它并不总是样本高效的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在Gumbel-max水印机制下估计LLM生成文本比例的问题。作者比较了两种观察模式：枢轴统计量简化模式与完整观察模式，并分别提出了相应的估计器。研究证明，尽管枢轴简化在数学上很方便，但完整观察模式能显著降低估计水印比例所需的样本复杂度。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 水印比例估计, Gumbel-max机制, 样本复杂度, 枢轴统计量
AI.comments: 该研究在LLM水印领域具有重要意义，揭示了常用的“枢轴统计量简化”方法在估计水印比例时可能存在的样本效率损失。通过数学证明，作者对比了完整观察与枢轴简化下的样本复杂度差异，为水印检测系统的设计提供了理论指导。

title: Alternating Optimization for Joint Resource Allocation in Full-Duplex Multi-Sector Fluid Antenna-Enabled Near-Field Systems
summary: This paper proposes a full duplex fluid antenna near field system (FD-FANS) with a multi-sector antenna array that jointly exploits resource allocation, antenna mobility, and group-based transmitting (TX) and receiving (RX) partitioning. A spherical wave uplink downlink channel is established that accounts for residual self interference (SI), wireless energy transfer (WET), and geometric constraints on antenna motion. Within the FD-FANS framework, an efficient protocol is devised to enable simultaneous downlink energy transmission (DET) and uplink data transmission (UDT) at the base station (BS). Furthermore, we formulate, for both perfect and imperfect SI cancellation (SIC), a weighted sum rate (WSR) maximization problem over time power allocation, antenna positions, and binary group selection, under practical average and peak power limits, per antenna box constraints, minimum spacing, and a half TX half RX balance. To tackle the resulting non convex mixed integer design, we develop an efficient alternating optimization (AO) framework based on majorization minimization successive convex approximation (MM SCA). The proposed algorithm monotonically improves the objective and converges to a stationary solution of a continuous relaxation. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves consistent performance gains over several benchmark designs, including half duplex FANS (HD FANS), FD fixed position antenna near field system (FD FPANS), non-grouped FD FANS, and far field counterparts, in terms of average sum rate (ASR), energy efficiency (EE), and user fairness, while exhibiting robustness to residual SI and channel uncertainty.

AI.title_translation: 全双工多扇区流体天线近场系统中联合资源分配的交替优化研究
AI.tldr: 提出了一种全双工流体天线近场优化框架，通过交替优化算法联合处理天线移动、功率分配与分组，显著提升了系统性能。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决全双工流体天线系统在近场环境下，由于自干扰、无线能量传输及天线几何约束导致的资源分配复杂性挑战，以提升系统整体性能。
AI.method: 利用球面波信道模型，针对加权和速率（WSR）最大化问题，开发了一种基于主要化最小化（MM）与连续凸近似（SCA）的交替优化（AO）框架，以协同优化功率分配、天线位置及分组选择。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，该方案在平均和速率、能量效率和用户公平性方面均优于半双工流体天线系统及固定位置天线系统，且对残余自干扰和信道不确定性具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 所提AO算法能够有效解决全双工流体天线近场系统中的非凸资源分配问题，并在系统和速率、能量效率及用户公平性方面显著优于传统基准方案。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种具有多扇区天线阵列的全双工流体天线近场系统（FD-FANS），旨在联合利用资源分配、天线移动性以及基于分组的发送（TX）和接收（RX）分区。建立了一个球面波上行下行信道模型，考虑了残余自干扰（SI）、无线能量传输（WET）以及天线运动的几何约束。在FD-FANS框架内，设计了一种高效协议以实现基站（BS）处的同步下行能量传输（DET）和上行数据传输（UDT）。此外，针对完美和非完美自干扰消除（SIC），在考虑实际平均和峰值功率限制、天线盒约束、最小间距以及半TX半RX平衡的情况下，构建了关于时间功率分配、天线位置和二进制分组选择的加权和速率（WSR）最大化问题。为了解决由此产生的非凸混合整数设计问题，开发了一种基于主要化最小化（MM）与连续凸近似（SCA）的高效交替优化（AO）框架。所提算法单调改进目标函数并收敛到连续松弛问题的平稳解。仿真结果表明，所提方案在平均和速率（ASR）、能量效率（EE）和用户公平性方面，均优于半双工流体天线系统（HD-FANS）、全双工固定位置天线近场系统（FD-FPANS）、非分组FD-FANS以及远场方案，并对残余自干扰和信道不确定性表现出鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种全双工流体天线近场系统（FD-FANS），通过联合优化天线位置、功率分配及分组策略，实现了下行无线能量传输与上行数据传输的同步。作者构建了球面波信道模型并开发了高效的交替优化算法，有效提升了系统的传输速率与能效。
AI.keywords: 全双工, 流体天线, 近场系统, 资源分配, 交替优化
AI.comments: 该研究将流体天线技术与全双工多扇区系统结合，并针对近场球面波模型进行了复杂资源分配优化。其创新点在于将天线位置的可移动性与分组划分相结合，利用MM-SCA算法有效解决了非凸混合整数规划问题，为提升近场通信系统的频谱与能量效率提供了新的设计框架。

title: Generalizable framework of eating episode detection on free-living wrist-worn wearable data
comments: This manuscript has been submitted to a peer-reviewed journal and is currently under review
summary: Accurate assessment of eating behavior is essential for understanding and managing conditions such as eating disorders, obesity, and diabetes. Wearable-based food intake detection has shown considerable promise; however, most existing approaches are trained and evaluated using internal validation on a single dataset with fixed sensor orientation and known wearing hand, which limits their generalizability to real-world settings. Furthermore, many existing approaches rely on both accelerometer (acc) and gyroscope (gyro) signals to achieve strong performance. However, gyro measurements may be unavailable in some real-world deployments due to battery constraints, and performance often degrades when only acc data are used. We propose a generalizable framework for orientation-invariant eating episode detection, with an acc2gyro module to improve performance in acc-only settings. The framework is trained using fine-grained wrist-worn datasets and externally validated across three heterogeneous datasets: the Clemson All-Day (CAD) and Capture-24 datasets, as well as Physio-ED, a dataset collected from individuals with eating disorders. Across external evaluations, the proposed framework demonstrates robust performance despite substantial variations in sensor modality, wearing hand, participant population, and annotation protocols. Specifically, the framework achieved F1-scores of 0.751, 0.592, and 0.793 on CAD, Capture-24, and Physio-ED, respectively, with CAD performance exceeding recent state-of-the-art methods evaluated using internal validation only. This study provides the first external validation of eating episode detection in an eating disorder population. Additionally, the acc2gyro module improves the performance in acc-only settings. These findings demonstrate the potential of orientation-invariant wearable sensing for scalable and clinically applicable assessment of eating behavior.

title: Channel Knowledge Map Reconstruction From Sparse Measurements via Pilot-Anchored Layout-Conditioned Fourier Refinement
comments: 13 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications
summary: Channel knowledge maps (CKMs) enable environment-aware wireless systems by providing location-specific channel knowledge, but long-term environmental variations, such as construction, traffic redistribution, and foliage changes, require periodic map refresh. In practice, channel measurements are often sparse and irregular, while environmental knowledge may be limited to coarse layout or topology descriptors. This paper studies CKM reconstruction from sparse measurements. We show that reconstruction pipelines that apply local aggregation or spectral operators directly to a zero-filled pilot grid can entangle the sampling mask with the channel field, allowing structural priors to act on mask-induced distortions before the measurements define a supported radio field. To address this issue, we propose Anchor-CKM, a measurement-first, knowledge-aided reconstruction framework. Anchor-CKM first uses support-aware partial convolutions to construct a pilot-supported representation, and then performs layout-conditioned dual-path Fourier refinement followed by coordinate-based heteroscedastic prediction of the CKM mean and per-location predictive variance. Experiments on transmitter-disjoint DeepMIMO scenarios cover missing ratios from 0.3 to 0.95, including stringent 5% to 10% pilot-coverage settings. In explicit-layout outdoor scenarios, Anchor-CKM reduces received-power root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 0.79 to 1.33 dB relative to the strongest reproduced baseline, while ablations identify pilot-support stabilization as the largest contributor and layout conditioning as beneficial for line-of-sight/non-line-of-sight (LOS/NLOS) boundary fidelity.

AI.title_translation: 基于导频锚定与布局条件傅里叶细化的稀疏测量信道知识地图重构
AI.tldr: 本文提出了Anchor-CKM框架，利用支持感知部分卷积和布局条件双路径傅里叶细化，从稀疏、不规则的测量中高效且高精度地重构信道知识地图。
AI.motivation: 长期环境变化（如建筑施工、交通重新分布和植被变化）要求定期更新信道知识地图（CKM）。然而，实际中的信道测量通常是稀疏且不规则的。直接在零填充导频网格上应用局部聚合或谱算子会导致采样掩码与信道场纠缠，使结构先验在测量定义支撑无线电场之前就作用于掩码引起的畸变。因此，需要一种能够从稀疏测量和粗糙环境布局中准确重构CKM的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种“测量优先、知识辅助”的重构框架 Anchor-CKM。该框架首先使用支持感知部分卷积（support-aware partial convolutions）来构建导频支撑的表示，然后进行布局条件双路径傅里叶细化（layout-conditioned dual-path Fourier refinement），最后基于坐标对CKM均值和每个位置的预测方差进行异方差预测（heteroscedastic prediction）。
AI.result: 在发射机不相交的DeepMIMO场景下进行实验，涵盖了0.3到0.95的缺失比例（包括5%到10%的极低导频覆盖率）。在显式布局的室外场景中，与最强的复现基线相比，Anchor-CKM将接收功率均方根误差（RMSE）降低了0.79至1.33 dB。消融实验表明，导频支撑稳定化是性能提升的最大贡献者，而布局条件对于视距/非视距（LOS/NLOS）边界保真度非常有益。
AI.conclusion: Anchor-CKM通过解决采样掩码与信道场纠缠的问题，能够有效地从极度稀疏和不规则的测量数据中重构高精度的信道知识地图，其中导频支撑稳定化和布局条件对提高重构精度和边界保真度起到了关键作用。
AI.translation: 信道知识地图（CKM）通过提供特定位置的信道知识来支持环境感知无线系统，但长期的环境变化（如建筑施工、交通重新分布和植被变化）需要定期更新地图。在实际应用中，信道测量往往是稀疏且不规则的，而环境知识可能仅限于粗糙的布局或拓扑描述。本文研究了基于稀疏测量的CKM重构。我们表明，直接在零填充导频网格上应用局部聚合或谱算子的重构流程会使采样掩码与信道场纠缠在一起，导致结构先验在测量定义支撑无线电场之前就作用于掩码引起的畸变。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Anchor-CKM，这是一个“测量优先、知识辅助”的重构框架。Anchor-CKM首先使用支持感知部分卷积来构建导频支撑的表示，然后进行布局条件双路径傅里叶细化，最后基于坐标对CKM均值和每个位置的预测方差进行异方差预测。在发射机不相交的DeepMIMO场景中进行的实验涵盖了0.3到0.95的缺失比例，包括极端的5%到10%导频覆盖率设置。在显式布局的室外场景中，与最强的复现基线相比，Anchor-CKM将接收功率均方根误差（RMSE）降低了0.79至1.33 dB，而消融实验表明导频支撑稳定化是贡献最大的因素，布局条件对视距/非视距（LOS/NLOS）边界保真度有益。
AI.summary: 本文针对无线通信中信道知识地图（CKM）因环境变化需要从稀疏、不规则的测量中定期更新的问题，提出了一种名为Anchor-CKM的重构框架。该框架克服了传统方法中采样掩码与信道场纠缠的缺陷，采用“测量优先、知识辅助”的设计。它首先利用支持感知部分卷积建立导频支撑表示，再通过布局条件双路径傅里叶细化和基于坐标的异方差预测来估计CKM均值和预测方差。实验表明，该方法在极高缺失率下仍能显著降低接收功率的RMSE，展现出优异的重构性能和边界保真度。
AI.keywords: 信道知识地图, 稀疏重构, 傅里叶细化, 部分卷积, 深度学习
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：提出了“测量优先、知识辅助”的重构思路，利用支持感知部分卷积有效解决了稀疏采样中掩码与信道场纠缠的问题。
2. 实用性：在极其稀疏（如仅5%-10%的导频覆盖率）的场景下，仍能实现高精度的CKM重构，对未来环境感知无线系统非常重要。
3. 局限性：摘要中主要在DeepMIMO仿真场景下进行了评估，实际复杂多变环境中的鲁棒性仍有待在真实物理环境中进一步验证。

title: Beyond Words: Towards Effective Modeling of Non-Verbal Vocalizations in ASR
summary: Modern automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems excel at transcribing lexical content but often omit nonverbal vocalizations (NVs), such as laughter, breaths, coughs, and cries, that carry conversational and affective information. Modeling NVs in ASR is challenging because NV annotations are sparse and highly long-tailed, with frequent categories such as breaths and laughter dominating rarer events such as cries and coughs. We study three data-centric strategies for improving low-resource NV recognition: (1) a two-stage curriculum that first maps all NV events to a generic token and then fine-tunes on target categories; (2) inter-token transfer from high-resource events, such as laughter and breath, to rare events, such as crying; and (3) voice-conversion augmentation with class balancing. Experiments show that shared acoustic structure across vocal events can be exploited to improve rare-category detection while preserving lexical ASR quality.

AI.title_translation: 言外之意：在语音识别中实现非言语发声的有效建模
AI.tldr: 本文提出了三种以数据为中心的策略，通过利用共享声学结构来改善自动语音识别中稀有非言语发声（如哭声、咳嗽）的检测，同时保证了文本识别的质量。
AI.motivation: 尽管现代ASR系统擅长转写文本，但往往忽略了携带丰富对话和情感信息的非言语发声（如笑声、哭声等）。此外，非言语发声的标注数据极度稀疏且呈长尾分布（常见发声主导了罕见发声），给建模带来了巨大挑战。
AI.method: 研究了三种以数据为中心的低资源NV识别改进策略：（1）两阶段课程学习：先将所有NV事件映射为通用标记，再对目标类别进行微调；（2）词元间迁移：从高资源事件（如笑声、呼吸）向稀有事件（如哭泣）迁移知识；（3）带类别平衡的声音转换增强。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法能够有效利用不同发声事件之间共享的声学结构来提高稀有类别的检测效果，同时保持了词汇ASR的识别质量。
AI.conclusion: 利用不同非言语发声事件之间共享的声学结构，配合所提出的三种数据中心策略，可以显著提升稀有发声类别的检测性能，且不会对原有的词汇语音识别质量产生负面影响。
AI.translation: 现代自动语音识别（ASR）系统在转写词汇内容方面表现出色，但往往会忽略非言语发声（NVs，如笑声、呼吸、咳嗽和哭声），而这些发声承载着对话和情感信息。在ASR中对NVs进行建模具有挑战性，因为NV标注非常稀疏且呈现高度的长尾分布，呼吸和笑声等高频类别在其中占据主导地位，而哭声和咳嗽等罕见事件则较少。我们研究了三种旨在改善低资源NV识别的以数据为中心的策略：（1）两阶段课程学习，首先将所有NV事件映射到一个通用标记，然后针对目标类别进行微调；（2）词元间迁移，即从高资源事件（如笑声和呼吸）向稀有事件（如哭泣）进行迁移；（3）结合类别平衡的声音转换增强。实验表明，可以利用不同发声事件之间共享的声学结构来提高罕见类别的检测能力，同时保持词汇ASR的质量。
AI.summary: 本文针对ASR中非言语发声（NV）标注稀疏和长尾分布的挑战，提出了三种以数据为中心的优化策略（包括两阶段课程学习、跨词元迁移和声音转换增强）。实验表明，这些方法通过共享声学结构提升了罕见发声事件的检测能力，且不损害文本识别性能。
AI.keywords: 自动语音识别 (ASR), 非言语发声 (NVs), 长尾分布, 课程学习, 声音转换
AI.comments: 本文针对自动语音识别（ASR）中长期被忽视但具有重要情感和交互价值的非言语发声（NV）建模展开研究，具有很强的实用价值。其创新点在于从“数据中心”的角度出发，设计了课程学习、跨词元迁移和声音转换三种策略，有效利用了不同发声之间的共享声学结构，解决了极度不平衡的长尾分布问题。局限性在于摘要未提及在具体何种基准数据集上进行了验证，以及这些策略对模型推理延迟的影响。

title: Waveform Design for Underwater Simultaneous Acoustic Information and Power Transfer
summary: Simultaneous acoustic information and power transfer (SAIPT) plays a crucial role in enabling self-sustainable and maintenance-free Internet of Underwater Things (IoUT) networks. This paper studies a multicarrier underwater SAIPT system that jointly considers the frequency-dependent characteristics of acoustic transducers and the nonlinear behavior of rectifier circuits. The waveform vector is firstly optimized using the successive convex approximation (SCA) method under constraints on average and peak transmit power for acoustic power transfer (APT). Then, in the SAIPT scenario, both the power splitting factor and waveform vectors are jointly optimized through an alternating optimization (AO) framework based on SCA, subject to transmit power and achievable rate constraints. Simulation results demonstrate that incorporating the transducer's frequency response, rectifier nonlinearity, and the high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) of multicarrier waveforms leads to a significant improvement in acoustic energy transfer efficiency. The results also show that the energy harvesting DC output can be further enhanced by properly choosing system parameters, such as the number of subcarriers and subcarrier spacing.

AI.title_translation: 水下声学信息与能量同步传输的波形设计
AI.tldr: 本文通过联合考虑换能器频率特性和整流器非线性，提出了一种用于水下声学信息与能量同步传输（SAIPT）的多载波波形优化设计方法，显著提升了能量传输效率。
AI.motivation: 为了实现自维持和免维护的水下物联网（IoUT）网络，需要研究水下声学信息与能量同步传输（SAIPT）技术。然而，现有的波形设计需要克服声学换能器的频率相关特性以及整流电路的非线性行为带来的挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于多载波的波形设计方法。首先，在声能传输（APT）的平均和峰值发射功率约束下，利用渐进凸逼近（SCA）方法优化波形向量。随后，在SAIPT场景下，基于SCA构建交替优化（AO）框架，在发射功率和可达速率约束下，联合优化功率分裂因子和波形向量。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，联合考虑换能器频率响应、整流器非线性以及多载波波形的高峰均功率比（PAPR）能显著提高声能传输效率。同时，通过合理选择子载波数量和子载波间隔等系统参数，可以进一步增强收集到的直流电能输出。
AI.conclusion: 合理设计多载波SAIPT系统的波形并考虑换能器频率响应和整流器非线性等实际物理特性，能够显著提升水下无线能量收集和信息传输的性能，这对于实现自维持的水下物联网至关重要。
AI.translation: 声学信息与能量同步传输（SAIPT）在实现自维持和免维护的水下物联网（IoUT）网络中起着至关重要的作用。本文研究了一种多载波水下 SAIPT 系统，该系统联合考虑了声学换能器的频率相关特性和整流电路的非线性行为。首先，在声学能量传输（APT）的平均和峰值发射功率约束下，利用渐进凸逼近（SCA）方法对波形向量进行了优化。然后，在 SAIPT 场景下，在发射功率和可达速率约束下，通过基于 SCA 的交替优化（AO）框架联合优化了功率分裂因子和波形向量。仿真结果表明，结合换能器的频率响应、整流器非线性以及多载波波形的高峰均功率比（PAPR），可以显著提高声能传输效率。结果还表明，通过合理选择子载波数量和子载波间隔等系统参数，可以进一步提高能量收集的直流输出。
AI.summary: 本文针对水下物联网提出了一种多载波水下声学信息与能量同步传输（SAIPT）系统的波形设计方案。该方案联合考虑了声学换能器的频率特性和整流器的非线性特征，通过渐进凸逼近（SCA）和交替优化（AO）算法对波形向量和功率分裂因子进行优化。仿真表明，该方法显著提升了声能传输效率，并可通过优化子载波参数进一步提高收集电能。
AI.keywords: 水下声学信息与能量同步传输 (SAIPT), 波形设计, 渐进凸逼近 (SCA), 整流器非线性, 水下物联网 (IoUT)
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将声学换能器的频率选择性与整流电路的非线性行为共同纳入多载波水下SAIPT系统的波形设计中，这种物理层特性的联合建模更符合实际水下声通与能量传输系统的物理约束。其局限性在于摘要中仅提到仿真验证，若能有实际水池或海试实验数据支持将更具说服力。

title: Enhancing Acoustic-to-Articulatory Inversion with Multi-Target Pretraining for Low-Resource Settings
summary: Acoustic-to-Articulatory Inversion (AAI) estimates vocal tract articulator movements from speech, benefiting tasks like ASR, speech synthesis, and speaker verification. While deep learning-based methods (CNNs, RNNs, Transformers) have advanced AAI, recent studies show that Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) features further enhance performance, particularly in low-resource settings. However, SSL feature extractors introduce inference latency and computational overhead. To address this, we propose a novel pretraining method leveraging three target representations-Phoneme Labels, Articulatory Feature Labels, and Critical-articulator Labels-eliminating the need for an SSL extractor during inference. We evaluate our approach against both baseline and SSL-based models across various data conditions. Results demonstrate that our method consistently improves AAI performance, particularly in low-resource scenarios, while significantly reducing inference costs without sacrificing accuracy.

AI.title_translation: 采用多目标预训练增强低资源设置下的声学-发音反演
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新的预训练方法，利用音素、发音特征和关键发音器标签，在低资源环境下显著提高声学-发音反演（AAI）性能，同时减少推理成本，无需自监督学习（SSL）特征提取器。
AI.motivation: 现有的深度学习AAI方法结合SSL特征虽然能提高性能，尤其是在低资源环境下，但SSL特征提取器会引入推理延迟和计算开销。本文旨在解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出一种新颖的预训练方法，利用三种目标表示：音素标签、发音特征标签和关键发音器标签。这种方法在推理时无需SSL特征提取器。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法持续提升了AAI性能，尤其是在低资源场景中，并且显著降低了推理成本，同时没有牺牲准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该多目标预训练方法在低资源AAI任务中表现优异，有效解决了SSL特征提取器的计算开销问题，同时保持甚至提升了性能。
AI.translation: 声学-发音反演（AAI）从语音中估计声道的发音器官运动，有益于ASR、语音合成和说话人验证等任务。虽然基于深度学习的方法（CNN、RNN、Transformer）推动了AAI的发展，但最近的研究表明，自监督学习（SSL）特征进一步提升了性能，尤其是在低资源设置下。然而，SSL特征提取器引入了推理延迟和计算开销。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的预训练方法，利用三种目标表示——音素标签、发音特征标签和关键发音器标签——从而在推理时无需SSL提取器。我们评估了我们的方法与基线模型和基于SSL的模型在各种数据条件下的表现。结果表明，我们的方法持续改进了AAI性能，特别是在低资源场景中，同时显著降低了推理成本而没有牺牲准确性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新的多目标预训练方法，用于增强低资源设置下的声学-发音反演（AAI）。该方法通过利用音素、发音特征和关键发音器标签进行预训练，成功避免了传统自监督学习（SSL）特征提取器带来的推理延迟和计算开销。实验证明，该方法在低资源环境下显著提升了AAI性能，并在不牺牲准确性的前提下大幅降低了推理成本，为AAI任务提供了一种高效且高性能的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 声学-发音反演, 多目标预训练, 低资源设置, 自监督学习, 推理成本
AI.comments: 这项研究通过提出一种巧妙的多目标预训练策略，成功解决了自监督学习（SSL）在声学-发音反演（AAI）中引入的计算开销问题，同时在低资源环境下保持甚至提升了性能。其创新点在于无需在推理阶段使用额外的SSL特征提取器，这对于实际应用具有重要意义。该方法为优化AAI系统提供了一个有前景的方向，特别是在资源受限的场景中。

title: Rethinking Fractional Programming for Joint Uplink Scheduling and Power Control in Multicell Wireless Networks
summary: This paper investigates the joint uplink scheduling and power control problem in a coordinated multicell wireless network, where at most one single-antenna user is allowed to access the single-antenna base station in each cell simultaneously. The resulting weighted sum-rate (WSR) maximization problem is a mixed discrete-continuous, nonconvex optimization problem that is notoriously difficult to solve directly. Classical fractional programming (FP) methods tackle this problem by leveraging the Lagrangian dual transform (LDT) followed by the quadratic transform (QT), yielding a tractable closed-form solution for scheduling and power control, with the LDT playing a crucial role in handling discrete variables. In this paper, we revisit the LDT from a minorization-maximization (MM) perspective and observe that its induced surrogate is somehow conservative due to the reciprocal-coordinate construction. Motivated by this observation, we propose a novel reciprocal-inversion transform (RIT) that constructs a tighter first-order Taylor expansion lower bound for the logarithmic rate function. The proposed RIT remains fully compatible with the QT, leading to a surrogate-enhanced FP (SEFP) algorithm for joint uplink scheduling and power control. The proposed SEFP algorithm retains the desirable per-cell separability of the classical FP framework and admits closed-form updates for the auxiliary variables, scheduling decisions, and transmit powers. Simulation results demonstrate that the SEFP algorithm consistently outperforms the classical FP method and other baselines for different network utilities.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考多小区无线网络中联合上行链路调度与功率控制的分数规划
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的倒数反演变换（RIT），并将其整合到分数规划（FP）框架中，形成了替代增强型FP（SEFP）算法，用于解决多小区无线网络中的联合上行链路调度和功率控制问题。SEFP算法通过构建更紧密的对数速率函数下界，在仿真中表现优于传统FP方法和其他基线。
AI.motivation: 多小区无线网络中的加权和速率（WSR）最大化问题是一个混合离散-连续的非凸优化问题，直接解决非常困难。传统的整数规划（FP）方法在处理离散变量时，其拉格朗日对偶变换（LDT）诱导的代理函数因倒数坐标构造而显得保守。受此启发，本文旨在提出一种更有效的方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 本文从小化-最大化（MM）的角度重新审视了拉格朗日对偶变换（LDT），并提出了一种新颖的倒数反演变换（RIT）。RIT为对数速率函数构建了更紧密的一阶泰勒展开下界，并与二次变换（QT）完全兼容，从而引出了代理增强型分数规划（SEFP）算法。SEFP算法保留了传统FP框架的每小区可分离性，并支持辅助变量、调度决策和发射功率的闭式更新。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，SEFP算法在不同的网络效用下，始终优于传统的FP方法和其他基线。
AI.conclusion: 代理增强型分数规划（SEFP）算法通过引入倒数反演变换（RIT）来构建更紧密的下界，有效地解决了多小区无线网络中的联合上行链路调度和功率控制问题，并在性能上超越了传统方法。
AI.translation: 本文研究了协调多小区无线网络中的联合上行链路调度和功率控制问题，其中每个小区最多允许一个单天线用户同时访问单天线基站。由此产生的加权和速率（WSR）最大化问题是一个混合离散-连续的非凸优化问题，直接解决非常困难。经典的分数规划（FP）方法通过利用拉格朗日对偶变换（LDT）以及随后的二次变换（QT）来解决此问题，为调度和功率控制提供了可处理的闭式解，其中LDT在处理离散变量方面发挥着关键作用。在本文中，我们从小化-最大化（MM）的角度重新审视了LDT，并观察到其诱导的代理函数由于倒数坐标构造而显得有些保守。受此观察的启发，我们提出了一种新颖的倒数反演变换（RIT），它为对数速率函数构造了更紧密的一阶泰勒展开下界。所提出的RIT与QT保持完全兼容，从而形成了一种用于联合上行链路调度和功率控制的代理增强型分数规划（SEFP）算法。所提出的SEFP算法保留了经典FP框架的理想每小区可分离性，并允许辅助变量、调度决策和发射功率的闭式更新。仿真结果表明，SEFP算法在不同的网络效用下始终优于经典FP方法和其他基线。
AI.summary: 本文针对多小区无线网络中的联合上行链路调度与功率控制问题，提出了一种新颖的代理增强型分数规划（SEFP）算法。该算法通过引入倒数反演变换（RIT），为对数速率函数构建了比传统拉格朗日对偶变换（LDT）更紧密的一阶泰勒展开下界。SEFP算法与二次变换（QT）兼容，保留了每小区可分离性，并实现了闭式更新。仿真结果表明，SEFP在性能上显著优于传统FP方法及其他基线。
AI.keywords: 分数规划, 上行链路调度, 功率控制, 多小区网络, 倒数反演变换
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了倒数反演变换（RIT），它从MM角度出发，解决了传统LDT在构建代理函数时存在的保守性问题，通过提供更紧密的下界，有效提升了分数规划算法的性能。这种方法不仅保持了传统FP算法的优点（如每小区可分离性和闭式解），还显著提高了优化效果，对于解决无线网络资源分配中的非凸优化问题具有重要意义。

title: Integrated Wake-Up Radio and MIMO Solution for Cellular IoT Networks
comments: To appear in the IEEE Vehicular Technology Conference (VTC) Fall 2026
summary: Wake-up radio (WUR) is a technology designed to enhance the energy efficiency of Internet of Things (IoT) networks and extend device battery life. While most studies focus on WUR performance with single-antenna base stations, this paper investigates the multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) technology to improve device energy saving and extend the coverage of wake-up signals. By leveraging MIMO beamforming, the transmitted energy can be spatially focused toward the intended IoT devices, with high beamforming gain and minimal inter-device interference. We develop a preliminary analytical framework using stochastic geometry to evaluate the wake-up success probability of WUR-MIMO in multi-cell cellular IoT networks, when the number of antennas equals $2 \times (\text{number of devices}) - 1$. Monte Carlo simulations show that, relative to a single-antenna WUR baseline, MIMO beamforming significantly enhances wake-up reliability when this antenna configuration is applied, mitigates more than 50% of false activations across all settings, and thereby prolongs the lifetime of IoT devices.

AI.title_translation: 蜂窝物联网中集成唤醒无线电和MIMO解决方案
AI.tldr: 本文研究了在蜂窝物联网中使用MIMO技术与唤醒无线电结合，以提高设备能效、延长电池寿命并增强唤醒信号覆盖和可靠性。

title: Antenna System for Simultaneous Wireless Power and Information Transfer to Brain Implants
comments: Published at IMBioC 2024. Part of the B-CRATOS project, Horizon 2020 FET-OPEN, grant 965044
summary: Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) have revolutionized neuroscience applications, from motor rehabilitation to neuroergonomics. Traditional implantable BCIs with invasive microelectrode arrays pose challenges, notably the need for wired connections and inherent implantation risks. This paper introduces a battery-free wireless BCI system, consolidating an implant and its external supporting system. Our design centers on a dual-function antenna system: firstly, an inductive coupling mechanism enables wireless power transfer, sufficiently powering the implant's Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) for stimulation and readout without an implant battery. Secondly, a backscatter antenna in the implant facilitates battery-free, high-data-rate wireless connectivity (up to 32 Mbps). This system not only enhances the BCI experience by eliminating wires but also retains data fidelity and energy efficiency, promising a safer, more efficient interface for tasks like robotic arm control.

title: LMPAN: A Lightweight Multi-Path Alignment Network for Joint Full-Duplex Acoustic Echo Cancellation and Noise Suppression
summary: We propose a lightweight multi-path alignment network (LMPAN) for on-device joint acoustic echo cancellation (AEC) and noise suppression (NS) in full-duplex spoken dialogue systems. To address hardware-induced distortions and dynamic acoustic conditions, we introduce three core innovations: (1) a multi-path alignment stage correcting temporal and energy mismatches across reference, linear AEC (LAEC) output, and microphone signals; (2) an attention-based mechanism that dynamically integrates enhanced LAEC and microphone features under varying acoustic scenarios; (3) a post-filtering module with a dynamic target generation strategy for downstream tasks (ASR, VAD). Furthermore, we adopt a two-stage training framework leveraging self-supervised learning representations to enhance perceptual quality. Experiments show that LMPAN, with only 480K parameters and 126 MACs, achieves performance comparable to the state-of-the-art lightweight model DeepVQE-S, while ensuring real-time inference capability.

title: Three-Dimensional Spatial Correlation Modeling for Cylindrical mMIMO Arrays in HAPS
summary: High-altitude platform stations (HAPS) are envisioned as a key component of future wireless networks, enabling ultra-wide coverage and providing direct connectivity to users with cylindrical massive multiple-input multiple-output (mMIMO) systems. Exploiting the channel degrees of freedom necessitates accurate modeling and characterization of three-dimensional (3D) channels in the presence of spatial correlation functions (SCFs). However, existing spatial correlation models are primarily developed for planar or linear antenna arrays and cannot be directly applied to cylindrical geometries commonly adopted by HAPS platforms. To address this limitation, this paper derives an exact closed-form expression for the SCF of 3D MIMO channels with antenna elements arranged in a cylindrical array. The proposed formulation is based on the spherical harmonic expansion (SHE) of plane waves and accommodates arbitrary antenna radiation patterns and angular distributions through the Fourier series (FS) coefficients of the power azimuth and zenith spectra. The derived SCF is validated through Monte Carlo simulations under standard-compliant settings.

AI.translation: 高空平台站（HAPS）被视为未来无线网络的关键组成部分，能够实现超广覆盖，并通过圆柱形大规模多输入多输出（mMIMO）系统直接为用户提供连接。充分利用信道自由度需要对存在空间相关函数（SCF）的三维（3D）信道进行精确建模和表征。然而，现有的空间相关模型主要是为平面或线性天线阵列开发的，不能直接应用于HAPS平台通常采用的圆柱几何结构。为了解决这一局限性，本文推导了天线单元排列在圆柱阵列中的3D MIMO信道SCF的精确闭式表达式。所提出的公式基于平面波的球面波展开（SHE），并通过功率方位角和天顶角谱的傅里叶级数（FS）系数来适应任意天线辐射方向图和角分布。导出的SCF已在符合标准的设置下通过蒙特卡洛仿真进行了验证。
AI.summary: 本文针对高空平台（HAPS）的圆柱形大规模MIMO阵列，提出了一种三维空间相关性建模方法。通过球面波展开技术，研究推导出了适用于该几何结构的精确空间相关函数闭式解，并能灵活适应多种天线辐射模式和角度分布，为优化HAPS无线网络性能提供了理论支撑。

title: Complexity-Scalable Direct Geolocation and Cancellation of Terrestrial GNSS Jammers: Single-Satellite and Multi-Antenna Experiments in Low Earth Orbit
comments: 15 pages, 15 figures, submitted to ION GNSS+ 2026
summary: Monitoring the radio-frequency (RF) spectrum from space imposes demanding requirements to satellite platforms in terms of communication bandwidth and computational resources, which are necessary for the downlink, the storage, and the processing of high-throughput I/Q samples. This paper analyzes in depth the quasi-direct geolocation (QDG) as a technique to enable the exploitation of satellites of opportunity in low Earth orbit (LEO) to sense the spectrum in the bands of global navigation satellite systems (GNSS). This is a technique of passive RF geolocation and consists of an ensemble of signal processing algorithms, which compress the I/Q samples and process the compressed data through fast delay-Doppler shift matching and interferometry in a quantized time-frequency domain. These algorithms speed up the exhaustive search of multiple RF sources in the position domain. The efficiency gain addresses the bottleneck that prevents the employment of satellites, which are limited in downlink capacity and on-board computational power. These satellites are usually constrained in size, weight and power (SWaP) and represent most of the spacecrafts in LEO. The ability to exploit assets as such for the geolocation of terrestrial GNSS jammers in near real time is instrumental the performance of a multi-constellation GNSS RFI monitoring system. The present work describes the mathematical framework and precision bounds, introduces single- and multi-antenna uses cases, combines different compression methods, and evaluates the geolocation accuracy with real data. The I/Q samples were collected by a repurposed GNSS reflectometry (GNSS-R) satellite, OPS-SAT PRETTY, in a dedicated test session during Jammertest 2025. The experimental results demonstrate the capability to geolocate GNSS jammers with different signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) with extremely high compression ratios.

title: Cross Domain Few-Shot Class-Incremental Audio Classification Via Adversarial Contrastive Learning
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, accepted for publication in Interspeech 2026
summary: Current Few-shot Class-incremental Audio Classification (FCAC) methods assume that samples of base and incremental classes are in the same domain (following the same distribution). However, there is generally a domain shift between the above two types of samples. In this paper, we explore the problem of Cross Domain FCAC where samples of base and incremental classes have domain shift. We propose a strategy of adversarial contrastive training which enables the model to effectively classify samples of different classes from unseen domains. The model consists of an encoder and a classifier. The encoder is trained in base session but frozen in incremental sessions, whereas the classifier is trained in all sessions. Experiments are done on six pairs of cross-domain datasets. Results show that our method exceeds state-of-the-art methods in average accuracy. The code is at https://github.com/YongjieSi/ACL.

AI.title_translation: 基于对抗性对比学习的跨域少样本类增量音频分类

AI.motivation: 现有的少样本类增量音频分类（FCAC）方法通常假设基类和增量类样本处于同一分布，但实际应用中存在明显的域偏移问题，导致模型性能下降。
AI.method: 提出了一种对抗性对比训练策略。模型由编码器和分类器组成，其中编码器在基类阶段训练后在增量阶段保持冻结，而分类器在所有阶段进行训练。

AI.conclusion: 本文提出的对抗性对比训练策略有效解决了跨域少样本类增量音频分类中的域偏移难题，在多个跨域数据集上验证了其优越性，显著提升了音频分类模型的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 目前的少样本类增量音频分类（FCAC）方法假设基类和增量类的样本处于同一域（遵循相同的分布）。然而，上述两类样本之间通常存在域偏移。在本文中，我们探讨了基类和增量类样本存在域偏移的跨域FCAC问题。我们提出了一种对抗性对比训练策略，使模型能够有效地对来自未见领域的不同类别的样本进行分类。该模型由一个编码器和一个分类器组成。编码器在基类阶段进行训练，但在增量阶段被冻结，而分类器在所有阶段进行训练。实验在六对跨域数据集上进行。结果表明，我们的方法在平均准确率上超过了现有的先进方法。代码地址为 https://github.com/YongjieSi/ACL。
AI.summary: 本文研究了存在域偏移的跨域少样本类增量音频分类问题，提出了一种对抗性对比训练策略。该方法通过冻结基类训练后的编码器并结合对抗性对比学习，增强了模型对不同领域类别的识别能力，在实验中表现优于现有最优方法。
AI.keywords: 跨域少样本学习, 类增量音频分类, 对抗性对比学习, 域偏移
AI.comments: 该论文针对音频分类领域中一个现实且具有挑战性的问题——跨域少样本类增量学习（Cross Domain FCAC）提出了创新的解决方案。通过引入对抗性对比学习，模型能够更好地处理域偏移问题，提升了在未知领域下的分类鲁棒性。其局限性在于对模型架构（冻结编码器）的依赖程度较高，可能限制了在极端分布差异下的性能上限。

title: Spatial Speech Perception Systems: A Survey of Sound Source Localization, Directional Enhancement, and Speech Recognition
summary:
Robust speech understanding in real-world acoustic environments remains a fundamental challenge for intelligent auditory systems such as robot audition, hearing aids, teleconferencing systems, smart speakers, and voice-controlled assistants. These systems must operate under background noise, reverberation, competing speakers, and dynamic acoustic conditions. Spatial speech perception addresses this challenge by exploiting microphone-array information to localize, enhance, and interpret target speech in complex acoustic scenes.
  This paper surveys spatial speech perception systems with emphasis on the roles of sound source localization (SSL), directional speech enhancement (DSE), and automatic speech recognition (ASR), both individually and within integrated processing pipelines. We review classical signal-processing approaches and recent learning-based methods for microphone-array localization, beamforming, neural enhancement, speech separation, and modern recognition architectures. Beyond component-level analysis, we discuss robustness to noise and reverberation, multi-speaker operation, real-time constraints, and computational efficiency. We also examine representative applications in robot audition, hearing assistance, smart speakers, and teleconferencing, and identify open challenges and future directions toward robust, low-latency, and perception-aware speech systems for complex acoustic environments.

title: Beyond Beamforming: Phase-and-Gain Channel Shaping via Rotatable Antenna Arrays
comments: 13 Pages, 9 figures. Submitted to an IEEE journal for possible publication
summary: This paper investigates geometry-reconfigurable transmission for multiuser communication systems enabled by a rotatable antenna array. In contrast to conventional fixed arrays, the proposed architecture jointly exploits array pose adjustment and element-level boresight steering, thereby reshaping both the array-induced phase responses and the direction-dependent channel gains. We formulate a weighted sum-rate maximization problem that jointly optimizes the transmit beamformers, array pose, and element boresights under practical visibility and steering constraints. To reveal the underlying design principles, we first provide a geometric interpretation via zero-forcing analysis, showing that the resulting rates stem from both channel-strength enhancement and spatial-separability improvement. Specifically, array-pose rotation improves inter-user channel orthogonality even with isotropic elements, whereas directional elements introduce a tradeoff between phase-based spatial separation and boresight-dependent gain alignment. Motivated by these insights, we develop an efficient optimization framework that jointly coordinates transmit beamforming, array-pose adaptation, and element-boresight steering to exploit the geometry-induced phase-and-gain channel-shaping capability. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed joint design outperforms fixed-array, pose-only, and boresight-only benchmarks, with larger gains achieved under more directive element patterns and tighter boresight-steering constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种可旋转天线阵列架构，通过联合优化阵列姿态和天线指向来重塑信道，从而显著提升多用户系统的通信性能。
AI.motivation: 传统固定天线阵列难以灵活应对复杂多变的通信环境，作者旨在通过引入可旋转天线阵列，利用物理几何重构来同时改变阵列的相位响应和方向相关的信道增益，从而突破传统波束赋形的限制。
AI.method: 提出了一个联合优化发射波束赋形、阵列姿态和单元指向的框架，通过零强制（Zero-Forcing）分析揭示了其几何设计原理，并开发了高效的优化算法进行求解。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，所提的联合设计方案在速率表现上优于固定阵列、仅优化姿态和仅优化指向的基准方案，且在天线方向性更强及指向约束更紧时增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合优化发射波束赋形、阵列姿态和单元指向，可旋转天线阵列能显著提升多用户通信系统的加权和速率，优于传统的固定阵列方案。
AI.translation: 本文研究了由可旋转天线阵列支持的多用户通信系统的几何重构传输。与传统的固定阵列相比，所提出的架构联合利用了阵列姿态调整和单元级视轴（boresight）转向，从而重塑了阵列引起的相位响应和方向相关的信道增益。我们建立了一个加权和速率最大化问题，在实际可见性和转向约束下联合优化发射波束赋形、阵列姿态和单元视轴。为了揭示潜在的设计原则，我们首先通过零强制分析提供了几何解释，表明所得速率源于信道强度增强和空间可分性改善。具体而言，即使使用各向同性单元，阵列姿态旋转也能提高用户间信道的正交性，而方向性单元则在基于相位的空间分离和依赖视轴的增益对齐之间引入了权衡。受这些见解的启发，我们开发了一个高效的优化框架，联合协调发射波束赋形、阵列姿态自适应和单元视轴转向，以利用几何诱导的相位和增益信道整形能力。仿真结果表明，所提出的联合设计方案优于固定阵列、仅姿态调整和仅视轴转向的基准方案，并且在更具方向性的单元模式和更严格的视轴转向约束下取得了更大的增益。
AI.summary: 本文研究了基于可旋转天线阵列的多用户通信系统，通过动态调整阵列姿态和天线单元指向，实现了对信道相位和增益的联合整形。研究表明，这种几何重构能力能够有效增强信道强度并改善空间可分性，从而显著提升系统的加权和速率。
AI.keywords: 可旋转天线阵列, 几何重构, 信道整形, 波束赋形, 多用户通信
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的硬件架构（可旋转天线阵列），通过物理层面的几何重构来优化信道特性。其核心贡献在于将传统的波束赋形扩展到了阵列姿态和单元指向的联合优化，为未来灵活通信系统的设计提供了新思路。局限性在于实际物理旋转机制的响应速度和机械复杂性可能限制其在高速移动场景的应用。

title: Robust Transmission Design for RIS-Assisted RSMA-SWIPT Systems With Movable Antennas Under Hardware Distortions
summary: This paper investigates a robust transmission design for a multi-user rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA)-based simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) system empowered by movable antennas (MAs) and a reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) under channel state information (CSI) uncertainty and residual hardware impairments (HIs). The effective channels in MAs-enabled systems depend on antenna positions, causing CSI uncertainty to affect not only active and passive beamforming but also antenna position optimization. Furthermore, residual HIs distort the effective SINRs, creating additional coupling among beamforming, RIS reflection control, common-rate allocation, power-splitting ratio optimization, and antenna position optimization. Consequently, the joint impact of CSI uncertainty and HIs leads to a highly coupled and challenging resource allocation problem. To address this challenge, we propose a robust resource allocation framework that jointly optimizes common-rate allocation, transmit beamforming, RIS reflection coefficients, power-splitting ratios, and MAs positions to maximize the achievable sum-rate while satisfying practical system constraints. To obtain an efficient solution, the original problem is decomposed into active beamforming, RIS reflection design, power-splitting ratio optimization, and MAs position optimization subproblems, where tractable convex surrogate functions are constructed to handle the non-convex objective and constraints. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework and demonstrate substantial improvements in achievable sum-rate, robustness against CSI uncertainty and hardware impairments, and convergence performance compared with benchmark schemes.

title: FLAME: A Federated Learning Approach for Multi-Modal RF Fingerprinting
comments: 21 pages, 16 figures. Published in IEEE Internet of Things Journal
summary: Authorization systems are increasingly relying on processing radio frequency (RF) waveforms at receivers to fingerprint (i.e., determine the identity of) the corresponding transmitter. Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a popular paradigm to perform RF fingerprinting in networks with multiple access points (APs), as they allow effective deep learning-based device identification without requiring the centralization of locally collected RF signals stored at multiple APs. Yet, FL algorithms that operate merely on in-phase and quadrature (I/Q) time samples incur high convergence rates, resulting in excessive training rounds and inefficient training times. In this work, we propose FLAME: an FL approach for multi-modal RF fingerprinting. Our framework consists of simultaneously representing received RF waveforms in multiple complementary modalities beyond I/Q samples in an effort to reduce training times. We theoretically demonstrate the feasibility and efficiency of our methodology and derive a convergence bound that incurs lower loss and thus higher accuracies in the same training round in comparison to single-modal FL-based RF fingerprinting. Extensive empirical evaluations validate our theoretical results and demonstrate the superiority of FLAME in comparison to multiple considered baselines.

AI.title_translation: FLAME：一种用于多模态射频指纹识别的联邦学习方法
AI.tldr: FLAME通过引入多模态射频特征，解决了联邦学习在设备指纹识别中训练效率低下的痛点，实现了更快的收敛和更高的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于联邦学习的射频指纹识别方法通常仅使用I/Q时间样本，导致模型收敛速度慢、训练轮次过多且效率低下。
AI.method: 提出FLAME框架，通过同时利用多种互补的射频波形表示模态（而非仅依赖I/Q采样）进行联邦学习训练，并推导了其收敛界。
AI.result: 理论分析证明了FLAME具有更低的损失函数值和更高的识别准确率；实验结果表明，FLAME在训练效率和识别性能上均优于多种基准方法。
AI.conclusion: FLAME通过多模态射频指纹表示方法，有效提升了联邦学习在设备识别任务中的收敛速度和识别精度，在性能上优于现有的单模态基准方法。
AI.translation: 授权系统越来越依赖于处理接收端的射频（RF）波形来对相应的发射器进行指纹识别（即确定其身份）。联邦学习（FL）已成为在多接入点（AP）网络中执行射频指纹识别的一种流行范式，因为它允许在不集中存储于多个AP的本地收集射频信号的情况下，实现有效的基于深度学习的设备识别。然而，仅在同相（I）和正交（Q）时间样本上运行的FL算法会导致收敛速度慢，从而导致过多的训练轮次和低效的训练时间。在这项工作中，我们提出了FLAME：一种用于多模态射频指纹识别的FL方法。我们的框架包括同时用多种互补模态（超越I/Q样本）来表示接收到的射频波形，以缩短训练时间。我们从理论上证明了该方法的可行性和效率，并推导出了一个收敛界，与基于单模态FL的射频指纹识别相比，该方法在相同的训练轮次中产生了更低的损失，从而获得了更高的准确度。广泛的实证评估验证了我们的理论结果，并证明了FLAME与多个考虑的基准相比具有优越性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FLAME，一种用于多模态射频指纹识别的联邦学习方法。通过利用多种互补的射频波形表示模态，FLAME解决了传统单模态联邦学习训练效率低下的问题，在保证隐私的前提下显著提升了模型收敛速度与识别精度。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 射频指纹, 多模态, 设备识别, 深度学习
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入多模态特征来优化联邦学习在射频指纹识别中的收敛效率，是一个非常有价值的改进方向。其创新点在于将传统单一的I/Q样本扩展为多模态表示，有效解决了联邦学习在射频领域训练耗时过长的问题。局限性在于未详细说明具体采用了哪些模态及其计算开销。

title: Bayesian Self-Calibration and Parametric Channel Estimation for 6G Antenna Arrays
summary: Accurate channel estimation is essential for both high-rate communication and high-precision sensing in 6G wireless systems. However, a major performance limitation arises from calibration mismatches when operating phased-array antennas under real-world conditions. To address this issue, we propose to integrate antenna element self-calibration into a variational sparse Bayesian learning (VSBL) algorithm for parametric channel estimation. We model antenna gain and phase deviations as latent variables and derive explicit update equations to jointly infer these calibration parameters and the channel parameters; the number of multipath components (MPCs) along with their complex amplitudes, delays, and angles-of-arrival (AoA), as well as the noise variance. We assess its performance in terms of the optimal subpattern-assignment (OSPA) metric, demonstrating consistent improvements over conventional VSBL without calibration. Furthermore, we show that integrating the estimation of the calibration parameters into the VSBL algorithm actually increases convergence speed, since a missing or wrong calibration results in the additional estimation of spurious components.

AI.title_translation: 面向6G天线阵列的贝叶斯自校准与参数化通道估计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将天线自校准集成到贝叶斯通道估计中的新算法，通过联合估计校准偏差与信道参数，解决了6G阵列天线的校准失配问题，并提升了收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 6G系统中相位阵列天线在真实环境中存在校准偏差，严重影响高精度通道估计，进而限制了高速通信与高精度感知的性能。
AI.method: 提出一种集成天线元件自校准功能的变分稀疏贝叶斯学习（VSBL）算法，通过将天线增益和相位偏差建模为潜在变量，利用显式更新方程联合推断校准参数、多径分量（MPC）的复杂振幅、延迟、到达角（AoA）及噪声方差。
AI.result: 在OSPA指标下，该方法相比于传统的无校准VSBL展现出显著的性能提升，且集成校准参数的联合估计能有效减少伪分量，从而提高算法的收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: 通过将天线校准参数纳入VSBL联合估计框架，该方法有效克服了校准偏差带来的性能损失，并提升了算法的收敛效率，为6G高精度通信与感知提供了有力支撑。
AI.translation: 精确的信道估计对于6G无线系统的高速率通信和高精度感知至关重要。然而，在现实条件下操作相控阵天线时，校准失配会导致主要的性能限制。为了解决这个问题，我们建议将天线元件自校准集成到用于参数化信道估计的变分稀疏贝叶斯学习（VSBL）算法中。我们将天线增益和相位偏差建模为潜在变量，并推导出显式更新方程，以联合推断这些校准参数以及信道参数（多径分量（MPCs）的数量及其复振幅、延迟和到达角（AoA）），以及噪声方差。我们在最佳子模式分配（OSPA）指标方面评估了其性能，证明了其相对于没有校准的传统VSBL具有持续的改进。此外，我们表明将校准参数的估计集成到VSBL算法中实际上提高了收敛速度，因为缺失或错误的校准会导致对伪分量的额外估计。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对6G天线阵列的联合自校准与参数化通道估计方法。通过将天线增益和相位偏差作为潜在变量整合进变分稀疏贝叶斯学习（VSBL）算法中，实现了对通道参数和校准参数的联合精确估计，有效解决了实际运行中的校准失配问题。
AI.keywords: 6G, 天线阵列, 通道估计, 变分稀疏贝叶斯学习, 自校准
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将天线自校准集成到变分稀疏贝叶斯学习（VSBL）框架中，解决了6G阵列天线在实际运行中的校准偏差问题。其重要贡献在于证明了联合估计不仅提高了精度，还通过减少伪分量的干扰提升了收敛速度。未来的研究方向可以考虑该算法在高动态场景下的实时性表现。

title: A mixed-signal analogue front-end for brain-implantable neural interfaces using a digital fixed-point IIR filter and bulk offset cancellation
comments: IEEE style, to be presented in MWSCAS 2026, 4 pages + 1 References
summary: Advances in miniaturised implantable neural electronics have paved the way for therapeutic brain-computer interfaces with clinical potential for movement disorders, epilepsy, and broader neurological applications. This paper presents a mixed-signal analogue front end (AFE) designed to record simultaneously both extracellular action potentials (EAPs) and local field potentials (LFPs). The feedforward path integrates a low-noise amplifier (LNA) and a successive-approximation-register (SAR) analogue-to-digital converter (ADC), while the feedback path employs a fixed-point infinite-impulse-response (IIR) Chebyshev Type II low-pass filter to suppress sub-mHz components via bulk-voltage control of the LNA input differential pair using two R-2R pseudo-resistor digital-to-analogue converters (DACs). The proposed AFE employs a low-power (LP) mode and an offset-cancellation high-performance (HP) mode. The proposed AFE achieves 40.55 dB gain and supports neural recording from 0.1 Hz to 5.705 / 9.66 kHz (LP / HP), with typical input-referred noise of 3.9 / 6.615 uVrms in the LFP band and 11.42 / 11.11 uVrms in the EAP band (LP / HP). Its typical power per channel is 5.44 uW (LP) and 11.35 uW (HP), while it occupies 0.198 mm2.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于脑植入式神经接口的混合信号模拟前端：采用数字固定点IIR滤波器和体偏置消除技术
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于脑机接口的低功耗、微型化混合信号模拟前端，通过数字IIR滤波和体偏置控制实现对神经信号的高效记录。
AI.motivation: 为了满足植入式脑机接口对微型化、低功耗以及能够同时记录动作电位（EAPs）和局部场电位（LFPs）的需求。
AI.method: 设计了一个包含低噪声放大器（LNA）和逐次逼近寄存器（SAR）ADC的前馈路径；反馈路径采用数字固定点切比雪夫II型IIR低通滤波器，通过两个R-2R伪电阻DAC控制LNA输入差分对的体电压来实现偏移消除。
AI.result: 该前端电路实现了40.55 dB的增益，在低功耗模式（LP）和高性能模式（HP）下，LFP频段的输入参考噪声分别为3.9 uVrms和6.615 uVrms，EAP频段分别为11.42 uVrms和11.11 uVrms，单通道功耗为5.44 uW（LP）至11.35 uW（HP），芯片面积为0.198 mm²。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发了一种适用于植入式神经接口的混合信号模拟前端，在保持低功耗的同时实现了对EAP和LFP信号的高效记录，为临床神经应用提供了可行的技术方案。
AI.translation: 微型化植入式神经电子学的发展为治疗运动障碍、癫痫和更广泛神经应用的脑机接口开辟了道路。本文提出了一种混合信号模拟前端（AFE），旨在同时记录细胞外动作电位（EAPs）和局部场电位（LFPs）。前馈路径集成了低噪声放大器（LNA）和逐次逼近寄存器（SAR）模数转换器（ADC），而反馈路径采用固定点无限脉冲响应（IIR）切比雪夫II型低通滤波器，通过两个R-2R伪电阻数模转换器（DAC）控制LNA输入差分对的体电压，以抑制亚mHz分量。所提出的AFE采用了低功耗（LP）模式和偏移消除高性能（HP）模式。该AFE实现了40.55 dB的增益，支持0.1 Hz至5.705 / 9.66 kHz（LP / HP）的神经记录，LFP频段的典型输入参考噪声为3.9 / 6.615 uVrms，EAP频段为11.42 / 11.11 uVrms（LP / HP）。其典型单通道功耗为5.44 uW（LP）和11.35 uW（HP），占用面积为0.198 mm²。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于脑植入式神经接口的混合信号模拟前端（AFE），通过数字固定点IIR滤波器和体偏置消除技术，支持同时记录EAP和LFP信号，并在功耗、噪声和面积方面表现优异。
AI.keywords: 神经接口, 模拟前端, 混合信号, IIR滤波器, 体偏置消除
AI.comments: 该研究通过结合数字IIR滤波器和体偏置消除技术，有效解决了植入式神经接口中低功耗与高性能之间的权衡问题，特别是在处理极低频信号偏移方面具有显著优势。其创新之处在于利用混合信号反馈回路实现精确的截止频率控制。

title: Signal Recovery from Time and Frequency Samples
summary: We analyze signal recovery when samples are taken concomitantly from a signal and its Fourier transform. This two-sided sampling framework extends classical one-sided reconstruction and is particularly useful when measurements in either domain alone are insufficient because of sensing, storage, or bandwidth constraints. We formulate the resulting recovery problem in finite-dimensional spaces and reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces, and illustrate the infinite-dimensional setting in a Fourier-symmetric Sobolev space. Numerical experiments with sinc- and Hermite-based schemes indicate that, under a fixed sampling budget, two-sided sampling often yields better conditioned systems than one-sided approaches. A simplified spectrum-monitoring example further demonstrates improved reconstruction when limited time samples are supplemented with frequency-domain information.

AI.title_translation: 基于时域和频域采样的信号恢复
AI.tldr: 通过同时采集信号的时域和频域样本，双侧采样方法在资源受限的情况下能比传统单域采样实现更准确、更稳定的信号重建。
AI.motivation: 为了解决在传感、存储或带宽受限的情况下，单一域采样无法满足信号高质量恢复需求的问题。
AI.method: 在有限维空间和再生核希尔伯特空间中构建双侧采样恢复模型，并利用基于sinc函数和Hermite函数的方案进行数值实验分析。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，在固定采样预算下，双侧采样相比单侧采样能获得更好的系统条件数，且在有限时间采样基础上补充频域信息能显著提升重构精度。
AI.conclusion: 双侧采样（时域+频域）在固定采样预算下，比单侧采样能提供更稳定的信号重建效果，特别适用于受限环境下的信号恢复。
AI.translation: 我们分析了当从信号及其傅里叶变换中同时获取样本时的信号恢复问题。这种双侧采样框架扩展了经典的单侧重建，特别适用于由于传感、存储或带宽限制而导致单一域测量不足的情况。我们在有限维空间和再生核希尔伯特空间中制定了相应的恢复问题，并阐述了傅里叶对称索博列夫空间中的无限维设置。基于sinc函数和Hermite函数的数值实验表明，在固定的采样预算下，双侧采样通常比单侧方法产生条件更好的系统。一个简化的频谱监测示例进一步证明，当有限的时间样本辅以频域信息时，重构效果得到了改善。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合信号及其傅里叶变换采样的双侧信号恢复框架，旨在解决单一域采样受限时的信号重建问题。通过在有限维和再生核希尔伯特空间中建模，并结合数值实验验证，证明了双侧采样在改善系统条件数和提升重构质量方面的优越性。
AI.keywords: 信号恢复, 双侧采样, 傅里叶变换, 希尔伯特空间, 重建算法
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将时域和频域采样相结合，突破了传统单域采样的局限性。其重要价值在于通过平衡两个域的采样资源，有效改善了信号重建系统的条件数，在资源受限（传感、存储或带宽）的实际应用场景中具有显著优势。局限性在于主要从理论和数值模拟层面验证，实际硬件实现难度未深入讨论。

title: Ray-Based Simulation of Scattering from Discretized Curved Bodies for Vehicular and ISAC Applications
summary: Realistic modeling of scattering from curved metallic bodies - such as vehicles and roadside structures - is essential for cellular and vehicular channel modeling as well as radar applications. A practical approach is to approximate curved surfaces with planar facets and apply ray-tracing with diffraction methods; however, accuracy depends critically on both geometric discretization and diffraction modeling. This work investigates ray-tracing-based modeling of near-field scattering from curved bodies, both in the backscattering and in the forward (shadow) region; in the ray-tracing tool, diffraction is modeled according to the Uniform Theory of Diffraction (UTD), extended with vertex diffraction and double-bounce interactions, including a heuristic combination of edge and vertex diffraction. A discretization strategy linking facet size to local curvature and wavelength is proposed to balance geometric fidelity, diffraction modeling, and efficiency. Validation is initially performed against analytical solutions and full-wave simulations for canonical geometries (sphere and circular cylinder). Furthermore, the practical applicability of the approach is demonstrated for a realistic vehicle by comparison with bistatic measurements in the backscattering region and full-wave simulation in the shadow region. The results demonstrate that no universal discretization strategy exists: fine meshes are beneficial for accurate backscattering prediction, while coarser discretizations can provide more efficient and accurate shadow region prediction. The proposed extended diffraction framework provides a computationally efficient framework for vehicular propagation and integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) channel modeling.

AI.title_translation: 面向车载与ISAC应用的离散化曲面物体散射的射线追踪模拟
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合改进UTD衍射模型与自适应网格离散化的射线追踪框架，有效提升了车载与ISAC场景中曲面物体散射模拟的效率与精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于平面面片近似的射线追踪方法在模拟曲面物体（如车辆）散射时，其精度高度依赖于几何离散化和衍射建模，缺乏一种能平衡计算效率与几何保真度的实用方法。
AI.method: 基于射线追踪方法，利用扩展的均匀衍射理论（UTD），包含顶点衍射、双重反射交互以及边缘与顶点衍射的启发式组合；并提出了一种将网格尺寸与局部曲率及波长相关联的离散化策略。
AI.result: 通过典型几何体和真实车辆的验证，结果表明后向散射预测需要精细网格以保证精度，而阴影区预测使用较粗的网格反而更高效且准确。所提框架在车载传播与ISAC场景中表现出良好的计算效率与实用性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明了通过合理的离散化和扩展的UTD衍射模型，可以高效且准确地模拟曲面物体的近场散射，适用于车载通信与雷达探测场景。
AI.translation: 对曲面金属体（如车辆和路边结构）散射的真实建模对于蜂窝和车载信道建模以及雷达应用至关重要。一种实用的方法是用平面面片近似曲面，并应用射线追踪和衍射方法；然而，其精度关键取决于几何离散化和衍射建模。本研究探讨了基于射线追踪的曲面物体近场散射建模，包括后向散射和前向（阴影）区域；在射线追踪工具中，衍射根据均匀衍射理论（UTD）进行建模，并扩展了顶点衍射和双重反射交互，包括边缘和顶点衍射的启发式组合。提出了一种将面片尺寸与局部曲率和波长相关联的离散化策略，以平衡几何保真度、衍射建模和效率。验证首先针对典型几何体（球体和圆柱体）的解析解和全波模拟进行。此外，通过与后向散射区域的双站测量结果以及阴影区域的全波模拟结果进行对比，证明了该方法对真实车辆的实际适用性。结果表明，不存在通用的离散化策略：细网格有利于准确的后向散射预测，而较粗的离散化可以提供更高效、更准确的阴影区域预测。所提出的扩展衍射框架为车载传播和集成感知与通信（ISAC）信道建模提供了一种计算高效的框架。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种改进的射线追踪建模方法，用于模拟曲面物体的近场散射。通过结合扩展的UTD衍射模型与一种将网格尺寸关联至局部曲率的离散化策略，该方法在车载通信和ISAC应用中实现了计算效率与预测精度之间的平衡。
AI.keywords: 射线追踪, 衍射理论, 曲面散射, 车载信道, 集成感知与通信 (ISAC)
AI.comments: 该论文为车载和ISAC应用中复杂曲面物体的电磁散射建模提供了一个实用的工程方案。其核心创新在于将几何离散化策略与改进的UTD方法相结合，平衡了计算效率与精度。局限性在于离散化策略并非万能，需要根据散射区域（后向散射与阴影区）进行权衡。

title: Low-Complexity Direct Geolocation of Terrestrial GNSS Jammers from Low Earth Orbit
comments: 6 pages, 4 figures, submitted to IEEE NAVICON 2026
summary: This paper introduces a low-complexity technique named quasi-direct geolocation (QDG) to perform passive radio-frequency (RF) geolocation of emitters directly in the position domain, akin to direct geolocation (DG) and direct position determination (DPD). The proposed technique drastically reduces the complexity of DG/DPD and is experimentally demonstrated in geolocating a terrestrial jammer at Jammertest 2025 from a repurposed satellite in low Earth orbit (LEO): OPS-SAT PRETTY. The goal of QDG is to enable satellites to contribute to a multi-constellation system for RF interference (RFI) monitoring as opportunistic spectrum sensors in global navigation satellite systems (GNSS) bands, even if these are constrained by low size, weight, and power (SWaP). They can serve as data collectors and/or edge computers. In the former case, QDG can be used to compress large volumes of I/Q samples into minimal signal information, which can be relayed to ground for post-processing via low-capacity downlinks. In the latter case, QDG can be used to compute the geolocation of RFI sources in orbit on low-power on-board computers (OBC). The drawback of these capabilities is lower sensitivity and accuracy than DG/DPD plus limitations on the types of signal sources that can be geolocated, which, nonetheless, include the most common GNSS jammers.
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, submitted to IEEE NAVICON 2026

AI.title_translation: 低地球轨道GNSS地面干扰源的低复杂度直接定位研究
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为QDG的低复杂度定位技术，使资源受限的卫星能够高效识别并定位GNSS频段的干扰源。
AI.motivation: 为了使受限于尺寸、重量和功耗（SWaP）的LEO卫星能够作为机会性频谱传感器，有效地对全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）频段的射频干扰进行监测。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为准直接定位（QDG）的技术，该技术直接在位置域进行射频发射机定位，旨在降低传统直接定位（DG/DPD）的计算复杂度，并支持星载低功耗计算或数据压缩传输。
AI.result: 通过在Jammertest 2025活动中利用OPS-SAT PRETTY卫星进行实验，证明了该技术能够成功定位地面干扰源。该方法能显著降低计算量，适用于低功耗星载计算机，但也存在灵敏度、精度较低以及对信号源类型有限制的缺点。
AI.conclusion: QDG技术提供了一种在资源受限的LEO卫星上实现高效、低功耗GNSS干扰源定位的可行方案，是传统直接定位（DG/DPD）方法的有力补充。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了一种名为准直接定位（QDG）的低复杂度技术，用于直接在位置域对发射机进行被动射频（RF）定位，类似于直接定位（DG）和直接位置确定（DPD）。所提出的技术大幅降低了DG/DPD的复杂度，并在Jammertest 2025活动中，利用低地球轨道（LEO）上的OPS-SAT PRETTY卫星成功演示了对地面干扰源的定位。QDG的目标是使卫星能够作为全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）频段的机会性频谱传感器，参与到射频干扰（RFI）监测的多星座系统中，即使这些卫星受到尺寸、重量和功耗（SWaP）的限制。它们可以作为数据采集器和/或边缘计算机。在前一种情况下，QDG可用于将大量I/Q样本压缩为最小的信号信息，并通过低容量下行链路中继到地面进行后处理。在后一种情况下，QDG可用于在低功耗星载计算机（OBC）上计算轨道上射频干扰源的位置。这些功能的缺点是灵敏度和精度低于DG/DPD，且对可定位的信号源类型有限制，但这些限制范围内仍涵盖了最常见的GNSS干扰源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为准直接定位（QDG）的新型低复杂度技术，用于在LEO卫星上直接进行射频干扰源定位。该方法显著降低了计算开销，使得资源受限的卫星能够作为GNSS干扰监测的边缘计算节点或数据压缩平台，并在实际实验中验证了其定位地面干扰源的可行性。
AI.keywords: 准直接定位, GNSS干扰监测, 低地球轨道卫星, 信号处理, 计算复杂度
AI.comments: 该论文提出的准直接定位（QDG）技术在计算复杂度和资源受限的卫星平台之间取得了很好的平衡。尽管牺牲了一定的灵敏度和精度，但其在低功耗星载计算或数据压缩传输方面的应用潜力，使其成为实现全球GNSS干扰源实时监测的一种极具实用价值的低成本解决方案。

title: A Benchmark of (MRI-) Foundation Models to Predict IDH Mutational Status in Glioma
summary: Non-invasive prediction of glioma molecular status from routine magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) has shown promising performance, but model generalization remains challenging given small-scale matched imaging-genomic datasets. Foundation models may address this bottleneck, but a comprehensive benchmark is needed to establish the impact of diverse architectures, pre-training domains, and objectives. Given the use case of isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) mutation prediction from FLAIR and post-contrast T1 MRIs, we compared four image-based foundation models, BrainIAC, MRI-CORE, BiomedCLIP, and BrainDINO, against radiomics-based TabPFN and logistic regression baselines. Prediction performance and calibration were assessed across four public adult glioma cohorts and an external post-treatment cohort. Within-cohort, TabPFN matched or outperformed all visual encoders, achieving 0.92 (0.03) AUROC and 0.74 (0.17) AUPRC (mean (SD) across all datasets). Among visual encoders, BiomedCLIP performed best (0.85 (0.08) AUROC), with BrainDINO competitive (0.82 (0.09) AUROC), while MRI-specific encoders (BrainIAC, MRI-CORE) consistently underperformed. Cross-cohort transfer showed moderate AUROC degradation but stronger AUPRC sensitivity to prevalence shifts. On the external cohort, BiomedCLIP achieved the highest AUROC (0.74 (0.07)), whereas TabPFN provided superior calibration (Expected Calibration Error 0.07 (0.01)). These results indicate that representation modality and evaluation context critically influence foundation-model performance in MRI-based molecular prediction. Tabular foundation models on radiomic features provide a strong, well-calibrated baseline, while image foundation models may offer complementary value under clinically distinct distribution shifts. Code available at https://github.com/nathanhollet/idh-status-prediction

title: Do Multimodal Large Language Models Need Reasoning to Classify Dementia from Speech?
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have emerged as a promising approach for improving the accuracy, transferability, and explainability of automatic dementia classification (ADC) systems from voice recordings. Yet it remains unclear whether their reasoning capabilities are beneficial for ADC, and how such capabilities should be leveraged. In this paper, we conduct a careful evaluation of reasoning MLLMs for ADC and show that naive strategies, such as relying on text-based rationales, can lead to hallucinated and inconsistent rationales for diagnosis and yield inferior ADC performance compared with LLM-free baselines. To overcome this limitation, we propose \textbf{De}mentia \textbf{T}hinker with Nonlinear \textbf{A}daptor and Re\textbf{i}nforcement \textbf{L}earning (DeTAiL), an adaptor-based framework that exploits the internal representations of reasoning MLLMs for improved dementia classification. Across two dementia datasets with distinct test formats and label granularities, DeTAiL consistently outperforms strong baselines and methods that rely on text-based rationales. Code and demo will be released upon acceptance.

AI.title_translation: 多模态大语言模型在通过语音分类痴呆症时需要推理吗？
AI.tldr: 本文指出直接利用多模态大模型的文本推理进行痴呆症语音诊断容易产生幻觉，并为此提出 DeTAiL 框架，通过利用大模型的内部表征结合强化学习，显著提升了分类性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在自动痴呆症分类（ADC）中展现出潜力，但其推理能力是否真的对 ADC 有益以及如何有效利用仍不明确。直接依赖文本推理的朴素方法容易导致幻觉和不一致的诊断，甚至使其性能劣于不使用大模型的基线方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 DeTAiL（Dementia Thinker with Nonlinear Adaptor and Reinforcement Learning）的适配器框架。该框架不依赖容易产生幻觉的文本推理，而是直接利用推理型 MLLM 的内部表征（internal representations），并结合非线性适配器和强化学习来优化痴呆症的分类。
AI.result: 在两个具有不同测试格式和标签粒度的痴呆症语音数据集上，DeTAiL 框架的分类性能一致且显著地优于强基线方法以及依赖文本推理的方法。
AI.conclusion: 直接使用大语言模型的文本推理进行痴呆症诊断容易产生幻觉且效果不佳。而通过提出的 DeTAiL 框架有效利用推理型 MLLM 的内部表征，可以显著提升语音自动痴呆症分类的性能，为多模态大模型在医疗领域的应用提供了更有效的方法。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）已成为提高基于语音记录的自动痴呆症分类（ADC）系统准确性、可迁移性和可解释性的一种很有前景的方法。然而，它们的推理能力是否对 ADC 有益，以及应该如何利用这些能力，目前仍不清楚。在本文中，我们对用于 ADC 的推理型 MLLM 进行了仔细的评估，并表明朴素的策略（例如依赖基于文本的推理依据）可能会导致诊断中出现幻觉和不一致的依据，并产生比不含 LLM 的基线更差的 ADC 性能。为了克服这一局限性，我们提出了带有非线性适配器和强化学习的痴呆症思考者（DeTAiL）——一个基于适配器的框架，它利用推理型 MLLM 的内部表征来改进痴呆症分类。在具有不同测试格式和标签粒度的两个痴呆症数据集上，DeTAiL 一致优于强基线和依赖基于文本推理的方法。代码和演示将在论文录用后发布。
AI.summary: 本文评估了推理型多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在语音自动痴呆症分类（ADC）中的表现。针对直接使用大模型文本推理容易导致诊断幻觉和性能下降的问题，作者提出了 DeTAiL 框架。该框架通过非线性适配器和强化学习，直接利用 MLLMs 的内部表征来进行分类。实验表明，DeTAiL 在多个数据集上均取得了超越现有基线方法的优异表现。
AI.keywords: 多模态大语言模型, 自动痴呆症分类, 语音分析, 内部表征, 强化学习
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：文章没有盲目跟风直接使用大模型的生成文本，而是敏锐地发现了文本推理容易产生幻觉的弊端，转而利用大模型的内部表征（Internal Representations）结合非线性适配器与强化学习，这种设计非常巧妙且务实。
2. 重要性：在医疗诊断等对准确性和可靠性要求极高的领域，解决大模型的幻觉问题至关重要，本文为多模态大模型在医疗语音分析领域的应用落地提供了切实可行的思路。
3. 局限性：由于仅基于摘要，尚不清楚在放弃文本推理、改用内部表征后，系统在临床应用中如何重新获得或保障其“可解释性”。

title: Sensitivity Analysis and Optimization of Stochastic Epidemic Models under Parameter Uncertainty
summary:
To address sensitivity analysis and optimization for a discrete-time stochastic epidemic model, we derive unbiased gradient estimators that accommodate uncertainties represented as distributions over the parameters of interest, such as those arising from Bayesian calibration.
  Specifically, we estimate the sensitivity of total infections over a finite time horizon with respect to the proportion immunized ($v$) and the contact rate ($β$). Comparing the proposed estimators with deterministic limit approximations based on large populations reveals differences due to the finite population and time horizon. The estimators exhibit lower variance than finite-difference estimators for the derivative with respect to $β$, but higher variance for the derivative with respect to $v$. Simulation experiments indicate parameter uncertainty reduces sensitivity to the parameters of interest. In particular, indirect effects of vaccination, such as herd immunity, are less pronounced compared to when parameters are known. For optimization problems balancing intervention and infection costs, incorporating parametric uncertainty leads to more conservative policies.

AI.title_translation: 参数不确定性下随机流行病模型的敏感性分析与优化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种适用于参数不确定性环境下的随机流行病模型无偏梯度估计器，研究表明参数不确定性会降低敏感性，并在成本优化中导致更保守的防疫政策。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决离散时间随机流行病模型在参数存在不确定性（例如由贝叶斯校准引起的不确定性）时的敏感性分析和优化问题。
AI.method: 推导了无偏梯度估计器，该估计器能够容纳表示为目标参数分布的不确定性。具体而言，该方法用于估计在有限时间跨度内，总感染人数对免疫比例（$v$）和接触率（$\beta$）的敏感性。
AI.result: 与基于大群体的确定性极限近似相比，所提估计器展示了有限群体和有限时间跨度带来的差异。在对接触率 $\beta$ 求导时，该估计器的方差低于有限差分估计器，但在对免疫比例 $v$ 求导时方差较高。模拟实验表明，参数不确定性降低了对目标参数的敏感性，且疫苗接种的间接效应（如群体免疫）在参数不确定时变得不那么显著。
AI.conclusion: 在平衡干预成本和感染成本的流行病防控优化问题中，将参数不确定性纳入考量会导致制定出更为保守（审慎）的防控政策。
AI.translation: 为了解决离散时间随机流行病模型的敏感性分析和优化问题，我们推导了无偏梯度估计器，该估计器能够容纳表示为目标参数分布的不确定性（例如由贝叶斯校准产生的不确定性）。具体而言，我们估计了在有限时间跨度内，总感染人数对免疫比例（$v$）和接触率（$\beta$）的敏感性。将所提出的估计器与基于大群体的确定性极限近似进行对比，揭示了由于有限群体和有限时间跨度带来的差异。在对 $\beta$ 求导时，该估计器的方差低于有限差分估计器，但在对 $v$ 求导时方差较高。模拟实验表明，参数不确定性降低了系统对目标参数的敏感性。特别是，与参数已知时相比，疫苗接种的间接效应（如群体免疫）变得不那么明显。对于平衡干预成本和感染成本的优化问题，纳入参数不确定性会导致产生更为保守的决策。
AI.summary: 本文针对存在参数不确定性的离散时间随机流行病模型，提出了一种无偏梯度估计器，用于分析总感染人数对免疫比例和接触率的敏感性。研究对比了该估计器与确定性极限近似及有限差分法的性能，并表明参数不确定性会削弱群体免疫等疫苗间接效应，从而在疫情防控的成本优化中引导出更保守的决策。
AI.keywords: 随机流行病模型, 敏感性分析, 参数不确定性, 梯度估计, 政策优化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于在随机流行病模型中引入了能够处理参数不确定性（如贝叶斯校准得到的分布）的无偏梯度估计器，这对于实际流行病学决策具有重要意义。然而，其局限性在于，在针对免疫比例（v）求导时，所提估计器的方差高于传统的有限差分估计器，这表明在某些特定参数的敏感性分析中仍有改进空间。

title: An unsupervised kernel norm monitoring for fault detection in a time series photovoltaic system
summary: Grid-connected photovoltaic systems (GCPVS) are generally robust but remain susceptible to faults that can compromise energy conversion efficiency or raise safety concerns. Promptly and automatically detecting such anomalies is therefore essential for maintaining system reliability and performance. However, in practice, labeled fault data are rarely available in real-world deployments, which limits the applicability of supervised approaches. Conventional unsupervised baseline models, including a one-class support vector machine (OCSVM), isolation forest (iForest), and local outlier factor (LOF), are trained on normal operation data and assign anomaly scores reflecting how closely new observations resemble that baseline. Although these methods already accommodate non-linear behavior to varying degrees, kernel-based formulations offer further flexibility in shaping the decision boundary; however, tuning the kernel hyperparameters ordinarily requires some prior knowledge of the fault regime. We overcome this limitation by proposing kernel-based norm monitoring (KNM), a non-linear, unsupervised, window-based fault-detection method designed for continuous processes. Although the paper focuses on the GCPVS as a case study, KNM is a general-purpose monitoring framework applicable to a wide range of industrial processes. Using the Grid-connected PV System Faults (GPVS-Faults) dataset operating in intermediate power point tracking (IPPT) mode, KNM is evaluated in two fault scenarios, sensor faults and partial shading, against three benchmark techniques: OCSVM, iForest, and LOF. KNM achieves up to 99.1% and 98.3% accuracy on the two fault scenarios, respectively, using the Cauchy kernel, compared to 93.5% for the best-performing benchmark. The method is interpretable, and variable contribution plots are proposed to support fault identification.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于时间序列光伏系统故障检测的无监督核范数监测方法
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为核范数监测（KNM）的无监督、基于核的故障检测方法，用于光伏系统，克服了缺乏标记数据和传统方法局限性的问题，并在传感器故障和部分遮蔽场景中取得了高精度。
AI.motivation: 并网光伏系统（GCPVS）虽然通常很稳健，但仍易受故障影响，这些故障会损害能量转换效率或引发安全问题。因此，及时自动检测这些异常对于维护系统可靠性和性能至关重要。然而，在实际部署中，标记的故障数据很少可用，这限制了监督方法的适用性。传统的无监督基线模型（如OCSVM、iForest和LOF）虽然能适应非线性行为，但核方法的超参数调整通常需要先验知识。
AI.method: 论文提出了一种名为核范数监测（KNM）的非线性、无监督、基于窗口的故障检测方法，专为连续过程设计。KNM克服了传统核方法需要先验知识来调整超参数的限制。该方法使用柯西核，并通过变量贡献图支持故障识别。KNM在Grid-connected PV System Faults (GPVS-Faults) 数据集上，在中间功率点跟踪 (IPPT) 模式下，针对传感器故障和部分遮蔽两种故障场景进行了评估。
AI.result: KNM在使用柯西核的情况下，在传感器故障和部分遮蔽两种故障场景中分别达到了99.1%和98.3%的准确率，而表现最好的基准方法（OCSVM、iForest、LOF）的准确率为93.5%。该方法具有可解释性，并提出了变量贡献图来支持故障识别。
AI.conclusion: 核范数监测（KNM）是一种有效且通用的无监督故障检测框架，特别适用于缺乏标记故障数据的工业过程，如光伏系统。它在保持高精度的同时，提供了可解释性，并显著优于现有基准方法。
AI.translation: 并网光伏系统（GCPVS）通常很稳健，但仍然容易受到可能损害能量转换效率或引发安全问题的故障的影响。因此，及时自动检测此类异常对于维护系统可靠性和性能至关重要。然而，在实际部署中，标记的故障数据很少可用，这限制了监督方法的适用性。包括单类支持向量机（OCSVM）、隔离森林（iForest）和局部异常因子（LOF）在内的传统无监督基线模型，都是在正常运行数据上训练的，并分配异常分数，反映新观测值与该基线的接近程度。尽管这些方法已经不同程度地适应了非线性行为，但基于核的公式在塑造决策边界方面提供了更大的灵活性；然而，调整核超参数通常需要一些关于故障状态的先验知识。我们通过提出核范数监测（KNM）克服了这一限制，这是一种为连续过程设计的非线性、无监督、基于窗口的故障检测方法。尽管本文以GCPVS作为案例研究，但KNM是一个通用的监测框架，适用于各种工业过程。使用在中间功率点跟踪（IPPT）模式下运行的并网光伏系统故障（GPVS-Faults）数据集，KNM在传感器故障和部分遮蔽两种故障场景中，与三种基准技术：OCSVM、iForest和LOF进行了评估。KNM在使用柯西核的情况下，在两种故障场景中分别达到了99.1%和98.3%的准确率，而表现最好的基准方法的准确率为93.5%。该方法具有可解释性，并提出了变量贡献图来支持故障识别。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了一种名为核范数监测（KNM）的无监督、非线性、基于窗口的故障检测方法，旨在解决并网光伏系统（GCPVS）中故障检测面临的挑战，特别是缺乏标记故障数据的问题。KNM通过引入核函数来增强决策边界的灵活性，同时避免了传统核方法对先验知识的需求。该方法在GPVS-Faults数据集上，针对传感器故障和部分遮蔽两种场景进行了评估，结果显示KNM的准确率分别高达99.1%和98.3%，显著优于OCSVM、iForest和LOF等基准方法。此外，KNM还提供了可解释性，通过变量贡献图辅助故障识别，使其成为一种通用且高效的工业过程监测框架。
AI.keywords: 无监督故障检测, 核范数监测, 光伏系统, 时间序列, 异常检测
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了KNM，一种无需先验知识即可调整核超参数的无监督故障检测方法，有效解决了实际应用中标记数据稀缺的问题。其通用性使其不仅限于光伏系统，还可应用于其他工业过程。高准确率和可解释性是其突出优势，为工业故障诊断提供了有价值的工具。

title: An Adaptive Glicko-2 Rating Framework for Probabilistic Football Forecasting and Season Simulation
summary: Football match outcome prediction is a challenging problem because team strength changes over time, match outcomes contain a high level of randomness, and draws play a central role in the result structure. Classical rating systems such as Elo provide simple and interpretable dynamic summaries of team ability, but they do not explicitly model uncertainty and often ignore football-specific contextual information. This paper proposes an adaptive Glicko-2-based rating framework for probabilistic football forecasting and leaguelevel season simulation. The proposed framework extends the standard Glicko-2 model by incorporating football-specific mechanisms, including margin-of-victory adjustment, dominance weighting, structural shocks, home advantage modelling, and an ordered-logit draw model. The framework estimates latent team strength dynamically, converts rating differences into win-draw-loss probabilities, and uses these probabilities to simulate the remaining part of a league season through Monte Carlo sampling.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于概率足球预测和赛季模拟的自适应 Glicko-2 评分框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应 Glicko-2 框架，用于足球预测和赛季模拟，通过纳入足球特定因素和平局模型来改进预测。
AI.motivation: 足球比赛结果预测是一个具有挑战性的问题，因为球队实力随时间变化，比赛结果包含高度随机性，并且平局在结果结构中扮演着核心角色。经典的评分系统（如 Elo）无法明确建模不确定性，并且经常忽略足球特定的上下文信息。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种基于自适应 Glicko-2 的评分框架。该框架通过纳入足球特定机制扩展了标准 Glicko-2 模型，包括胜负分调整、优势权重、结构性冲击、主场优势建模以及有序 Logit 平局模型。该框架动态估计潜在的球队实力，将评分差异转换为胜-平-负概率，并利用这些概率通过蒙特卡洛抽样模拟联赛赛季的剩余部分。
AI.result: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 足球比赛结果预测是一个具有挑战性的问题，因为球队实力随时间变化，比赛结果包含高度随机性，并且平局在结果结构中扮演着核心角色。Elo 等经典评分系统提供了简单且可解释的球队能力动态摘要，但它们没有明确地建模不确定性，并且经常忽略足球特定的上下文信息。本文提出了一种基于自适应 Glicko-2 的评分框架，用于概率足球预测和联赛级别赛季模拟。所提出的框架通过纳入足球特定机制扩展了标准 Glicko-2 模型，包括胜负分调整、优势权重、结构性冲击、主场优势建模以及有序 Logit 平局模型。该框架动态估计潜在的球队实力，将评分差异转换为胜-平-负概率，并利用这些概率通过蒙特卡洛抽样模拟联赛赛季的剩余部分。
